tei:div.tei:p: 'ga' zhig 'jil ba dang*/

/ting 'dzin phra mo skyed pa'i thabs/ /dad pa chen pos bsgoms na yang*/ /yang dag ye shes mi skye bas/ /ma dag pa yi bsgom pa yin/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang mi mthun pa'i/ /'chad rtsom rtsod la mkhas gyur cing*/ /bya ba thams cad shes gyur kyang*/ /ma dag pa yi shes rab yin/ /bla ma ngan la dad pa dang*/ /chos ngan pa la mos pa dang | | bsgom ngan pa la dga' ba ni/ /ma dag pa yi dad pa yin/ /nad pa dga' ba'i kha zas ster/ / tshad nad can skom pa la snying rje zer nas chang ster ba lta bu'o|| ngan par spyod pa la snying rje zer nas/ tshar mi gcod/ / pa lta bu'o/ /chos zab mo ma thob par snying rje zer nas dbang bskur med par gsang sngags ston/ / pa lta bu/ zab dang rgya che'i snod min pa la chos 'chad pa la/ sogs/ / pa lta bu/ 'phral la phan pa ltar snang yang*/ /phyi nas gnod pa cher 'gyur bas/ /snying rje'i dbang gis byed na yang*/ /ma dag pa yi snying rje yin/ /gdug pa can la byams pa dang*/ /bu dang slob ma phyin ci log byed pa thabs kyis/ mi 'chos dang*/ / srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms na bdud la gnod zer nas/ mi bsgom zhing*/ khro bo'i bzlas pa bgegs la gnod zer nas/ 'gog pa sogs/ /rgyud sde kun dang 'gal te lha khro bor bzhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bdud 'dul ba thams cad byams pa med par thal/ bas na/ / de 'dra'i rigs ma dag pa yi byams pa yin/ /mdo rgyud kun las ma gsungs shing*/ /rigs pas bsgrub par mi nus pa/ / lto ba'i nang du me mthe bong gi tshad tsam bsgoms pas drod dang bde ba skye ba mu stegs byed la'ang yod pa/ dang*/ /mi rtog ltar snang skye ba rtog pa kha bkag nas mi rtog pa bsgom pa mu stegs pa la'ang yod/ sogs/ /nad gdon cung zad sel ba dag / mu stegs kyi na ra si ha dang ha nu maṇ+ḍa la sogs pa'i dmigs pa'ang 'ga' zhig gis/ blun po dga' ba bskyed na yang*/ /mu stegs byed la'ang yod pa'i phyir/ /ma dag pa yi thabs lam yin/

/bdag lta'i rtsa ba ngar 'dzin/ ma chod cing*/ /'khor ba'i phun sum tshogs pa dang mya ngan las/ 'das pa'i bde ba/ gnyis la smon pa can// dge ba la ni ngo mtshar du/ blta/ / ba/ chos kun spros bral mi shes pas/ chos kyi dbyings yod pa'i dge ba yin zer ba lta bu/ / sangs rgyas nyid du bsngo na yang*// bsngo ba des sangs rgyas thob mi srid pas ma dag pa yi smon lam yin/ /de la sogs pa nor ba mang po yod kyang bshad kyis mi lang bas/ mtha' yas pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi gnad 'chugs pa/ /dge bar byed par snang na yang*/ /ma dag pa ru shes par gyis/ /mdor na sangs rgya gsung rab dang*/ /mthun pa'i thos bsam bsgom pa gsum/ /bsam pa dag pas sgrub byed na/ / sangs rgyas bstan par shes par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na// smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed lam rim pa/ gnyis la 'bad par bya/ /smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur yang*/ /bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing*/ /cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa/ /phyi nang rten 'brel bsgrig mkhyen zhing*/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ / bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang*/ /de yis sdom pa sum ldan 'gyur/ /deng sang rdo rje phag mo yi/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur yin zhes zer/ /'di yis chos kyi sgo phye nas/ /gtum mo la sogs bsgom pa mthong*/ /'di 'dra rgyud sde las ma gsungs/ /bstan bcos rnams las bshad pa med/ / rdo rje phag mo'i gzhung khungs ma/ nyid las kyang*/ / dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs bya'o zhes gsungs kyi/ dbang bskur ma thob/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa la byin rlabs bya bar ma gsungs/ dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan/ /de la byin rlabs bya zhes gsungs/ /dbang bskur med la byin rlabs bkag

/dper na mu zi'i bcud len 'ju/ /de nas dngul chu bza' bar gsungs/ /mu zi thog mar ma bsten par/ / dngul chu zos na 'chi ba ltar/ /de bzhin thog mar dbang bskur blang*/ / de nas rdo rje phag mo sbyin/ /dbang bskur med par byin brlabs na/ /dam tshig nyams par thub pas gsungs/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ / sdom pa gsum ldan bya mi rung*/ /phyi nang rten 'brel 'grig mi 'gyur/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon thegs mi nus/ /de phy-ir 'di ni byin rlabs tsam/ /yin gyi smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur/ pa min/ /des na thub pas rgyud sde de nyid bsdud pa la sogs pa/ las/ /dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du 'di ni ma smra zhig /smras na dam tshig nyams zhes gsungs/ /'ga' zhig 'di la'ang phag mgo la/ /sogs pa gri gug dang*/ mda' gzhu dang*/ chang pa stong pa 'i dbang bskur yod ces zer/ /de 'dra dbang bskur nyid ma yin/ /rgyud sde kun las 'di ma gsungs/ /gal te brgya la sus kyang ma mthong ba'i rgyud sde 'dra las| gsungs srid kyang*/ /rjes gnang yin gyi dbang bskur min/ /la la rdo rje phag mo la/ /sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang*/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang bskur sogs/ /rang bzos cho ga byed pa thos/ /rang bzos cho gar 'gyur mi srid/ /cho ga sangs rgyas spyod yul yin/ khyim pas mkhan slob dad pa'i dge 'dun/ gsol bzhi'i las byas pa la sogs pa cho ga gang gi lad mo byed/ kyang*// dge slong gi sdom pa mi 'chags pa/ ltar/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ / sdom pa phog kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa/ 'chags mi 'gyur/ /cho ga cung zad nyams pa tshig gi brjod pa bag tsam 'khrul ba/ la'ang/ /cho ga 'chags par ma gsungs na/ / 'dul ba'i mdo las kyang*/ cho ga las 'das na las mi 'chags zhes so/ / cho ga phal cher nyams pa dang 'khrul pa/ la/ /cho ga 'chags par 'gyur re skan/ / te mi 'chags/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/

khyad par can gyi las rnams la/ /lha dus bya ba dus bzhin bstan/ /gzhan du cho ga nyams pa'i phyir/ /'grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so| | des na 'chad pa'i gnas skabs su/ /cung zad nor bar gyur kyang bla'i | | sman dpyad nor bas nad pa mi sos pa'am/ so nam nor bas ston thog mi 'byung ba ltar cho ga nor bar gyur pa la/ /grub pa nam yang med par gsungs/ / gzhan yang phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ /gsang sngags chos sgor byed pa ni// rgyu sde gang na'ang bshad pa med/ /de bas dge slong byed pa la/ / mkhan slob dad dge mi dgos par rang byung gi ni bsnyen rdzogs sangs rgyas/ dang*/ / lnga sde ye shes khong du chud pa'i bsnyen rdzogs/ pa dang*/ / chos sbyin ma 'phrin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*/ /de bzhin 'od srungs chen po/ ston pa khas blangs kyi bsnyen rdzogs| dang*/ /tshur shog la sogs so ta ya na'i bu dris pa'i lan glan pas/ bsnyen rdzogs blang*/ / da lta byed na rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ /'di 'dra'i lugs kyi bsnyen rdzogs gnyis/ 'khrul pa yin pa mnyam po la/ / bsnyen rdzogs 'di rnams sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus/ gyi cho gar 'dul ba lung las/ bshad/ / rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la sngon chog tu'ang bshad pa med/ rdo rje 'chang gis kyang sngon gyi cho ga thams cad sprul pa'i dkyir 'khor du dbang bskur bar gsungs so/ / des na nyan thos theg pa ni/ /nub kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang*/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la/ / gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo*/ / deng sang blun po snying phod can rnams/ gyis kyang*/ /'dul ba'i la cho ga dang 'ol spyi ma bstun pa/ cho ga la/ brgal ma nus// gsang sngags kyi/ cho ga dbang dang rim gnyis/ thams cad la/ /blun po rnams kyis rgyud sde nas ma gsungs pa'i phag mo'i cho ga la sogs pa/ rang bzor spyod/ / pa mang*/ dper na rab byung gang zag ni/ / lung las/ tshogs kyis tshogs ky-i las mi bya//zhes bya ba la brten nas

gsum las mang ba 'jug mi nus/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa na/ /grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed/ /'di ni rdo rje 'chang gis bkag /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs/ /lhag ma dmigs bsal mdzad pa yi/ /slob ma la ni grangs nges yod/ /'di ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ /mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga'am yang na bdun dag gam/ /nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung*/ /de bas lhag pa'i slob ma ni/ / yongs su gzung bar mi shes so/ /zhes gsungs 'di ni kun la 'jug /de bas lhag pa'i slob ma la/ /cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /mtshan mo gcig la tshar mi nus/ /de yi mtshan mor ma tshar na/ /cho ga nyams par 'gyur bar gsungs/ /de yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ /lha yang nyi ma nub pa na/ /nges par byin gyi rlabs kyis 'du/ /nyi ma shar bar ma gyur bar/ / mchod nas gshegs su gsol ba shis/ /'di ni bya ba'i rgyud yin pas/ / gzhan gyi cho ga min snyam na/ /gzhan rnams kun la'ang 'di 'jug par/ / spyi rgyud nyid las 'di skad gsungs/ / rgyud sde gang du dbang dang rab gnas la sogs pa'i/ las ni yod gyur la/ /las kyi cho ga rnams gsal po/ med pa/ / der ni gsang ba/ spyi yi rgyud dag las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas bsten | | zhes/ de skad gsungs phyir cho ga 'di/ / dbang bskur gsungs la grangs nges ma gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams kun la 'jug pa yin/ /deng sang byin rlabs mi byed cing*/ /dbang bskur byed pa kha cig kyang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga mi byed par/ /g.yung drung ris kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ /nas 'dra pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ la sogs byed pa thos/ / 'di 'dra dag tu dbang bskur yang*/ /sdom pa thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /de yi rgyu mtshan bshad kyis nyon/ /phyi dang lus ngag yid gsum byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun/

nang gi rten 'brel gyi/ /stobs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams sbyong ba| dkyil 'khor 'byung ba yin/ / g.yung drung ris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di la rten 'brel bsgrig mi nus/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyis bkag /dbang bskur byed pa phal cher yang*/ /slob ma brgya stong grangs med la/ / sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga rnams/ /sangs rgyas gsungs bzhin mi shes par | | ma 'brel 'gal zhing nyams pa yi/ /cho ga'i gzugs brnyan byed pa la/ /dbang bskur yin zhes blun po smra/ /de yi lus ngag yid gsum gyi | | rnam pa gdon gyis 'phag rgal dang ku co 'don pa/ bsgyur ba la/ /byin rlabs yin par 'khrul pa mang*/ /dpal ldan dam pa dang po 'i rgyud/ las/ / cho ga nyams pa'i byin rlabs kun/ /bgegs kyis yin par phyag dar khrod kyi sha za la sogs pa 'jug par/ rgyal bas gsungs/ /cho ga dag par gyur pa las// lus ngag yid gsum 'gyur ba byung ba sangs rgyas byin rlabs yin/ / par gsungs/ kha cig / dbang bskur med kyang lam zab mo/ /bsgoms na sangs rgyas 'grub snyam na/ /dbang bskur med par lam zab mo/ /bsgom pa ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsung*/ /phyag rgya chen po thig le 'i rgyud/ las/ /dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma las ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs rgyud sde gzhan las kyang*/ /de ltar gsungs dam pa dang po las/ dbang bskur med par sngags 'chad dang*/ /zab mo don nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang*/ /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba med/ /ces bya ba dang*/ rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad pa/ /sgrub pos sngags kyi don shes kyang*/ /shi nas ngu 'bod chen por lhung*/

/zhes bya ba sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ / phyir 'bad par bya/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab || smin byed phag mo'i byin rlabs yin/ /'bring dang tha ma dag la ni// dbang bskur cho ga dgos zhes zer/ ba 'di rang bzo yin te/ / gang zag rab 'bring gsum ka la/ /phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed du/ /rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /'phags pa rnams kyis gang zag rab/ /sprul pa yi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur mdzad ces de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa'i rgyud sde rnams las/ gsungs pa ni/ /sngon gyi cho ga 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi lugs| yin/ /deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod kyi/ /gzhan gyi phag mo la sogs pa/ smin byed rgyud las bkag /la la 'jug pa/ sems bskyed byas pa la | | gsang sngags bsgom du 'dod ces zer/ /'di ni sngags kyi 'khrul bya ba/ yin no/ /'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon/ /bya ba'i rgyud la rnam gsum yod/ / rtog pa'i rgyud don yod zhags pa la/ sogs 'ga' zhig gtsug tor rnam rgyal gdugs dkar/ la/ /dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang*/ /smyung gnas la sogs byed nus na/ /gang zag kun gyis sems can rnams la nus sam mi nus dris te sbyin zhes bya ba dang*/ dud 'gro'i rna lam du'ang sgrogs shig ces/ bsgrub par gsungs/ /dam tshig gsum bkod mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa/ la sogs pa/ / 'jug pa sems bskyed thob nas ni/ /phrin las zhi drag la sogs pa/ 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /cho ga shes na bsgrub par gnang*/ /legs par grub pa dang dpung pa bzang po/ yan chad du/ /rang gi dbang bskur ma thob na/ / sems bskyed thob kyang gsang sngags bkag / dpung bzang las/ gang dag rigs dang dbang bskur cho ga med/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*/ /gang dag byang chub sems ni ma bskyed la/ /nga yi gsang sngags bzlas na 'phung bar 'gyur/

/zhes bkag go / de yang legs par grub pa las/ /dbang bskur ma byas pa dag la/ /cho ga shes pas sngags mi sbyin/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la ltos/ / lhag ma rgyud sde gsum po la/ /dbang bskur thob pa ma gtogs pa/ / sems bskyed tsam la brten pa yi/ /yi dam bsgom pa gsungs pa med/ / dbang bskur nang gi rten 'brel yin/ /sems bskyed la ni rten 'brel med | | des na sems bskyed byas na yang*/ /gsang sngags zab mo bsgom pa la/ /ltung ba yod par rgyal bas de nyid bsdus pa las/ dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig smras na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ gsungs/ /de phyir rnam dbye shes dgos so/ /gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhes bya dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin dang ā li kā li'i dbang bskur la sogs pa/ gyi dbang bskur yang*/ /slob ma smin byed cho ga ru/ /rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /'ga' zhig gsang sngags da lta spyod/ /dbang bskur phyi nas khas len byed/ /'di yang sangs rgyas bstan pa min/ /dbang ma thob la chos bshad na/ /slob dpon ltung ba can 'gyur zhing*/ /slob ma'ang sngon du nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams par gyur pa dam chos kyi/ /snod min zhes ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /mdor na chos kyis ci byed soms/ /sangs rgyas byed na chos bzhin gyis/ /la la sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /dbang bskur thob kyang mi phan zer/ /gal te sems nyid rtogs gyur na/

/ dbang bskur bya yang mi dgos lo/ /'o na sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /sdom pa bsrungs kyang ci zhig phan/ /gal te sems nyid rtogs gyur na/ /sdom pa bsrung yang ci zhig dgos/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang*/ /sems nyid rtogs na bya ci dgos/ /gal te sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /byin rlabs byas kyang ci zhig phan/ /de bzhin sems bskyed la sogs pa/ /cho ga kun la sems nyid go na bla ma la gus kyang ci dgos ma go na gus pa byas kyang ci phan/ tshul 'di mtshungs/ /des na rab byung sdom pa mkhan slob las len pa/ dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs chos sgo ba las len pa/ dang*/ /sems bskyed bya dgos zer nas| 'bad nas byed bzhin du/ / sangs rgyas kyis gsungs nges pa'i dbang bskur mi dgos zhes smra ba/ /gsang sngags spong ba'i gsang tshig yin/ kha cig cho ga med bzhin du/ /bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par len zhes zer/ /'o na de bzhin du/ dge tshul dge slong yang*/ / mkhan slob mi dgos/ bla ma'i sku las cis mi len/ /sems bskyed kyang ni bla ma yi/ /sku nyid las ni thob pa'i phyir/ /sems bskyed cho ga ci zhig dgos | | rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang*/ /bla ma'i sku las thob pa'i phyir || chos sgo ba las blang ci dgos/ /de bzhin cho ga thams cad kyang*/ / bla ma'i sku las blangs pas chog / gyis la/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mdo rgyud las| gsungs pa yi/ /cho ga zab mo thams cad spongs/ /gal te cho ga nyams gyur na/ /so sor thar dang sems bskyed kyi/ /sdom pa 'chags par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i/ /byin rlabs 'jug par mi 'gyur na/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yang*/ /dbang bskur med na thob mi nus/ /des na cho ga gzhan dag la/ /'bad pa chen po byed bzhin du/ /dbang bskur cho ga bya mi dgos zer nas/ 'dor byed pa/ /thabs la bslu ba'i bdud yod ces/

mdo dang mdo sde rgyan las/ / gsungs pa 'dir yang dran par bya/ /de phyir dam pa'i don du na/ /chos rnams thams cad spros bral yin//de la cho ga gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang yod min na// cho ga gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi/ /dbye ba thams cad kun rdzob yin/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /dbang bskur la sogs cho ga dang*/ /bsgom pa'i dmigs pa ji snyed dang*/ /rten 'brel zab mo thams cad dang*/ /sa dang lam gyi dbye ba dang*/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa yang*/ /kun rdzob yin gyi don dam cha《zha》ta du cho ga byed par ja min/ /de 'dra'i dbye ba shes nas ni/ /cho ga byed na cha《zha》ta yang dag kun rdzob la ja thams cad gyis/ / don dam du cho ga byed pa min na sgom pa la sogs pa bya ba/ thams cad dor bar byos/ / phag mo'i byin rlabs la sogs pa chos nas ma gsungs pa'i/ cho ga la la byed/ dgos bzhin du chos nas gsungs nges pa'i dbang bskur dang*/ rim gnyis pa sogs pa/ / la la'i cho ga mi dgos zhes/ /smra ba mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'ang dkrugs pa yin/ / te dgos pa la mi dgos/ mi dgos pa la dgos pa zhes zer ba'i phyir ro/ /'bum dang phal po che las bdud kyi byin rlabs yin/ zhes bya ba'ang*/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can yin par gsungs/ kha cig bya ba'i rgyud sogs spyod pa dang*/rnal 'byor/ la'ang | | dbang bzhi'i cho ga byed pa dang*/ /don yod zhags pa thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma/ la sogs la'ang*/ /rim gnyis sgom par byed pa thos// 'di yang sangs rgyas dgongs pa min/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin// bya spyod rnam 'byor rgyud gsum gar/ /dbang bzhi dang ni rim gnyis med || gal te yod na de dag kyang*/ /rnal 'byor chen po nyid du 'gyur// dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin// grub mtha'i rnam dbye mi phyed cing*/ /rgyud sde'i rim pa mi shes par/

/rnam gzhag legs legs 'dra na yang*/ /lham dpe zhwa la bkab pa yin/ /des na rgyud sde bzhi po yi/ /dbang dang lam gyi dbye ba la/ /mi 'dra'i dbye ba rnam bzhi yod/ /rang rang cho ga bzhin byas na/ /de nas gsungs pa'i dngos grub 'byung*/ /la la dbang bskur ma byas kyang*/ /gal te sngags la mos thob na/ /de nyid chos kyi sgo yin pas/ /gsang sngags bsgom du rung zhes zer/ /'o na sdom pa ma thob kyang*/ /rab tu byung la mos pa nyid/ / sdom pa len pa'i sgo yin pas/ /sdom pa bsrungs pas chog gam ci/ / sems bskyed sdom pa ma thob kyang*/ /sems bskyed pa la mos pa nyid/ / byang chub spyod pa'i sgo yin pas/ /sems bskyed blang yang ci zhig dgos// de bzhin so nam ma byas kyang*/ /lo thog la ni mos pa nyid/ /bza' rgyu za ba'i sgo yin pas/ /so nam la yang 'bad ci dgos/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos lugs kun/ /de 'dra'i rigs kyis sun dbyung ngo*/ /des na chos sgo zhes bya ba/ / rgya gar na med/ bod kyis sbyar ba yin/ 'di yi ming gis 'khrul gzhi byas/ /dbang bskur chos sgo tsam yin gyi/ /'tshang rgya ba yi chos gzhan zhig /bsgom rgyu logs na yod do zhes/ /blun po rnams kyis mun bsgom byas/ /'o na dge slong sdom pa yang*/ /dge slong byed pa'i sgo yin gyi | | dge slong sdom pa'i ngo bo zhig /gzhan nas btsal du yod dam ci/ / de bzhin so nam byed pa yang*/ /ston thog 'byung ba'i sgo yin gyi/ kha zas 'byung ba'i thabs gzhan zhig /logs nas btsal du yod dam ci/ /des na snying gtam 'di ltar yin/ /dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin/ /gsang sngags rten 'brel lam du/ byed pa yin pa/ sa/ /rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas kyi/ sa bon cho ga'i rten 'brel khyad par can gyis/ btab nas ni/ / rab tshe 'dir 'bring 'chi ka'am bar do ru/ sangs rgyas thob par/

byed pa rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ dkyil 'khor cho ga ji ltar bu/ /cho ga chos dang rnal 'byor te/ /gsang ba'i thar pa yang dag 'byung*/ /skye ba 'di nyid kho na la/ /rab dga' sgrub par byed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so// yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ te dper na ston thog 'byung ba'i thabs la so nam byed pa bzhin no|| des na gang zag dbang po rab / / cha《zha》ta in+d+ra bo dhi lta bu/ ja dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs/ /dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i/ /gang zag gzhan la lam rim gnyis/ bsgom dgos la dbang ma thob na lam bsgoms kyang gsang sngags kyi lugs kyi grub thob mi yong bar gsungs/ so/ /des na dbang bskur thob pa de/ /bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa la/ /bsgom pa zhes su btags pa yin/ pas dbang gis yan lag ma yin pa'i sgom bya ba logs pa med/ / de phyir pha rol phyin pa la/ / smon 'jug gi sems bskyed blangs nas bsrung ba'i thabs/ min pa'i chos gzhan logs na/ med/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ / dbang bskur las gzhan chos med do/ /des na thub pas rgyud sde thams cad/ las | | dbang bskur kho nar bsngags pa dang*/ /mkhas pa/ rnams ci nas kyang bdog pa thams cad phul te/ dbang bskur zhu ba/ la/ /gus pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /la la dbang bskur mu bzhi 'dod/ / 'di dbang bskur rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud las gsungs zer te de bod ma yin/ dbang bskur byas kyang ma thob dang*// ma byas kyang ni thob pa dang*/ /byas na thob la ma byas na/ /mi thob pa dang rnam bzhir 'dod/ /'di 'dra khungs ma'i rgyud sde/ gang na'ang bshad pa med/ / bstan pa dkrugs pa'i snyad kar zad/ /'on kyang 'di yang brtag par bya// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed la'ang | | mu bzhi ci yi phyir mi brtsi/ /de bzhin bsgom la'ang cis mi mtshungs | | bsgoms kyang mi skye ma bsgoms kyang*/ /skye ba la sogs mu bzhi yod

pas mu bzhi rtsis la dbang bskur mi len pa ltar/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ sems bskyed la'ang mu bzhi rtsis la ma len/ sgom la'ang mu bzhi rtsis la ma sgoms/ / mu bzhi kun la yod bzhin du/ /gzhan la mu bzhi mi brtsi bar/ /dbang bskur nyid la brtsi ba ni/ /bdud kyi gsang tshig yin par dogs/ / dper na/ sman pa g.yon can gyis sman bzang po thams cad bsags te/ rtsa ba'i sman gcig bor nas nad pa gsor mi rung bar byed pa ltar/ gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo gzhan yod kyang*/ rtsa ba'i sman dbang bskur bor nas gsor mi rung bar gtong ste/ gsang sngags kyi gnad zab mo thams cad dbang bskur la yod pas de 'bor ba'i phyir ro/ gal te mu bzhi yod du chug na yang*/ / so so'i mtshan nyid shes mi nus/ /ci ste shes par nus na ni/ / lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam pa tha dad 'di ltar yod ces/ de yi mtshan nyid smra dgos te smra mi nus so// gal te 'ol tshod smras kyang rang bzo ma yin pa/ / khungs ma'i lung dang mthun pa khyed la med/ de khungs ma nas 'di 'dra bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ / gal te mu bzhi bden srid na/ /gzhan la dbang bskur mi byed kyang*/ /byas na thob pa'i gang zag la/ /dbang bskur ci yi phyir mi dgos/ /gzhan la dbang bskur mi dgos pas/ /de la'ang dbang bskur mi dgos na/ /nad med pa la sman spong bas/ /nad pa la yang spong ngam ci/ /'di 'dra'i chos log thams cad ni/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs yin zhes bya/ kha cig gsang sngags gsang ba la/ /ye gsang thabs kyis chod pa'i phyir/ / dbang bskur ma thob pa la gsang sngags bshad kyang*/ gsang sgrogs kyi/ ltung ba med ces zer/ /'di yang cung zad brtag par bya/ /ye gsang zhes bya'i don ci zhig /gal te go ba med pa la/ /zer na go ba'i gang zag la/ /ye gsang min phy-ir ltung bar 'gyur | | gal te dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /dam chos bden pa'i byin rlabs 'di/ /su yis thos kyang phan yon che/

/des na gsang sgrogs mi 'byung na/ /gal te khyed kyis/ dam chos bden pa cha《zha》ta ma go la che ja ru/ /go na chos nas 'byung bzhin gyis/ /chos la gsang ba gsang sngags/ dang mi gsang ba phar phyin pa 'i/ /lugs gnyis rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /des na ye gsang zhes bya ba/ /'di yang chos khungs ma nas bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ bstan la gnod tshig yin/ kha cig 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med/ /thabs lam gcig tu nges pa med/ /lta ba rtogs pas klu sgrub grol/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bskyed rim gyis/ /dka' thub spyad pas lū hi pa/ /spyod pa'i grogs kyis nag po pa/ /rlung gi stobs kyis go rak+ṣa/ /gtum mo'i stobs kyis sha wa ri/ /phyag rgya chen pos sa ra ha/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis tog tse ba/ /za nyal 'chag gis zhi ba lha/ /in+d+ra bhū ti 'dod yin gyis/ /rten 'brel thams cad tshogs pa las/ /bir+wa pa la grub thob byung*/ /'di 'dra'i thabs lam sna tshogs la/ /skur ba gdab tu mi rung zer/ /'di yang legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis min pa'i | | sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan med/ /des na grub thob thams cad kyang*/ /phyogs re'i thabs kyis grol ba min/ /dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i/ /ye shes skyes pas grol ba yin/ /lta ba dang ni bskyed rim dang*/ /gtum mo dang ni byin rlabs sogs/ /de dag rkyang pas grol ba min/ /dbang bskur ba yi byin rlabs dang*/ /rim gnyis bsgoms pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /ye shes rtogs nas grol ba yin/ / bskyed rim rlung dang gtum mo sogs/ /rim pa gnyis las tha dad min/ / byin rlabs de las byung ba yin/ /lta ba de yi yan lag yin/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba dbang dang rim pa gnyis po/ de'i ye shes/ la zer ba yin gyi/ bod lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po 'di la phyag rgya chen por chos nas bshad pa med/ / de yi spros bcas spyod pa ni/ /in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa yin/

/de yi spros med spyod pa la | | bhu za/ su nyal/ ku 'chag zhes sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de yi shin tu spros med ni/ /rim gnyis brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ /grub thob rnams kyis mdzad pa ni/ / rgyud sde rnams las/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod par bshad/ /des na thabs dang shes rab kyi/ rgyu rkyen ma tshogs par/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu mi 'byung mod/ /snga ma'i las 'phro'i bye brag dang*/ /nang gi rten 'brel khyad par gyis/ /ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren ni/ /thabs kyi dbye bas byed par gsungs/ /dper na nad pa'i lus brtas pa/ /bza' dang btung bas byed mod kyi/ /de yi yi ga 'byed pa ni/ /zas kyi khyad par se'u 'bru'am zho la sogs pa/ yin pa bzhin/ /de phyir dbang dang rim gnyis la sogs pa'i/ thabs kyi khyad par la/ / mi dgos zhes skur pa 'debs na blun po yin/ /'on kyang sems ngo 'phrod pa lta bu/ re res 'tshang rgya bar/ /'dod na shin tu 'khrul par bshad | | des na gsang sngags la 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na/ smin byed dbang dang ni/ / rim pa gnyis la 'bad par gyis/ /so nam tshul bzhin byas pa yi/ /lo tog rim gyis smin pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam zhugs na/ /grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i sa bon ni// nyi ma gcig la lo tog smin/ /rdo rje theg pa'i thabs shes na/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub/ /stong pa/ nyid dang byams pa/ snying rje la/ sogs bsgom pa/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs yin/ /de yis ji ltar myur na yang | | bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi dka' spyad dgos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam po che/ /rtsod pa kun las grol ba'i chos/ /mkhas pa kun gyis gus pas bsten/ /gal te 'di bzhin bsgrub 'dod na/ / mdo las rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs bshad pa/ med/ /lhan skyes la sogs pa'i lha/ 'dir mi bsgom/ /gtum mo 'phrul 'khor/ la sogs thabs lam bral/ / phyag rgya chen po

bsgom pa 'i tha snyad med/ /tshe 'di dang ni bar do dang*/ /phyi mar 'tshang rgya phar phyin pa/ khong mi bzhed/ /'on kyang theg pa chen po yi/ /sde snod rnams las 'byung ba bzhin/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ / grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis sogs/ /sems can yongs su smin pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams legs par sbyongs/ /sa bcu'i tha mar bdud btul nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par phar phyin las/ gsungs | | pha rol phyin gzhung ltar mgo dang rkang lag gtong zhing zhum pa'i sems med pa la sogs pa bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi dka' ba spyad mi nus par/ /gal te 'jug pa bde bas myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ gsang sngags bsgom par 'dod na// cho ga nor ba med pa'i dbang bzhi longs/ / gdams ngag gi gnad/ 'khrul pa med pa'i rim gnyis sgoms/ / dbang dang rim pa gnyis po de las byung ba'i ye shes ni | | phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba yin pas de la/ goms par bya / / bod lugs kyi rtog pa kha bkag pa'i phyag rgya chen po mi bsgom/

de nas 'khor 'das bsre ba'i phyir/ / rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin/ spyad/ /nang gi rten 'brel gyi/ sa bcu gnyis/ lam lnga/ kun bgrod nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ / bcu gsum pa ni thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ / dam pa'i chos kyi snying po yin/ /rgyud sde dri ma med pa/ rnams kyi gsang tshig mchog | 'di nyid yin par shes par bya/ / skyes bu gang zhig sangs rgyas byed 'dod na/ /de yis 'di bzhin spyad par bya/ /yang na pha rol phyin pa yi || mdo las ji ltar 'byung ba/ bzhin sems bskyed nas bskal pa grangs med gsum du pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i lugs/ gyis/ /yang na rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rgyud sde bzhin du dbang bskur ma nor ba long la rim gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa ma 'khrul bar/ nyams su long*/ / la sgoms/ phar phyin dang gsang sngags 'di gnyis min pa'i theg chen ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdo rgyud gang las kyang*/ gsungs pa med/ / da lta'i chos pa phal che ba/ / 'di ltar snang ste/ bslab pa gsum po lhag pa tshul khrims/shes rab/ting nge 'dzin/ mi sbyong bas/ /pha rol phyin pa'i chos lugs min// gsang sngags kyi dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min/ /'dul ba'i sde snod las tha na ltung ba sde lnga'i rnam gzhag tsam yang*/ mi shes pas/ /nyan thos kyi yang chos lugs min/ /'on kyang kho bo cag chos pa ngo mtshar can yin no zhes/ chos par khas 'che ba/ /kye ma sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ gang gi nang du'ang mi 'du ba 'di gang gi bstan par 'gyur/ / te gang gi bstan par 'gyur ngo ma shes| pha med pa yi bu mang yang*/ / rus med pa'i phyir/ rigs kyi nang du chud mi nus | | de bzhin du mdo rgyud gang gi'ang*/ khungs nas ma byung ba'i/ /chos pa bstan pa'i nang du min/ /dag dug bsdus pa'i gos la ni/ sprang po'i gos 'ong gi

| chen po rnams kyi chas mi rung*/ /de bzhin du/ thun tshags bsdus pa yi// chos kyis blun po phral dga' bar byed nus kyi/ dad can 'tshang mi rgya/ / dper na bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi zas bsres pa'i snyigs ma la bkru bshal zer/ de bzhin du khungs nas ma byung ba'i bsra bsre mang po chos kyi bkru bshal yin/ mu stegs byed pa kha cig kyang*/ / sangs rgyas pa la 'di skad zer/ /sdig pa spong zhing dge byed na/ /mu stegs yin yang ci zhig skyon/ /dge ba med cing sdig byed na/ /chos pa yin yang ci phan lo/ /de bzhin 'di na'ang blun po 'ga'/ /dad dang ldan zhing snying rje che/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa bsgom/ /bsam gtan bsgom zhing stong pa nyid/ /rtogs na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ sems bskyed dang*/ dbang skur dang rim gnyis la sogs pa mdo rgyud rnams dang mi mthun yang*/ /de la skyon med dad pa dang snying rje la sogs pa/ de dag med na/ /mdo rgyud dang*/ mthun bya ba'i ming gis/ yang ci phan lo/ /de yang brtag par bya ba 'i 'thad pa bshad kyi sa nyon/ /mu stegs byed la skyabs 'gro med pas/ sdom pa med/ /de 'i/ phyir dge ba byas na yang*/ /bar ma 'i dge ba bya ba/ yin gyi sdom pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba srid ma yin/ /de bzhin dbang bskur ma thob pa/ /de la rig 'dzin sdom pa med/ / gsang sngags kyi sdom med de yis dge spyad kyang*/ /bar ma 'i dge ba bya ba/ yin gyi gsang sngags kyi/ / sdom pa las byung dge ba min/ / bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa sdig pa mi byed kyang sdom pas bsdus pa'i dge bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ / sdom pa'i dge ba ma yin na/ / gsang sngags thabs lam rab zab kyang*/ /'tshang mi rgya bar thub pas dbang med na ni dngos grub med ces bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par/ gsungs/ /sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yi/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i gnad shes na/ /de ni tshe 'di'am bar do'am/

/skye ba bcu drug tshun chad na/ / 'grub par rdo rje rtse mo la sogs par gsungs te rgyas par yi ge mang gis dogs pas ma bris/ 'grub par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ / yang dag par sbyor ba las/ gzhan du bskal pa bye ba ni/ / grangs med pas ni gang thob pa/ /gang gi dam pa'i bde bas khyod/ /skye ba 'dir ni 'grub par 'gyur| de phyir 'di la mkhas rnams gus/ /gang dag rab tu 'byung 'dod na | | sdom pa bsrung phyir 'dul ba'i lugs bzhin/ gus pas longs/ /lto gos tsam la dmigs pa yi/ /rab tu 'byung ba thub pas bkag /sems bskyed byed pa de dag kyang*/ / dbu ma'i sems bskyed gang zag thams cad la bya bar gsungs/ sems tsam pa'i sems bskyed blo ma sbyangs pa la mi bya bar gsungs pa la/ bstan pa'i lugs bzhin mi byed kyi/ /thos chung rnams kyi mgo bskor nas/ /blun po dga' bar bya phyir sems tsam pa'i sems bskyed khrom la byed pa mthong*/ yin/ /gsang sngags bsgom pa mang mod kyi/ / dbang dang rim gnyis la sogs pa rgyud sde bzhin du bsgrub pa nyung*/ /spyod pa bde ba'i 'du shes kyis/ / chos nas ma bshad pa'i gang bde bde la bla ma'i gdams ngag tu ming btags nas/ rang bzor gsang sngags spyod par zad/ /gal te dbang skur byed na yang*/ / sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i cho ga bzang po'i gzhung lugs kun dor nas/ /gang dag brdzun gyis bslad pa phag mo'i dbang bskur la sogs/ la/ /ngo mtshar bzhin du gus pas len | | brgya la bskyed rim bsgom na yang*/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs 'phrod pa'i/ /cho ga'i yan lag bsnyen sgrub bzhi la sogs pa/ kun bor nas/ / rang bzo'i dkrongs bskyed bsgom par zad/ / de yi dam gyi lhar dkrongs kyis sgoms shig ces bya ba tsam la bskyed rim du re/ gtum mo bsgom pa phal cher yang*/ / rgyud nas gsungs pa'i nang gi rten 'brel mi shes par/ / gcer bu pa la sogs pa'i

mu stegs byed kyi gtum mo ltar/ /drod tsam la ni dmigs par go gtum mo ras thub ces zer ba thos/ ye shes cung zad skyes na yang*/ / lo tog dang sbur ma 'dres nas skye ba ltar ye shes dang rnam rtog 'dres nas skye ba yin te/ de 'byed pa la lam 'bras bu'i gdams ngag lta bu med na sgom skyes kyang*/ / de dag nyon mongs rnam rtog dang*/ / 'byed pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ lam du/ mi 'gyur/ /bla ma gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ma thob pa/ la ni mos na yang*/ /de 'dra'i bla ma bla ma min/ / te mu stegs btsun yang sdom pa ma thob pas dge slong du mi 'gyur la/ des mkhan po byas kyang mkhan por mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /dpe de bzhin du/ dpon slob gnyis ka gsang sngags kyi/ / dbang bskur ma thob/ sdom pa med pa yin la sdom med la bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mi srid pa'i/ phyir ro/ /dper na rab byung ma byas na | | mkhan po'i tha snyad med pa bzhin/ /de bzhin dbang bskur ma thob na | | bla ma'i tha snyad mi 'byung ngo*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba las/ gang la dbang rab mchog thob pa/ /de ni bla mar yongs su gzung*/ /zhes gsungs la/ rgyud rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa las kyang mang du gsungs so/ /de dag gi don bla ma lnga bcu pa la sogs pa mang po nas gsungs so// gsang sngags min pa'i bla ma la/ /mos pa byas kyang tshe 'di yi// bde skyid phun tshogs tsam zhig gam/ /rim gyis 'grub pa'i rgyu srid kyi/ / de ni tshe 'di'am bar do la/ /sangs rgyas nyid sbyin mi nus so/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs sangs rgyas phal po che la sogs pa/ las/ /bla ma sangs rgyas lta bu ru/ /blta bar bya zhes gsungs mod kyi/ /sangs rgyas dngos su gsungs pa cha《zha》ta ye shes grub pa las ja med/ / gsang sngags kyi bla ma sangs rgyas nyid yin zhes/ /bya ba dbang bskur thob nas yin/ /dbang bskur sdom pas ma 'brel na/

/ bla ma bzang yang pha rol phyin pa yin/ /rab byung min la 'dul ba'i lugs kyi/ mkhan po med/ /dbang ma bskur la gsang sngags kyi lugs kyi| bla ma med/ /sdom pa med pa/ la sde snod kyi lugs kyi/ dge ba'i/ rgyun chags med | | skyabs 'gro med na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i/ chos pa min/ /dge sbyong sdom pa med pa dang*/ /rgyal sras sems bskyed ma thob pa/ /sngags pa dbang bskur med pa gsum/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chom rkun yin/ / phyag rgya chen po bsgom na yang*/ /rtog pa kha 'tshom nyid cha《zha》ta kha 'ching ba ja la phyag rgya chen po yin zer nas/ bsgom gyi/ /rim pa/ gnyis las byung ba'i/ ye shes la | phyag rgya chen po yin pa la/ phyag rgya chen por mi shes so/ /blun po phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher ye shes grub pa las rmongs pa'i sgom par ming btags nas/ dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /min na sems stong pa la ngo sprad nas dge ba ci rigs byas nas/ gzugs med khams su skye/ /yang na srid pa gsum tshogs bsags nas stong nyid rtogs na/ nyan thos 'gog par ltung*/ /gal te de ni bsgom legs te thabs shes rab zung 'brel du bsgom shes/ kyang*/ /dbu ma'i bsgom las lhag pa med | | dbu ma'i bsgom de bzang mod kyi/ /'on kyang 'grub pa shin tu dka' | | ji srid bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs pa/ /de srid bsgom de mthar mi phyin/ sdud pa las/de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba ji srid ma rdzogs bar// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ / 'di yi tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa la | | bskal pa grangs med dang pos sa dang po/ gnyis pas sa brgyad pa/ gsum pas sa bcu pa/ dgos par gsungs/ /nged kyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*/ /rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las/ /byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin/ /'di yi rtogs pa gsang sngags kyi/

/thabs la mkhas na tshe 'dir 'grub/ /de las gzhan du phyag rgya che/ /rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs/ /des na phyag rgya chen po la/ /mos na gsang sngags gzhung bzhin sgrubs/ /da lta bod phal ches bsgom pa 'i phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang ma hwa yan gyi/ lugs kyi rdzogs chen la/ /yas 'bab dang ni mas 'dzegs gnyis/ / rim gyis pa dang cig car bar/ /ming 'dogs bsgyur ba ma gtogs pa// don la de gnyis/ khyad par dbye ba med/ /chos lugs 'di 'dra 'byung ba yang | | byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho slob dpon bo dhi satwa sa/ /rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la/ /lung bstan ji bzhin thog tu bab/ /lung bstan de yang bshad kyis nyon/ /rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'dir/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas/ /mu stegs 'byung bar mi 'gyur mod/ /'on kyang rten 'brel 'ga' yi rgyus/ /chos lugs gnyis su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de yang thog mar nga 'das nas/ /rgya nag dge slong byung nas ni/ /dkar po chig thub ces bya ba/ /cig char pa yi lam ston 'gyur/ /de tshe nga yi slob ma ni/ /mkhas pa chen po ka ma la/ / shī la zhes bya rgya gar nas/ /spyan drongs de yis de sun 'byin/ /de nas de yi chos lugs bzhin/ /dad ldan rnams kyis spyod cig gsung*/ /de yis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /phyi nas thams cad bden par gyur/ /rgya nag lugs de nub mdzad nas/ /rim gyis pa yi chos lugs spel/ /phyi nas rgyal khrims nub pa dang*/ /rgya nag mkhan po'i gzhung lugs kyi/ /yi ge tsam la brten nas kyang*/ /de yi ming 'dogs gsang nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen por ming bsgyur nas/ /da lta'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin/ /nā ro dang ni mai trī ba'i/ / lugs kyi/ phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa/ /de ni las dang chos dang ni/ /dam tshig dang ni phyag rgya che/

/ gsang sngags rgyud nas ji skad du/ /gsungs pa de nyid khong bzhed kyi rtse gcig dang*/ ro gcig la sogs pa mi bzhed do/ /'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang | | phyag rgya bzhi par 'di skad gsung*/ las kyi phyag rgya mi shes pa rnams kyis ni chos kyi phyag rgya mi shes na/ phyag rgya chen po'i ming yang rtogs par lta ga la 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so// las kyi phyag rgya mi shes pas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'ang mi shes na/ / phyag rgya chen po'i ming tsam yang*/ /rtogs pa nyid ni mi srid gsung*/ / rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan dges pa rdo rje dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa/ dang ni/ / grub pa sde bdun sogs bstan bcos chen po gzhan las kyang*/ /dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba/ /de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /dbang bskur ba las byung ba yi/ /ye shes phyag rgya che rtogs na/ /da gzod mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i/ /'bad rtsol kun la mi ltos so/ /deng sang bod/ 'ga' zhig bla ma la gsol ba btab pa/ yi/ /mos gus byas pas rtogs pa cung zad skyes pa/ tsam gyis sems bsgyur nas/ /rtog pa cung zad 'gags pa la/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod byed/ /de 'dra 'i byin rlabs/ bdud kyi yin pa'ang srid/ /yang na khams 'dus 'ga' la'ang 'byung*/ /ka ru 'dzin zhes bya bal po'i grub thob zer ba yi/ /brdzun rlabs can gy-i grub thob byung*/ /de yi dgon pa mthong tsam gyis/ /'ga' la ting 'dzin skyes zhes zer/ /phyi nas de yi grub thob zhig | de nas ting 'dzin de rgyun chad/ /de 'dra'i ting 'dzin bdud rigs kyi | | 'byung po rnams kyis byed par mdo rgyud las/ gsungs/ / nag po ro zan bya ba zhig gis kyang la lar bsgom thebs pa byung ste/ de yang rgyal 'gong zhig gis byas par 'dug zer|| sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrub pa yi/ /byin rlabs sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin/ / sgom chen kha cig skye ba snga ma la/ /sems bskyed dbang bskur ma byas na/

/chos la dad pa mi srid pas/ /gang dag theg chen dad thob pa/ /de dag sngar sbyangs yin pas na/ /da lta dbang bskur bya/ mi dgos zer/ mos pa tsam sngar byas pa'i rtags yin pas da lta bya mi dgos na/ / 'o na so sor thar pa yi/ /sdom pa dag la mos pa yang*/ /snga ma'i sdom pa yod pa'i phyir/ /da lta mkhan slob kyis/ rab tu dbyung ba dang sdom pa len pa/ ci dgos | | byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dgos/ kyang*/ /snga ma'i sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir/ /da lta sems bskyed bya ci dgos/ rab byung dang sems bskyed ma byas na bstan pa dang 'gal bas bya dgos so zhe na/ / de dag dgos na gsang sngags kyi/ /dbang bskur yang ni ma byas na bstan pa dang 'gal bas na bya/ cis mi dgos te dgos/ / sangs rgyas chos la mi dga' ba'i/ /mu stegs byed kyis chos spangs pa/ / sangs rgyas pa'i dgra yin pas dgras chos spangs pa// de la mtshar du mi brtsi yi/ /sangs rgyas chos la brten bzhin du/ /mdo rgyud dri ma med pa la tshig gi na ya yin zer nas/

nyan bshad 'gog byed pa/ /de la kho bo ngo mtshar skyes/ /la la zhi gnas cung zad dang*/ /snang stong rtogs pa phra mo la | | mthong lam yin zhes ngo sprod byed/ khyung gi sgong rgya ma chag par 'phur mi nus pa/ ji bzhin du/ / rnal 'byor pa lus kyi rgya yis bcings pas na/ /da lta yon tan mi 'byung bas/ /lus rgya zhig pa'i shi ma thag /yon tan phyi nas 'byung zhes zer/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud mtha' dag las/ /'di 'dra'i chos lugs bshad pa med/ / dper na/ / nyi ma de ring shar ba yi/ /'od zer nangs par 'byung zer/ ba mi srid pa yin pas/ mtshar/ kha cig pha rol phyin pa dang | | gsang sngags gnyis kyi mthong lam la/ / phar phyin gyi rgyan can gsang sngags kyi rgyan med yin zhes zer/ /de ltar yin na sa bcu'i bar gyi bsgom lam yang rgyan can dang rgyan med rigs pa 'dis mthar/ sangs rgyas kyang*/ /rgyan can rgyan med gnyis su 'gyur/ / dgos te rgyu mtshan mtshungs pas so// nyan thos rnams kyi dgra bcom la/ / bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas thob pa rgyan can dang bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs tsam la brten nas thob pa rgyan med gnyis 'thad kyi/ /theg pa chen po'i 'phags pa la/ /rgyan can rgyan med gnyis su gzhung nas bshad pa med pas/ mi srid/ / mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras byang chub phyogs mthun pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad ni/ /rtag tu mthong ba'i lam de dang*//lhan cig tu ni thob par 'dod/ /ces gsungs so| |yang nyan thos lcags kyi tshwa tshwa 'phar ba dang*/bar snang dang*/ sa la bab nas mnal ba 'i dpes/ / dgra bcom pa la tshe 'dir mya ngan ma 'das pa/ /bar dor ram tshe phyi mar lus blangs nas/ mya ngan las/ 'da' bar gsungs/ /de bzhin du/ gsang sngags bsgom pa las/ /tshe 'dir mthong lam ma thob pa/ /bar dor mthong lam thob par rgyud nas gsungs pa yod/ mod kyi/ / khyed kyi lugs kyi/ tshe 'dir mthong lam skyes pa la/ /yon tan

tshe 'di la mi 'byung bar/ shi nas 'byung ba ni// blun po rnams kyi slob ma la mgo bskor ba'i/ brdzun rib yin/ / nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis ka'i mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun pas/ /'di 'dra'i chos lugs mkhas pas spangs/ /jo bo nā ro ta pa ni/ /dbang bskur dus su mthong lam skye/ / ba/ de ni nyi shu dgu'i zla ba ltar/ skad cig de la 'gag /chos mchog rjes kyi mthong lam skyes pa de/ ni/ / tshes gcig gi zla ba mthong ba ltar 'gag pa med ces gsungs par grag /'di ni dpe yi ye shes la/ /mthong ba'i lam du btag par zad/ / pa yin gyi mtshan nyid pa ma yin/ / 'phags pa lha yis spyod bsdus su/ / gang zag 'ga' zhig bden pa mthong yang zhing las la sogs pa'i/ las kyi| mtha' la/ /chags pa srid mod 'on kyang srid pa gzhan mi len/ par gsungs pa ni| rdzogs rim gyi/ /rang byung gi ye shes nyid yin/ rtogs pa ni/ /dpe yi ye shes nyid yin/ la de rtogs pa la bden pa mthong bar/ dgongs/ /de dang lam 'bras la sogs pa/ /grub thob rnams kyi dgongs pa mthun/ /des na nged kyi mthong lam ni/ /'phags pa min la 'byung mi srid/ /theg pa gsum gyi lag len yang*/ /rang rang gzhung lugs bzhin byed mi 'gal ba rnams mthun par nyams su blangs/ 'gal ba rnams dgag dgos gang gtso che rung mthun brtsis la nyams su blangs/ na/ /sangs rgyas bstan yin mi byed na/ /bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin zhes bya/ / dper na nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma so so skye bo/ de | | bzang yang bzhi sder ma longs pas dge 'dun du mi 'gro bas/ gang zag kho nar bas | | pha rol tu/ phyin pa'i bla ma ni/ /bzang na dge 'dun dkon mchog yin | | skyabs gsum bdun cu pa las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bdud ni bye ba brgya yis kyang*/ /gang phyir dbye bar mi nus pa/ /de phyir dge 'dun zhes su bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ / gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin/

/ he ru ka mngon 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang*/ ye shes grub pa las/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos 'gyur zhing*/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ / des na gsang sngags pa'i bla ma/ de la gsol btab pas/ / dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub/ ste sangs rgyas/ / de lta'i theg pa gsum po yi/ /so so'i gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /bla ma'i mtshan nyid mi ldan na/ /bla ma tsam/ yin gyi dam pa min/ / no//dam pa min pa de la gsol ba btab na yang*/ / 'khor dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ byin rlabs cung zad tsam| 'byung mod kyi/ /tshe 'di'am bar do la sogs su/ /sangs rgyas nyid sbyin par/ mi nus so/ /des na dbang bskur thob pa'i mis/ /dkon mchog gsum po bla ma 'i ngo bo/ ru/ /'dus par mthong nas bla ma la/ /gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'jug /gal te dbang bskur ma thob na/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum nyid du/ /phar la bsdus la dkon mchog gsum gyi nang du bla ma yod par ltos la dkon mchog gsum rang la/ gsol ba thob/ /rim gyis byin rlabs ci rigs 'jug/ dbang bskur ma thob pas bla ma rkyang pa bzang srid kyang*//gsol ba btab pa byin rlabs chung*/ / 'di'i rgyu mtshan dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi btub/ de bas dkon mchog gsum nyid la/ /gsol ba btab pa shin tu bzang*/ /dbang bskur dang po ma thob par/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ /dbang bskur gnyis pa ma thob par/ /gtum mo rlung 'khrul 'khor| la sogs bsgom pa dang*/ /dbang bskur gsum pa ma thob par/ / bde stong la sogs chos sku thob pa'i gdams ngag bsgom pa dang*/ /dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par/ /phyag rgya chen po sogs bsgom dang*/ /dge slong sdom pa ma thob par/ /mkhan slob la sogs byed pa ni/ /gsang sngags med par sbrul gdug gi /mgo las rin chen len pa ltar/ /rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru bas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyang ring spang*/

/gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod bod yul/ 'di na/ /'khrul pa'i lag len du ma yod/ kha 'bar ma yi gtor ma la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi yi mtshan/ / sngon la brjod pa'i lag len mthong*//'di yang mdo dang mthun ma yin/ / mdo las sngon la yi dwags kha nas me 'bar ba la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs/ sngags brjod nas/ /sangs rgyas bzhi po rin chen mang la sogs pa/ phyi nas gsungs/ / 'ga' zhig chu sbyin nang du zan/ /'jug pa'i lan len byed pa thos/ / 'jur gegs can gyi yi dwags kyis/ /chu sbyin nang du zan mthong na/ / 'jigs pa chen po 'byung bar gsungs/ /des na chu sbyin nang du zan/ / 'debs pa cho ga nyams pa yin/ /zan gyi phud la lha bshos dang*/ /chang bu bya bar sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las ni/ /zas kyi phud la chang bu sbyin/ /zhes gsungs 'phrog ma'i mdo las kyang*/ /sangs rgyas ston par khas 'che na/ /'phrog ma la ni chang bu sbyin/ /zhes gsungs de yi cho ga ni/ /lta ba ngan sel dang dze tā ri'i yi dam blangs pa dang*/ las dang po ba'i bya ba/ la sogs ltos/ /'ga' zhig sangs rgyas gsungs pa yi/ /lha bshos chang bu mi byed par/ /ma gsungs pa yi 'brang rgyas dang*/ /gru gsum la sogs byed pa mthong*/ /gsang sngags rnying ma 'ga' zhig las/ /gru gsum dbang phyug chen po'i snying*/ / dbang phyug de yi 'khor bcas kyi/ sha dang khrag gis brgyan/ /mtheb kyu mgo bo'i thod pas bskor/ /chang sogs bdud rtsis de bkang nas/ /he ru ka la mchod ces zer/ /gsang sngags gsar mar gru gsum gyi/ /gtor ma gzhung nas bshad pa med/ /zas kyi phud la khyad par du/ /gru gsum 'bul ba gsungs pa med/ /lag len thams cad sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung dang mthun na bstan pa yin/ /des na mdo sde ma dkrug par/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin nyams su longs/ / ltung bshags kyi sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba yi/ /phyag tu mtshon cha ral gri dang mda' gzhu sogs/

bskur ba 'i sgrub thabs bod kyis byas pa/ mthong*/ khyim pa'i cha lugs can longs sku'am khro bo ru sprul pa/ dag la/ /rgyan dang mtshon cha sogs srid kyi/ / rab byung rnams la 'di mi srid/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya sa gnon/ mchog sbyin| ting nge 'dzin/ skyabs sbyin/ sogs/ /mdzad pa'i rigs lnga ser 'byam mthong | | 'di mdo lugs yin zhes/ bod/ la la smra/ /mdo nas 'di 'dra gsungs pa med/ /bya spyod gnyis kyi rgyud las kyang*/ /sangs rgyas rigs lngar bsdus pa med/ /rnal 'byor gyi/ rgyud de nyid bsdus pa/ las gsungs pa ya ི/ / rigs lnga kha dog rnam snang dkar po la sogs pa/ tha dad cing*/ /phyag rgya yang ni rnam snang byang chub mchog la sogs pa/ tha dad gsungs/ /'di yi sku mdog phyag rgya ni/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung sku yin pas/ /ye shes lnga po kha dog lnga la rten 'brel bsgrig pa/ la 'thad pa yin/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs las/ / rigs lnga'i kha dog gzhan gsungs pa/ /'byung ba rnam pa lnga sbyong ba'i/ / rten cing 'brel 'byung sku yin no/ / 'di 'dir bshad du mi rung bla ma'i zhal las dris| sangs rgyas gser mdog ces mdo las/ gsungs pa/ / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar dri ma med cing dwangs ba'am/ /sprul sku phal che ba/ la dgongs te gsungs || gzhan du sman bla nam mkha'i mdog /sngon po nyid du mdo las gsungs | | pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ yi dam lha yi sgrub thabs dang*/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga dang*/ /mchog sangs rgyas/ dang thun mong zhi sogs/ dngos grub dang*/ /sgrub pa'i cho ga ji snyed pa/ / sgrub thabs kyi cho ga mdo sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /deng sang gang zag la la gsang sngags la mi mos par/ / sgrol ma dang mi g.yo ba la sogs pa nas bzung nas dges rdor bde mchog gi bar gyi lha bsgom sngags bzla ba rab gnas sbyin sreg la sogs byed pa yang*/ /sangs rgyas kyi| bstan pa/ dang mthun pa min/

/gzhan yang sbyin sreg ro sreg dang*/ / bdun tshig sāts+tsha'i cho ga sogs//deng sang gsang sngags lugs bor nas// mdo mchod tsam la brten pa yi/ /cho ga'i rnam gzhag byed pa yod/ /pha rol phyin pa'i mdo sde dang*/ /bstan bcos kun las cho ga de dag gsungs pa med/ / rgyun chags gsum pa tsam ma gtogs pa gzhan la dbyangs bya bar ma gsungs/ 'di dag ngan song sbyong rgyud la/ /sogs pa'i rgyud sde 'ga' zhig las/ / gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs ba yi/ /gsang sngags pa la grags pa yin// de bzhin rab gnas mdo lugs dang*/ /phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs dang*/ / ltung bshags dang ni sher snying sogs/ /sngags lugs yin zhes 'chad pa thos || 'di yang brtag par bya bas nyon/ /mdo nas rab gnas bshad pa med || 'on kyang mchod bstod bkra shis sogs/ / phyag byas me tog gtor nas nged kyi mchod gnas yin zhes/ rgyal po'i mnga' dbul lta bu la/ /rab gnas yin zhes smra na smros/ / rgya gar na khron pa dang skyed mos tshal la sogs pa la mchod pa byed pa la yang rab gnas su ming 'dogs pa yod/ lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas dang*/ / bum pa lha yi sta gon dang*/ /dngos gzhi'i dam tshig sems dpa' dang*/ / ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang*/ /spyan dbye brtan par gzhugs pa dang | | sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /me tog dor nas legs mchod de/ /bkra shis rgyas par byed pa yi/ /cho ga gsang sngags rgyud sde las | | gsungs kyi pha rol phyin las min/ / bod la la jo bo rje'i/ gdams ngag yin zhes smra/ /'o na mdo sde gang dag la/ /brten pa yin pa smra dgos so | | 'on kyang mdo gang nas kyang bshad pa med/ jo bo yang bshad mi gsungs/ bshad pa med pa la gdams ngag yin gsungs na/ jo bos kyang sangs rgyas ky-i bstan pa ma bzung ba yin/ deng sang gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha/ /bsgoms nas de dag gi sngags bzlas/ mdo lugs yin zhes smra/ /gsang 'dus la sogs cho ga la/

/mdo lugs cho ga 'byung ba mtshar/ / dper na seng ge'i phru gu glang chen las/ /byung na sngon med srog chags yin/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di 'dra yi/ /cho ga slan chad ma byed cig /lha la rab tu gnas pa dang*/ /mi la dbang bskur bya ba sogs | | rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ba/ /thob kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ma thob par/ bya bar ma gsungs na/ /dbang bskur gtan nas ma thob pa'i/ / gang zag rnams kyis smos ci dgos//rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur tsam/ / thob nas lha bsgom tsam dang ni/ /bzlas brjod dang ni sbyin sreg dang*/ / las tshogs la sogs bsgrub pa yi/ / thun mong gi dngos grub dang ni mchog sgrub pa'i/ phyag rgya yi/ /ye shes sgrub pa'i cho ga dang*/ /gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang rtog pa la sogs/ 'ga' zhig nyan pa la/ /dbang ba yin gyi rgyud 'chad dang | | dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas sogs/ / rdo rje slob dpon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i/ phrin las byar mi rung*/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang thob nas/ / 'khor lo lha yi de nyid sogs/ /rnam dag dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ / dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas sogs/ /slob dpon gyi ni phrin las dang | | sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /bla na med pa'i sdom pa sogs || 'di tsho'i bshad pa dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi rung bas bla ma'i zhal las dris| rdo rje slob dpon kho na'i las/ /nyid yin pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ma thob pa/ gzhan gyis byar mi rung*/ /deng sang rab gnas mdo lugs zhes/ / 'chad pa sangs rgyas bstan pa min/ khyim pas mkhan slob byed pa dang*/ / rdo rje slob dpon ma yin pas/ /dbang bskur rab gnas byed pa ni/ / gnyis ka sangs rgyas kyi/ bstan pa min par mtshungs/ / da lta bod na khyim pas mkhan slob byas na gad mo byed/ dbang bskur ma thob par rab gnas byed pa la gad mo mi byed par snang ste chos dang bstun na 'di gnyis 'dra ba yin/

phyag na rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas kyang*/ / mdo sde rnams nas bshad pa med/ /gzungs 'bum/ nas bshad pa de dag ni | | bya ba'i rgyud kyi cho ga yin/ / gzungs 'bum thams cad bya ba'i rgyud yin/ blun po'i bsam pa la po ti chen po la bris pas mdo yin snyam ste chos kyi rnam dbyai ma shes pas 'khrul pa yin/ byang chub ltung bshags sangs rgyas phyag mtshan la/ /phub dang ral gri mda' gzhu/ sogs 'dzin pa'i/ /sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis mdo rgyud gang las kyang*| ma gsungs/ /mdo dang rgyud kyi khyad par ni/ / dbang dang lha bsgom dang bzlas brjod sogs/ cho ga'i bya ba yod med yin/ /de ltar khyad yod med de'i rgyu mtshan| shes nas mdo sde dang*/ sngags kyi lugs kyi khyad par/ rnams dpyad de shes par gyis la smros/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba la la theg pa rim dgu la/ /lta ba tha dad yod ces zer/ /nyan thos dang ni theg chen la/ /lta ba'i rim pa yod mod kyi/ /pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags la/

/ sems tsam dbu ma gnyis phar phyin gsang sngags gnyis ka la yod/ de las lhag pa'i/ lta ba'i dbye ba bshad pa med/ / 'ga' zhig las dbu ma las kyang khyad par du 'phags zer ba yod de/ mthar 'dzin gyi dbu ma 'ga' zhig bzlog pa'i phyir yin/ 'dzin med kyi dbu ma dang khyad med/ de'i rgyu mtshan / pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni/ / theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse'i/ lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /spros bral yin na dbu ma dang khyad par med/ /des na bshad pas go ba yi/ /thos pa las byung ba 'i shes rab kyi/ lta ba gcig nyid yin/ /'on kyang spros bral mngon sum du/ rtogs pa yi/ / thabs la gsang sngags khyad par du/ 'phags/ kha cig dbu ma'i lta ba ni// kun rdzob 'di/ ji ltar snang ba/ bzhin du gsal ba/ yin/ /don dam pa yod med la sogs pa/ mtha' bzhi'i spros dang bral / / ba yin zer bya ba'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob ni | | sku gsung thugs kyi lha rigs gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /don dam dbu ma dang mtshungs zer/ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob dang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi kun rdzob ni/ /rigs lnga'i rgyal bar snang ba yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i kun rdzob ni/ /dam pa rigs brgya yin zhes zer/ / lta thog nas sgom de'i ngang nas spyod pa byed ces lta bsgom rnam dbye ma phyed cing*/ /thabs sgom pa/ dang lta ba shes rab spyod pas de gnyis mthar 'byin pa/ ma shes pas/ /'di 'dra'i dbye ba 'khrul ba yin/ /'di yi 'thad pa bshad kyis nyon/ / rigs gsum dang rigs lnga/ la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas su/ /bsgom pa 'i ldog pa/ yin gyi lta ba 'i ldog pa/ min/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum las/ /snang ba kun rdzob 'di/ lha ru gsungs pa med/ /'on kyang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ / rigs gsum gyi bris sku la/ lha ru bsgoms nas kyang*/ /de las dngos grub len pa yin no/ des na dka' thub

dang*/ gtsang sbra yis/ /sangs rgyas mnyes nas dngos grub gnang*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud du bris sku dang*/ /rang nyid gnyis ka lhar bsgoms nas/ / bdag gi sangs rgyas dang mdun gyi sangs rgyas gnyis grogs po lta bu'i tshul gyis/ dngos grub len/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du phyi rol gyi bris sku la sogs| la/ /dmigs pa'i rkyen tsam byas nas kyang*/ /rang nyid gtso bor/ dam tshig sems dpa' ru bsgom pa/ la/ /ye shes 'khor lo sngags ting nge 'dzin phyag rgya'i sgo nas/ spyan drangs nas/ /ji srid phyag rgya ma bkrol ba/ /de yi bar du rang gi lus la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /phyag rgya bkrol nas rang gi lus las/ sangs rgyas thon te rang bzhin gyi gnas su/ gshegs/ /de nas rang nyid lha ma yin par| tha mal du/ 'gyur/ / ro// 'di dag gi ni lung sbyor rnams/ /yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas bzhag slob dpon kun dga' snying pos phyag rgya gang dang gang nas byung de dang de nyid du bkrol te ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol lo/ /gzhan du na lha la brnyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par de nyid snang ba la sogs par ltos/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du ni/ /dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin bshad/ /'di yi lung rigs man ngag rnams/ / dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi rung bas bla ma'i zhal las legs par dris/ /gal te bya ba'i rgyud kyi yang*/ / rdzogs chen gyi lugs ltar kun rdzob lha ru gnas par 'dod/ na ni/ / rang re'i lha ci'ang mi za ba la sogs pa'i dka' thub 'thor 'thung la sogs pa'i/ gtsang sbra ga la 'thad/ /lha la la| gtsang ba/ dang la la/ mi gtsang ba'i lha gnyis/ med/ /lha rnams dka' thub kyis mi gdung*/ kha cig spyod pa'i rgyud kyi yang*/ / kun rdzob rigs lnga la sogs pa lta ba rnal 'byor gyi/ rgyud dang mthun/ /spyod pa bya ba'i rgyud bzhin gtsang sbra 'ba' zhig byed/ / ces zer ba yod de/ 'di yang de ltar nges pa med/

/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ 'di ni gnyis ka'i rgyud yin pas/ / lha ma bsgom pa'i skabs res 'ga' gtsang sbra spyod mod kyi/ /phal cher ci bder spyod par gsungs/ / ngan song sbyong rgyud las rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /thams cad zos te kun byas kyang*/ /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes so/ / spyod pa'i rgyud la rigs lnga yi/ /don grub na yang tha snyad med/ / rnam snang la kun rigami bskyod pa la sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ rin 'byung la rgyal mchog rin chen/ 'od dpag med la shākya thub pa/ don grub la me tog cher rgyas la sogs pa'i tha snyad kyang mi 'dra/ phyag rgya yang rnam snang la ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa mi 'dra/ phyag rgya sku mdog rnam dag kyang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin der ma gsungs/ /des na rnal 'byor rgyud man chad/ / bskyed chog gi thabs kyis lhar bsgom pa ma gtogs pa/ kun rdzob 'di/ lha ru gsungs pa med/ /'on kyang kun rdzob thams cad ni/ / rgyud sde gsum po'i lugs kyis ji ltar snang ba bzhin du bas/ / kyi lhar snang ba ma yin no/ bris sku la sogs lhar bsgom pa/ / de ni bskyed chog gi thabs kyi khyad par gyis lhar 'gyur ba/ yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las/ /kun rdzob ji ltar snang ba 'di/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa/ /de tshe dam pa rigs brgya la | | sogs pa'i dbye ba rgyal bas gsungs/ / 'di'i 'thad pa dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi nyan/ des na kun rdzob ldog pa dang*/ /lta ba'i ldog pa ma phyed pas/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i kun rdzob kun/ /lta ba dang 'khrul ba'i rgyu mtshan/ de ltar yin/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur rnying ma/ ba rnams ni/ / yo ga rnal 'byor mahā yo ga rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ / a nu yo ga ni rjes su rnal 'byor a ti yo ga shin tu ni/ /rnal 'byor zhes bya rnam pa bzhi/

/theg pa'i rim pa yin zhes zer/ /shin tu rnal 'byor bzang bar 'dod/ /gsang sngags phyi 'gyur ba rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ / shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /'di dag ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i/ rim pa/ yin gyi/ /rgyud sde'i bzang ngan gyi/ rim par mi bzhed do/ /des na rgyu sde bzhi po yi/ / nang na yod pa'i/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po 'i rgyud gnyis/ dang | | bye brag tu rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la grags pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi yi rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin/ dang*/ /rnal 'byor chen po 'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis po/ mi gcig go /dper na klu chen pad+ma dang*/ /pad+ma chen po zhes bya dang*/ /me tog pad+ma pad chen gnyis/ /ming mthun na yang don mi gcig snga ma gnyis klu yin| phyi ma gnyis me tog yin/ dpe de bzhin du rnal 'byor snga ma gnyis rgyud sde yin/ phyi ma gnyis ting nge 'dzin yin/ / des na gsang sngags gsar ma la/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ltag na ni/ /de bas lhag pa'i rgyud sde med/ /bsgom pa'i dmigs pa nyid kyang ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin las lhag pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan/ gong na med/ / dmigs pa de dag las skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ / blo'i yul ma yin pas spros pa med cing ngag gi yul ma yin pas/ brjod pa dang*/ bral bas/ / des na shes brjod las 'das pa de/ theg pa'i rim par sangs rgyas/ mi bzhed do/ /lugs 'di legs par shes gyur na/ / rdzogs chen pa'i lugs kyi a ti yo ga'i lta ba yang | khong rang gi lugs la yang ye shes yin gyi theg pa min/ / no/ brjod bral la| brjod byar byas theg pa rim dgu'i nang du bsdud/ pa ni/ /mkhas pa'i dgongs pa min zhes bya/ /des na thos pa'i lta ba ni/ /dbu ma yan chad nas rgyud sde/ thams cad mthun/ /de phyir lta ba'i lung sbyor kun/ /pha rol tu/ phyin pa rgyas 'bring bsdus par gsum gyi lugs/

bzhin du sngags mtshan nyid/ thams cad du mthun par lung du/ mdzad/ / pa yin/ de rtogs pa yi thabs la ni/ / mdo dang rgyud sde las theg pa'i rim pa yod pa yin/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi bsgrub pa yang*/ / phan tshun 'chol cing*/ 'khrul par byas na dngos grub ring*/ / 'o na ma 'khrul ba'i sgrub pa ji ltar byed ce na bya ba'i rgyud la bdag lhar/ bskyed pa/ med/ /bris sku mchod nas gsol ba 'debs/ / don zhags dang rnam rgyal la sogs pa bdag bskyed kyi/ sgrub thabs slob dpon dag gis mdzad pa yod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gyi/ rgyud kyi rjes su/ 'brangs nas/ / bla ma'i man ngag gzhan gyis/ / de yi lugs bzhin mdzad pa yin | | des na 'di la rtog pa'i lugs dang sgrub thabs kyi lugs gnyis cho ga mi 'dra/ sgrub thabs kyi lugs de ltar byed na smyung gnas med/ /bdag nyid lha ru bskyed pa la | | mchod na bsod nams brnyas na sdig /gal te bya ba'i rgyud la/ smyung gnas byed 'dod na/ /rang nyid lhar ma bsgoms par/ tha mal gyi/ nga rgyal gyis// bris sku gzhung nas 'byung ba'i/ cho ga bzhin bris la/ /rje dpon la 'bangs kyis zhu ba| bzhin du dngos grub blang*/ /de la sha chang gi gtor ma med/ / don zhags las| khrag med pa'i gtor ma sha dang bcas pa zhes gsungs pas de 'gyur nyes pa yin/ rgya dpe dang bstun na gtor ma sha khrag med pa bya ba yod/ gla rtsi la sogs srog chags dang*// 'brel ba'i mchod pa thams cad spongs/ / gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ srog chags yan lag rnams spangs pa//zhes gsungs so// gu lang mchod pa'i lhag ma dang*/ /gtor ma'i kha zas 'dir mi za/ /lha la phul ba'i dman ma sogs/ /za dang 'gom pa gnyis kha bkag / dpung pa bzang po las/ gu lang mchod pa'i lhag ma mi bza' zhing*/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs la/ legs par grub pa la sogs pa kri ya'i rgyud thams cad las kyang bkag dkar gsum la sogs kha zas dang*/ /gtsang sbra la sogs brtul zhugs kyis/

/bya ba'i rgyud kyi gsang sngags grub/ /spyod pa'i rgyud| dang rnal 'byor gyi/ rgyud gnyis su/ /las tshogs bsgrub pa 'ga' zhig la | | gtsang sbra dka' thub bshad pa yod/ /gzhan du dka' thub smyung gnas sogs/ /brtul zhugs khyad par gtsor mi mdzad/ /rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom/ /gla rtsi'i ring bu la sogs pa/ /srog chags yan lag las byung ba'i/ /mchod pa rnams kyang 'dir mi 'gog /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i lhag ma rnams/ /sdig pa spang phyir bza' 'o zhes/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las gnang*/ /'byung po'i gtor ma rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ 'dir mi za/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rnams las/ / rtogs pa skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pas a ba dhū tī'i spyod sogs la/ /'byung po'i gtor ma za ba'ang gnang*/ / dka' thub la sogs brtul zhugs 'gog /'jug pa bde ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsang sngags rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub/ /'di dag rgyas par bla ma mchog dbang thob/ dam tshig bsrung*/ rgyud shes/ man ngag dang ldan pa'i/ / mkhas pa'i gsungs las shes par gyis/ / 'dir dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi nyan| mu stegs pa dang sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha'i rnam dbye mi shes shing*/ /rgyud sde'i bzhi'i dbang dang lam bzhi'i/ khyad par ma phyed par/ /cho ga thams cad dkrugs nas ni/ / lung rigs med par bla ma'i bka' srol yin zer nas rang bzo'i rnam thar spyod pa mtshar/ / gsang sngags kyi lam dngos nyams su len pa'i rim pa rang ji ltar yin zhe na dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /dang por rang gi khyim du bsgom | | brtan pa thob nas dur khrod chu'i 'gram/ ri khrod/ sogs/ /brtan pa chen po thob nas ni/ /lus dang ngag gi brda rnams la/ /legs par sbyangs shing de nyid rtogs/ /sa bcu gsum/ rnams bgrod par bya ba dang*/ / yul sum cu so bdun dang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun/ rnams dbang du bsdu pa'i phyir/

/gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs/ /yul chen sum cu so bdun du/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod phyir rgyu/ /lugs 'di rnal 'byor chen po yi/ / dges rdor bde mchog sogs rgyud dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pa shes nas ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs sangs rgya/ / 'di dag dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi rung bas/ bla ma gsang sngags legs par mkhyen pa la dris/ deng sang bod 'di na/ gsang sngags mi shes par/ / sngags kyi lugs su 'chos pa lag len phyin ci log mthong*/ / dbang ma thob cing rim pa gnyis po mi bsgom na/ /yul chen sum cu so bdun du/ /'gro ba rgyud sde las/ sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs/ / phar phyin dang nyan thos la yul chen dgos pa med/ / rim pa gnyis po mi bsgom pa'i/ / gtum mo dang phyag rgya chen po lta bu'i sgom chen bzang yang pha rol tu/ /phyin pa'i sgom chen las ma 'das/ / mdo las yul chen de dag tu/ /'gro ba'i cho ga bshad pa med/ /gal te gsang sngags kyi dbang ma thob/ rim pa gnyis/ mi bsgom zhing*/ /rtogs pa yod par rlom pa yis/ /yul der phyin na sgom chen de la/ bar chad 'byung*/ /ci yang med pa'i sgom chen gyis/ /phyin yang phan pa'i dngos grub/ gnod pa'i bar chad| gang yang med/ /u rgyan dzā lan+dha ra dang*/ /gangs can de bī ko ṭa sogs | | kla klo blun po mu stegs byed/ /'brog pa rnams kyis yul chen po de dag gang nas yod mod kyang*/ /de dag grub pa thob bam ci/ / 'o na gnas chen de dag tu 'gro ba'i gang zag gang yin zhe na/ dbang thob nas gsang sngags kyi rim pa gnyis/ bsgom pa'i rtogs pa can/ / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar go bar byed pa'i brda don 'phrod pa'i skal bar ldan/ /de la yul der gnas pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis rlob/ /'di don rnal 'byor chen po yi/ / rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud sde rnams su legs par ltos/

/des na gsang sngags mi bsgom par/ /yul chen bgrod pa don med yin/ / chos rje shākya shrī la/ sgom chen gcig na re/ ti se dang tsā ri yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i phyogs re lags sam ma lags zer bas/ chos rje'i zhal nas khyod gsang sngags bsgom mam mi bsgom gsungs/ kho na re/ gsang sngags mi bsgom phyag rgya chen po bsgom zer bas/ gsang sngags mi bsgom na yul nyi shu rtsa bzhis ci byed/ phar phyin dang nyan thos kyi gzhung las yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi bshad pa med/ khyed bod kyi chos pa 'di 'dra 'di'i rigs can la nor ba gzhan yang mang po 'ong gsungs nas bod la gting khrel te chos rje med do// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mngon pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa yi/ /gangs ri gser gyi bya skyibs dang*/ /'dzam bu'i shing dang glang po che/ sa srung gi bu/ /glang chen lnga brgyas bskor ba dang*/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gangs can de ni ti se min/ /ma dros rgya mtsho ma phang min/ /glang po rnams kyang de na med/ /de bzhin 'dzam bu'i ljon pa dang*/ /gser gyi bya skyibs ga la yod/ /de yi gtan tshigs 'di ltar yin/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /chu bo si tā'i byang phyogs na/ /ri bo gangs can yod par gsungs/ /de yi 'gram na sham+bhal/ /grong khyer bye ba dgu bcu drug

/de na rgyal po'i pho brang mchog / kā la pa zhes bya ba yod/ /de na sprul pa'i rgyal po rnams/ /lo grangs brgya brgyar chos gsung ngo*/ /de na nags tshal sna tshogs dang*/ /bza' shing ra ba du ma yod/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'phag pa'i yul/ /kla klo'i chos kyis gang bar 'gyur/ /de na kla klo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /sham+bha la ru dmag 'dren 'gyur | | de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal pos kla klo kun bcom nas/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi bar du bod dang rgya gar tshun chad/ yang | | sangs rgyas bstan pa spel bar gsungs/ de'i don rgyas pa dus 'khor du ltos| des na ri bo gangs can du/ /rdzu 'phrul med pas 'gro mi nus/ / mngon pa mdzod/ las kyang 'di skad du/ / ma ga dha'i yul 'di nas byang du ri nag po | | ri gangs thar thor chags pa'i ri'i rgyud ring po ste/ mdzod kyi 'grel pa las/ 'di na ni ri nag po gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs pas bod dang rgya gar gyi bar na stod mnga' ris nas rgya nag gi bar ma chad pa'i ri rgyud gnyis/ bod dang hor gyi bar na chags pa'i gangs rgyud de ltar gsum dang*| chu bo si ta'i byang na ri rgyud drug ste/ dgu 'das pa na nag nog med pa/ gangs 'ba' zhig tu song ba'i/ ri'o de nas ni/ / ri bo spos ngad ldan pa'i tshul rol na/ / ma dros pa chu zheng lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho/ /zhes sogs mtshan nyid rgyas par gsungs | | der ni rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mi ldan pas/ /bgrod par bya ba min zhes mdzod 'grel las/ bshad/ /da lta'i ti se 'di la ni/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag gang yang med/ /mu stegs byed pa'i gzhung gzhon nu 'byung ba'i snyan ngag las kyang*/ /shar nub gnyis kyi rgya mtsho'i bar/ /gangs can gyis ni khyab par bshad/ / spre'u ha nu man+thas lang ka'i yul nas/ 'phangs pa yi/ /gangs ri'i dum bu lam du/ 'tshar ba zhig /ti se yin zhes drang srong*/ grog mkhar smra/ 'di'i gtam rgyud rgyas pa dga' byed kyi 'jug pa na yod/

/des na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas | | sa srung bu yis brten pa'i sa/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs pa'i yul/ /da lta'i ti se 'di ma yin/ /rma bya chen mo'i mdo las kyang*/ / gangs can ti se tha dad gsungs/ / gzungs gra lnga'i rma bya chen mo las kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang*/ ri'i rgyal po gangs can dang*/ ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldan dang*/ zhes bya ba mang po'i gsham na/ ri'i rgyal po ti se dang*/ zhes de gnyis tha dad du gsungs so/ / phal po che yi mdo las kyang*/ /ma dros pa yi chu zheng du/ /dpag tshad lnga bcu lnga bcur gsungs/ /sa gzhir rin chen gseg ma bdal/ /ngos ni rin chen pha gur brtsigs/ /de las 'bab pa'i chu bo bzhi/ /gaṅgā glang chen gyi/ kha nas ni/ /dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing 'bab || de bzhin du si tā seng ge'i kha nas ni/ / lha rdzas kyi rdo rje'i bye ma 'dren cing 'bab/ /sin+dhu glang gi kha nas ni/ /gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing 'bab// la la sin+dhu rma bya'i kha nas 'bab zer ba yod na'ang de ni nor ba yin gyi rma bya'i kha nas 'bab par bshad pa med/ pak+ṣu rta yi kha nas ni/ /baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i bye ma/ 'dren cing 'bab/ / thams cad kyi ni kha zheng la/ /dpag tshad re re yod par gsungs/ /chu bo de bzhis ma dros la/ /lan grangs bdun bdun g.yas phyogs nas/ bskor nas | | phyogs bzhi dag tu rgya mtsho chen po la/ 'bab par bshad/ /de yi bar mtshams thams cad ni/ /ut+pal pad+ma ku mu ta dang*/ puṇ+ḍa ri ka la sogs kyi/ / me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rin chen ljon shing sna tshogs kyis/ /rab tu gang bar gnas pa yin/ /de sogs mtshan nyid rgyas par ni/ /phal po che yi mdo sder drug dum pa'i ga par/ ltos/ /da lta'i ma phang 'di la ni/ /mtshan nyid de dag gang yang med/ /de la kha cig 'di skad du/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri la yang*/ /dkon brtsegs nas bshad pa/ bzhin du

mtho ba zlum pa la sogs/ da lta med/ /dus kyi stobs kyis yul kun yang*/ /rnam pa 'gyur bar snang zhes zer/ /'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa dang*/ /skyon yon bsngags pa rnam gnyis yod/ /skyon dang yon tan sgrogs pa na/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyi lugs bzhin du/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri la yang*/ /mtho ba zlum pa la sogs bshad/ /bod kyi yul dog pas rgyang grags re la'ang*/ thang chen po yin zer ba/ ji bzhin du/ / ma ga dha na ri gzhan med pas bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'phags pa'i yul gyi ri chen yin/ / rgya gar ri phul chung*/ bod thang phul chung*/ de ltar 'chad la snyan ngag mkhan/ /skyon du brtsi ba gang yang med/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa ste mtshan nyid gtan la 'beb pa'i tshe| na/ /lhag chad 'khrul pa byung ba la/ /de la mkhas rnams skyon du brtsi | | dper na ba lang bsngags pa'i tshe/ /gangs ri'i phung po 'gro shes pa'am | | sprin chad pa yi dum bu dang*/ /rwa rtse rdo rje 'dra ba dang*/ /rmig pa in+d+ra nī la dang*/ /rnga ma dpag bsam ljon pa sogs/ /gzhan yang skyes bu bsngags pa na/ /bzhin la nyi ma zla ba dang*/ /so la gangs ri'i phreng ba sogs | | rgya che ba la nam mkha'i dpe/ /chung la rdul phran dpe sbyor dang*// rags pa'i dpe la ri rab dang*/ /byi ba la ni glang chen dpe/ /phyug po la ni rnam thos bu/ /rgyal phran la yang brgya byin dpe/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal pa la'ang*/ /sangs rgyas lta bur bsngags pa sgro btags pa 'di lta bu'i dpe rgyan/ ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan la snyan ngag gi bstan 'chos las/ bkag pa med | | dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa'am/ /mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa na/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin ma yin pa/ / rta'i mtshan nyid nog lkog shal dang*/ me bsil ba/ chu tsha ba lta bu phyin ci log tu bshad na mkhas rnams ga la dga' | | des na bya rgod phung po sogs/ /bsngags pa snyan ngag lugs bzhin yin/

/gangs can ma dros la sogs pa/ /dngos pa'i gnas lugs 'chad pa na/ /de la 'khrul na kun mkhyen min/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi shugs brtas pas/ /cung zad ngan par 'gro srid kyi/ / chos mngon pa nas bshad pa'i ma dros pa dang*/ spos ngad ldan pa dang*/ shing 'dzam bu dang*/ me tog pad+ma la sogs thams cad 'khrul par ga la srid/ /tsā ri tra zhes bya ba'i yul/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yod/ / la la tsā ri tra tsā ri tsā gong yin zer ba yod de/ de ma yin | | de bī ko ṭa gnyis yod pa'i che shos rgya gar shar phyogs na yod de/ 'i gnas gzhan chung ba/ zhig /tsā ri yin zhes la la smra/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las ni/ /de bī ko ṭar bha tra gnas/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las || bod yul lhan cig skyes ma ni/ /rdo ba'i phug la brten te gnas// yul der gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ /bha tra'i shing la brten zhes gsungs*/ / de yi phyogs na bha tra'i shing*/ /yod na yul de 'gal ba med/ /ti se dang ni tsā ri sogs/ /gal te rgyud nas bshad pa'i/ gnas chen yin na yang*/ /yul der 'gro ba'i gang zag ni/ / sngar bshad par ltar dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig dang*/ ldan/ /brda dang brda yi lan shes shing*/ /rim gnyis rtogs pa brtan pa yis/ / gsang sngags nas bshad pa'i/ spyod pa'i don du rgyu bar gsungs// de lta min pa'i gang zag dbang bskur ma thob/ dam tshig mi ldan/ rim gnyis mi bsgom/ brda dang brda'i lan mi shes pa dag gis/ /yul der 'gro ba rgyud las bkag ste dper na gter gyi kha byang dang gting byang med par gter 'don pa na nor mi thob/ thob kyang bar chad 'byung ba ltar yul chen por 'gro bar bkag kha cig dkar po chig thub las/ / 'bras bu sku gsung 'byung zhes zer//gcig las 'bras bu 'byung mi nus// gal te gcig las 'bras bu zhig /byung yang nyan thos 'gog pa bzhin// 'bras bu de yang phan gnod med pa'i stong pa nyid/

gcig tu 'gyur/ /'ga' zhig chig thub bsgoms pa yi/ /rjes la gzhan don 'ong ba'i thabs su/ bsngo ba bya dgos zer/ /'o na chig thub gnyis su 'gyur/ /de la'ang stong nyid rkyang pa la nam mkha' ltar bsngo rgyu'i dge ba med pas bsngo rgyu'i dge bar 'gro ba/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ /yi dam lha bsgom la sogs pa/ /dgos pas de rnams byed/ na chig thub du mar 'gyur/ / mi byed na dge ba ma byas pa la bsngo rgyu'ang med/ gyur cig rkyang pas ci la'ang mi phan des na chig thub 'di 'dra'i lugs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mdo rgyud las/ gsungs pa med/ /thub pas stong nyid la/ bsngags pa mdzad pa ni/ /dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog pa dang stong pa nyid la skrag pa la de'i che ba dbyung ba'i| phyir yin/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal brjod tsam gyis/ /'khor ba las ni thar zhes 'bum la sogs pa'i mdo las/ gsungs/ /de bzhin mchod rten bskor ba dang*/ /rten 'brel tsam zhig thos sogs dang*/ / a la sogs pa'i sngags 'bru 'ga' zhig dran tsam gyis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhes || mdo rgyud 'ga' zhig las/ gsungs pa'i dgongs pa mi shes par/ /tshig 'bru tsam la brten nas zab cing rgya che ba'i chos gzhan spang bar/ mi bya// dper na mda' rkyang la ni byed pa med//gzhu bzang zhing skyes bu/ 'phen pa mkhas par/ gyur na// de yis 'dod pa'i bya ba dgra gsod pa la sogs pa/ 'grub/ /de bzhin stong nyid rkyang pa la/ /byed pa ci yang yod ma yin/ /thabs dang shes rab legs 'brel na/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu rim bzhin thob/ / rgyud rdo rje gur las 'di skad gsungs/ /gal te stong pa thabs yin na/ /de tshe sangs rgyas kyang stong pa/ nyid du 'gyur gyi sku gsum/ mi 'byung*/ / de'i 'thad pa 'bras bu rgyu las gzhan min te rgyu 'bras mtshungs dgos pa'i/ phyir/ / sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i thabs ni stong pa nyid ma yin/ / 'o na stong pa nyid bsgom par gsungs pa'i 'thad pa gang yin zhe na/

mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba rnam las bzlog pa dang*/ / mu stegs byed bdag tu lta ba tshol rnams kyi/ /bdag tu/ zhen pa'i/ bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ / stong pas sangs mi rgya/ sangs rgya ba la thabs lam zab dgos| dper na bkru sman gyis nad 'byin gyi lus brtas pa la bza' btung dgos pa bzhin no// 'o na gsang sngags kyi thabs gang gis 'tshang rgya zhe na/ de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa bskyed rim bya/ zhes/ /thabs bsgoms pa las/ ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ / sangs rgyas nga rgyal te bskyed rim gzugs sku'i nga rgyal/ rdzogs rim chos sku'i nga rgyal gyi/ rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /de sogs shin tu gsal bar gsungs/ / rgyud sde rnams su ltos/ rnam snang mngon byang las kyang ni/ /thabs dang mi ldan pa'i/ ye shes stong pa nyid/ dag / de dang 'brel ba'i bslab pa dag kyang gsungs pa ni/ /dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos thabs zab mo la skrag pa/ rnams/ /de la gzhug pa'i phyir gsungs so/ /gang dag dus gsum gyi/ mgon po sangs rgyas/ rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la/ / bslabs nas bla med theg pa ni/ /'dus ma byas pa sangs rgyas/ des thob bo// zhes gsungs pa yang shes par gyis/ /chos kyi grags pas rnam 'grel las | | rnam pa du mar thabs mang po/ /yun ring dus su goms pa las// de la thabs bsgom pa'i stobs kyis/ skyon dang yon tan dag / bzo yi gnas goms pa ltar rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur//des na thabs goms pa'i stobs kyis/ thugs kyang shin tu/ gsal ba'i phyir/ / sgrib pa gnyis kyi rgyu yi bag chags legs par/ spangs pa yin/ /thub chen gzhan don 'jug can gyi/ / sangs rgyas de/ bse ru sogs rang sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom pa gnyis/ las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu thabs lam/ de yin/ /de don phy-ir na thabs goms pa/ /de nyid gzhan la/ ston pa 'i sangs rgyas/

yin par bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa yang de nyid yin/ / des na thabs la ma sbyangs na/ /shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ / gzhan don mdzad pa sems ngo 'phrod pa'ang*/ mi srid do/ / za 'og la sogs pa'i thags kyi rgyu rnams phal cher mthun/ /spun gyi dbye bas ri mo/ bzang ngan 'byung | | de bzhin du 'khor ba las grol ba'i rgyu/ stong nyid phal cher mthun/ / 'bras bu'i bzang ngan thabs bzang ngan/ kyis byed/ / thabs mi mkhas pa'i stong nyid lta bas mya ngan 'da'/ /thabs la mkhas pas stong nyid rtogs/ na rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /des na sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /thabs mkhas pa la nan tan gyis/ /dgra bcom pa dang rang sangs rgyas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam pa gsum/ / 'khor ba las rnam par grol bar mtshungs na yang*/ /bzang ngan thabs bzang ngan/ kyis phye ba yin/ /de yang mdo sde rgyan las ni/ /ji ltar mdud pa'i bye brag gis/ /gos btsos par mnyam pa/ la tshon bkra mi bkra ba || de bzhin du thabs kyi/ 'phen pa'i bzang ngan gyi/ dbang gis ni/ / 'khor ba las grol ba mnyam yang mkhyen pa 'i ye shes bkra mi bkra 'byung*/ / de skad gsungs pa'ang don 'di yin/ /slob dpon ma ti tsi tras bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ kyang || bse ru'i rwa dang 'dra gang dang*/ /gang yang khyod kyi rjes 'gro slob// ma dgra bcom pa/stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi ba tsam gyis khyod dang mtshungs/ / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs bsam yas yon tan tshogs kyis mtshungs pa/ mi/ /zhes gsungs pa yang don 'di yin/ /des na sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ / stong pa nyid la 'dris par gyis/ /thabs mkhas pa la 'bad pas sgoms// stong nyid la ni 'dris bya yi/ /stong nyid mngon du ma byed ces/ /shes rab pha rol phyin las gsungs/ / rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ka las/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'dris par bya yi stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon sum du mi bya zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so//

stong nyid rkyang pa bsgoms na ni/ /stong nyid nyid kyang rtogs mi nus/ /gal te stong nyid rtogs na yang*/ /nyan thos kyi ni 'gog par ltung*/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ /seng ge gang la'ang mi 'jigs mod/ /me chen mthong na 'jigs pa skye/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yang*/ /chos gzhan gang la'ang mi 'jigs kyang*/ /stong pa nyid la skrag ces gsungs/ /de yi dgongs pa 'di ltar yin/ /thabs dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyis/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gyur phyir ro/ /la la stong nyid bsgoms pa las/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'dod pa dang*/ /la la zung 'jug bsgoms pa las/ /'bras bu 'od gsal du sangs rgyas zhes/ 'dod pa yod/ /rgyu 'bras phyin ci log pa'i phyir/ /gnyi ga yang ni skyon can yin/ kha cig sa lam mi bgrod par/ /rjogs 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa phyag rgya chen po chig chod la sa lam mi dgos zhes zer ba/ dang*//ti se la sogs bskor ba dang*/
