/ rtsa mdud med sogs 'dod pa yang*//rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ma shes pas/ / de dag shin tu 'gal ba yin/ / rgyu mtshan dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi nyan/ phyi ru yul rnams bgrod pa dang*/ /nang du rtsa mdud grol ba ni/ /sa bcu la sogs bgrod pa yi/ /rten 'brel nyid kyis 'byung ba yin/ /'di don rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud kyi sa lam skabs su ltos/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la bshad du mi nyan/ / des na sa lam mi bgrod pa'i/ /yul sogs bgrod pa bzhad gad gnas/ /la la gsang sngags kyi/ dbang bzhi mi 'dod cing*/ / bskyed rim rang byin rlabs/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ phyag rgya chen po/ la sogs lam bzhi po'i/ /rnam par bzhag pa mi 'dod par/ /rdo rje theg pa'i 'bras bu ni | | sprul sku la sogs longs sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid sku/ sku bzhi zhes/ /'dod pa de yang log shes yin/ / te dbang bzhi thob/ lam bzhi bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu sku bzhi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ kha cig 'bras bu'i mthar thug ni/ / sems 'od gsal du sangs rgya ba/ yin zhes smra ba thos//'di ni 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras 'i dgongs pa min/ /rim lnga dang ni spyod bsdus su/ /'od gsal ba las zung 'jug skur | | ldang ba mthar thug yin par gsungs/ / rim lnga las/ 'od gsal nyid la dmigs nas ni/ /zung du 'jug pa thob par 'gyur/ /zung 'jug rim pa la gnas nas/ /slar zhing gang du'ang mi slob bo/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ spyod bsdus su/ 'od gsal ba las zung 'jug tu ldang ba'i tshul rgyas par gsungs so/ / la la grub thob ngan zhes zer/ /rtogs ldan bzang ba yin no lo/ /grub thob brgyad cu'i nang na yang*/ /rtogs ldan med ces zer ba thos/ /'di 'dra 'phags pa'i gang zag dang*/ /bla ma rnams la skur 'debs yin/ /'di 'dra 'dzin pa lta ci smos/ /thos par gyur kyang rna ba dgab/ /de yi 'thad pa bshad kyis nyon/ /grub thob chung ngu mthong lam yin/

/grub thob 'bring po sa brgyad pa/ /grub thob chen po sangs rgyas sa/ /'phags pa min la grub thob med/ /mdo sde rgyan las 'di skad gsungs/ /grub pa dag dang ma grub dang*/ /grub pa dag tu shes par bya/ /ma grub pa yang grub pa dang*/ /grub pa dag tu yang dag 'dod/ / ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni dag pa'i sa la ltos nas sa dang po'ang ma grub pa/ 'jig rten pa'i sa la ltos nas/ sa dang po'ang grub pa'i sa/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la ltos nas sa brgyad pa'ang ma grub pa/ ma dag pa'i sa bdun pa man chad la ltos nas/ sa brgyad pa'ang grub pa/ grub pa mthar thug pa sangs rgyas kyi sa yin no// dgaungs pa de nyid yin/ /rnal 'byor gyi/ dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa/ yis/ /lam 'bras las kyang de skad gsungs/ / nged kyi grub thob de 'dra yin/ /rtogs ldan gyi/ mtshan nyid 'di yin no// zhes | | mdo rgyud kun las gsungs pa med/ /des na rtogs ldan zhes bya ba'i ming 'di chos ma thos pa'i/ blun po la/ /grags kyi mkhas pa sde snod shes pa/ rnams la min/ /la la nyams dang go ba dang*/ /rtogs pa zhes bya rnam pa gsum | | nyams ni ngan la go ba 'bring*/ /rtogs pa bzang ba yin zhes zer | | 'di yang re zhig brtag par bya/ /nyams zhes bya ba nyams myong la | | zer na sems yod thams cad la/ /myong ba de yang yod pa yin/ / gal te bsgoms pa'i nyams myong la/ /zer na tshogs lam chung ngu nas/ / mthar phyin lam gyi bar du yod/ /'on te so so rang rig pa'i/ /ye shes yin na 'phags pa yi/ /gang zag rnams la nyams de yod/ / bodha go ba dang ni ga ti rtogs pa gnyis/ /rnam grangs sgra yin ngo bo gcig /rgya skad gcig la lo tsā ba'i/ /'gyur gyi dbye ba kho nar zad/ / de/ lo tsā ba la las de gnyis ka go bar bsgyur/ res rtogs par bsgyur/ res skabs ji ltar bde bar bsgyur/ res 'ga' so sor bsgyur/ rtogs pa gsal dang mi gsal la/ /go dang rtogs par 'dogs na thogs/

/gzhung lugs 'ga' las bsgoms pa yin/ /ting 'dzin nyams kyi snang ba ste/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la/ /dag pa'i snang bar bshad pa yod/ /bsgoms nyams skyon med ces bya ba/ / sangs rgyas kyi/ sa la gsang sngags kyi gzhung 'ga' zhig las/ bshad pa'ang mthong*// de 'dra'i nyams dang rtogs pa la/ /bzang ngan rnam par dbye ba med/ / kong ni ru pa'i gdams ngag khas len pa kha cig rtse gcig dang ni spros bral dang*/ /ro gcig dang ni bsgom med bzhi/ /rtse gcig mthong lam spros bral ni/ /sa bdun bar yin ro gcig ni/ /dag pa'i sa gsum bsgom med ni/ / sangs rgyas sa zhes la la zer/ / yang lam la sbyar na/ rtse gcig tshogs sbyor gnyis/ spros bral mthong lam/ ro gcig sgom lam/ sgom med mthar phyin pa'i lam zer/ 'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon/ /so so'i skye bo nyid yin yang*/ /gal te chos mthun tsam brtsi'am/ /'on te 'phags pa nyid yin pa'i/ /bden pa'i sa lam dngos su byed/ /so so'i skye bo'i gang zag la/ /chos mthun tsam zhig sgrig na ni/ /chos nas gsungs na 'gal ba med/ /dper na dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i| rmi lam nges par/ bstan pa'i mdo/ las/ /thub pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las | | byas pa mthong na sa dang po/ /rdo las byas mthong sa gnyis pa/ / rdo thal gyis byugs sa gsum pa/ /stegs bu gdugs byas sa bzhi pa/ / rdo skas byi dor byas sa lnga/ /gser gyis sbrel mthong sa drug pa/ /rin chen drwa bas g.yogs pa bdun/ /g.yer kha'i drwa bas g.yogs pa mthong na sa| brgyad / / par blta'o// sa dgu dang ni bcu pa la/ /rmi lam logs pa mthong med gsung*/ /de la/ sogs/ pa/ rmi lam gyi/ bye brag mang po/ la/ /sa bcu'i dbye ba mdzad pa mthong*/ /'di ni mos pas spyod pa so so skye bo/ yi/ /sa bcu yin gyi 'phags pa'i sa bcu/ min//de bzhin rtse gcig la sogs spros bral/ la'ang// gal te mdo dang rgyud sde las/ /mos pa spyod pa'i sa lam du/

/gsungs pa mthong na mi 'gal mod/ /'on kyang mdo rgyud khungs ma gang nas kyang*/ 'di 'dra bshad pa med/ /ci ste rtse gcig la sogs pa/ 'phags pa'i sar byed na/ /mdo rgyud kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ kha cig theg pa rang sa na/ /bden pa yin zhes kun la sgrogs/ /'di yang brtag par bya bas nyon/ /gal te smras tshad bden na ni/ /brdzun tshig shes bya la mi srid/ /'on te grub mtha' kun bden na/ /'tshe ba chos su smra ba srog gcod pas mtho ris su skye bar 'dod pa/ dang*/ /'jig rgyang 'phen pa/ rten pha rol med pa la/ sogs pa/ / lta log thams cad bden par 'gyur/ /gal te mu stegs mchog rnams la/ /rtag pa'i dngos po la sogs pa/ /brdzun pa'ang du ma yod mod kyang*/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa byams snying rje/ sogs/ /bden pa'ang du ma yod pa'i phyir/ /bden pa'i cha nas grub mtha' kun/ /rang sa na ni bden snyam na/ /sbyin sogs bden pa'i dngos po/ phal cher bden mod kyang*/ /skyabs gnas dang ni lta ba dang*/ /thabs kyi gnad rnams 'khrul pas na/ /chos gzhan bzang yang zas bzang yang dug yod na 'chi ba bzhin/ skyob mi nus/ /ci ste sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ theg pa kun/ /rang sa na ni bden snyam na/ / 'di yang cung zad brtag par bya/ /sangs rgyas gsung la drang don dang*/ / nges don rnam pa gnyis su yod/ /sgra yang ji bzhin pa dang ni/ /ji bzhin min pa gnyis su gsungs/ /theg pa yang ni 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa gnyis su gnas/ /bshad pa yang ni dgongs pa bzhi/ dang*/ ldem por dgongs pa bzhi/ dang drang po ru/ /dgongs pa zhes bya rnam gsum yod || de la 'jig rten mthun 'jug la/ /dgongs nas phyi rol gyi rdul phran/ don du gsungs/ / te//rnam 'grel las/ des de nyid don btang snyoms can/ /glang chen gzigs stangs nyid mdzad nas/ 'jig rten thugs ni 'ba' zhig gis/ /phyi rol dpyod la 'jug par mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/

/ tha snyad dpyod pa'i rigs pa la/ /dgongs nas chos rnams sems su gsungs/ /dam pa'i don la dgongs nas ni/ /chos kun spros pa bral zhes gsungs/ /des na drang ba'i don dang ni/ /ji bzhin min pa'i sgra dag dang*/ /dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs dang*/ / 'jig rten pa yi theg pa la/ /dgongs te gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud kun/ / de ltar bden par mi bzung ngo*/ / mdo sde rgyan las/ don sgra ji bzhin yongs bzung na// bdag nyid snyems shing blo nyams 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ / nges pa'i don dang ji bzhin sgra/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i theg pa dang*/ /drang por dgongs pa rnams la ni/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin drang por/ bden par gzung*/ /gal te mu stegs byed la yang*/ /byams dang snying rje sbyin la sogs/ /bden pa'i chos kyang mang po snang*/ /sangs rgyas gsung la'ang drang don dang*/ / dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs sogs/ /bden pa min pa'ang gsungs pas na/ /bden brdzun gnyis ka mtshungs pa la/ /sangs rgyas gsung len mu stegs byed/ /spong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ /sangs rgyas drang don gyis khrid nas/ /bden pa nyid la sbyor bar mdzad/ /mu stegs bden pas khrid nas ni/ /brdzun pa nyid la sbyor bar byed/ /des na bdag cag sangs rgyas la/ /gus pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /de bzhin du/ gangs can bod/ 'di na yang*/ / lus ngag chos dang bstun pa lta bu'i rnam thar bzang po bstan nas ni/ / sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang gang mi mthun nam snyam pa log pa'i chos la sbyor mthong nas/ /mu stegs byedakyi/ chos bzhin du nor ba de dag kyang*/ nged kyis spangs/ /theg pa sna tshogs tshul bstan nas/ /gnad rnams sangs rgyas gsung bzhin du/ /yang dag ston mdzad bla ma de/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gis bzung*/ /chos gzhan sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa mngon mtshan can rags pa/ legs par ston na yang*/ / bsam gtan dang shes rab la sogs pa zab pa mngon mtshan chung ba phra ba'i

chos kyi gnad rnams bcos pa ni/ kha zas bzang po la dug btab pa bzhin shin tu 'jigs pa chen por blta/ /de 'dra ba las skyon byung ba/ mang*/ / de'i dpe 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ / srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu zhes bya bas/ /'bad pas dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs/ / lo grangs sa ya bcu gnyis dang*/ /phyed kyis lhag pa'i tshe/ dngos grub byin/ khyab 'jug phrag dog gis gzir nas/ /mgrin bcu la ni 'di skad smras/ khyod kyi 'bad pa che mod kyi/ /dbang phyug gi ni dngos grub chung*/ /da dung sngar gyi tshe tshad/ ma yin pa/ /sa ya phrag phyed thub pa slongs/ zhes smras pas/ / mgrin bcus tshig de la/ bden par bsams nas ni/ /dbang phyug la ni don de zhus/ /dbang phyug chen pos de byin pas/ /gnad sngar gyis ma yin pa zhes bcos pa yi tshig de yis/ /sngar gyi dngos grub thams cad yal/ / nas sa ya phrag phyed las ma thub/ 'di'i gtam rgyud dga' byed kyi 'jug pa na yod/ lha ma yin gser can gyi ni dngos grub kyang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis nyams zhes thos/ / gser can gyis dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs nas sa dang*/ nam mkha'/ phyi/ nang*/ mi dang*/ mi ma yin pas mi gsod pa'i dngos grub byin/ des khyab 'jug gis lus mi/ mgo seng ge sder mo lcags su byas te/ them pa'i steng du phang par bsad/ dngos grub kyi gnas bcos pa de 'dra'i rigs yin| oṃ med pa yi gsang sngags la/ /g.yon can gyis ni oṃ bcug pas/ / sngags kyi nus pa nyams pa mthong*/ /de bzhin swā hā hūm̐ phaṭa gug 'greng*/ sogs || yod pa rnams la phri ba dang*/ /med pa rnams la bsnan pa dang*// gzhan yang sngags kyi gnas rnams la/ /g.yon can rnams kyis yi ge ka dgos pa la gar/ bcos pa yis/ /gsang sngags dag gi nus pa rnams/ / nyams shing 'gyangs pa ser ba khu 'phangs su 'gro ba dang*/ char pa than par 'gro ba dang*/ mthu zhag bdun pa lo bdun par 'gro ba la sogs pa/

mang po mthong*/ des na gsang sngags la ye ge btu ba dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ / de bzhin chos kyi gnad rnams kyang | | cung zad cung zad bcos pa las/ /dngos grub nyams par 'gyur bar gsungs//de phyir rags pa'i/ chos byams snying rje sbyin pa tshul khrims sogs/ gzhan legs na yang*/ / zab cing phra ba'i gnad rnams bcos na sngar gyi chos gzhan legs pa| thams cad 'jig/des na chos kyi gnad ji ltar zhe na/ nyan thos kyi/ theg pa la// tshul khrims kyi gnad sdom pa dang ni lta ba'i skabs su/ bden bzhi'i gnad/ /bcos na nyan thos kyi/ chos gzhan/ kun bzang yang*/ 'jig /theg pa che la sdom pa'i gnad| sems bskyed dang*/ /de yi bslab bya'i gnad lta spyod/ bcos na/ /theg pa chen po'i chos gzhan/ kun bzang yang*/ 'jig /gsang sngags la ni sdom pa'i gnad| dbang bskur dang*/ / sgom pa'i gnad rim pa gnyis kyi gnas bcos na// gsang sngags kyi ni chos gzhan/ kun bzang yang*/ 'jig /des na da lta'i chos 'ga' la/ /gnad kyi gnas rnams bcos pa ru/ /dogs pa'i chos lugs 'ga' zhig yod/ /de yang mdo tsam bshad kyis nyon/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa rigs brgyad/ ni/ /byang chub ma thob/ bar du blang dgos zer ba yod de de ltar/ blangs par/ gyur na/ /so sor thar pa ci nas kyang*/ 'jig /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la/ / bya bar gsungs pa'i dbu ma'i lugs bzhin mi byed par/ / bya bar ma gsungs pa'i sems tsam pa yi cho ga ni/ /skye bo kun la byed pa mthong*/ /'di yi cho ga nges par 'jig / cho ga las 'das na las mi 'chags pa'i phyir/ 'di yang gnas rnams bcos par mthong*/ /sems bskyed kyi ni bslab bya'i mchog /bdag gzhan brje ba'i bdag bde gzhan la ster/ gzhan sdug bdag gis len pa byang chub sems/ /bsgom du mi rung zhes smra ba/ /'di yang bdag gzhan ma brjes na sangs rgyas mi thob gsungs pa'i phyir/

gnad rnams bcos par mthong*/ /gsang sngags kyi ni dbang bskur ba/ /med kyang gsang sngags bsgom rung zer/ rdo rje 'chang gis bkag pas na/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs | | gsang sngags lam gyi mchog gyur pa/ / bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis tshul bzhin du/ mi bsgom par/ /rang bzo'i gdams ngag bskyed rim krong skyed dang*| gtum mo drod skyed dang*/ phyag rgya chen po rtog pa kha bkag sogs/ du ma yis/ /blun po nges shes skyed pa thos/ /mdo rgyud kun las 'di bkag pas/ /'di yang gnas rnams bcos par dogs/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mthar thug pa || dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung*/ /rigs bdag de ni rnam pa sangs rgyas la ngo bo rtsa ba'i/ bla ma yin/ /'di ni gal te 'chol gyur na/ /dngos grub med par rgyud las gsungs/ / brtag gnyis las/ rigs 'chol bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba yis||dngos grub med cing sgrub po'ang med/ /ces gsungs so/ / 'on kyang bla ma spyi bo ru// bsgom bya min

te bsgoms na tshe la gnod/ zhes la la zer/ /'di yang sangs rgyas kyi gsungs 'gog pa'i phyir/ gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /yod pa'i dge ba zhes bya ba/ /chos kyi dbyings bde gshegs snying po/ la bsams nas ni/ /de ni bsngo ba'i rgyur byed pa/ /dmigs pa med pa'i chos kyi dbyings / / spro bral ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa yod pa'i dge bar byas nas dmigs pa'i dge bar bsgyur ba 'di/ / yod med du 'dzin pa dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba dug dang bcas par mdo rgyud kun las/ gsungs/ /'di yang bsngo ba thams cad 'jig pa'i phyir/ gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /de bzhin gtum mo bsgom pa dang*/ /phyag rgya chen po la sogs dang*/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa yi/ /gnad rnams bcos pa mang mod kyi/ /gsang sngags yin phyir 'dir ma bshad/ / logs su bshad yod/ chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug tu/ /mdo rgyud kun las rgyal bas gsungs | | la la sems ngo 'phrod na gzhan ci yang mi dgos par sangs rgya bas/ spros bral rkyang pa ni/ /dkar po chig thub yin zhes zer/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /gnad rnams min pa'i chos gzhan yan lag 'ga'/ / zhig ma tshang ba dang lhag pa dang*/ /cung zad 'khrul par gyur na yang | | nyes pa chen po bskyed mi nus/ /chos kyi gnad rnams bcos gyur na || chos gzhan bzang yang 'tshang mi rgya/ /dper na 'gro ba'i srog rtsa snying*/ dang | | ljon shing rnams kyi skye sa'i/ rtsa ba dang*/ /sa bon gyi ni skye sa dang*/ / thags rnams kyi ni srog shing dang*/ /bcud kyis len gyi rtsa ba dngul chu lta bu/ dang | | mig la sogs pa dbang po rnams kyi gnad mthong byed dang thos byed la sogs pa| rnams ni/ /'chugs na bsgrub tu mi rung ba/ bzhin/ /de bzhin chos kyi gnad 'chugs na/ / gnad ma yin pa'i chos rnams legs legs 'dra yang 'bras bu med/

/des na gnad ma yin pa'i chos/ la la 'khrul yang bla/ / chos kyi gnad rnams 'khrul med dpyad dgos so/ /de la gnad rnams 'chos pa'i bdud/ / ji lta bu'i tshul du 'byung zhe na/ la la sangs rgyas dngos su ston/ kha cig mkhan po slob dpon dang*/ /bla ma'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dang*/ /pha ma'ang nye du'i cha lugs kyis/ /sems can rnams la slu bar byed/ / 'ga' zhig nga'i lus 'di lta bu mi byed na chad pas gcod ces pa lta bu/ rtsub mor smra byed cing | | bsdigs pa'i tshul gyis chos bor nas chos log tu/ sgyur bar byed/ /la la khyod kyi rigs la chos 'di lta bus phan zhes/ 'jam por smra byed cing*/ /byams pa'i tshul gyis chos log bstan pas/ slu bar byed/ /la la sangs rgyas kyis/ gsungs pa'i lung*/ /phyin ci log lta ba'i lung spyod pa/ spyod pa'i lung lta ba'i lung*/ tu bshad nas sgyur/ /la la rigs pa bzang po la/ /ngan pa yin zhes bshad nas sgyur/ /la la rigs pa ngan pa la/ /bzang po lta bur bcos nas sgyur | | la la zas nor ci 'dod pa'i/ /rngan pa byin nas nga'i chos lugs 'di gyis zhes/ chos log ston/ /la la ka ru 'dzin lta bu/ lus dang sems la ni/ / ting 'dzin cung zad bskyed nas kyang*/ /de la yid ches skyes pa dang*/ / log pa'i chos rnams bstan nas slu/ /la la sangs rgyas skar rgyal lta bu/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul cung zad bstan nas kyang*/ /blun po yid ches bskyed nas ni/ /phyi nas chos log ston par byed/ /la la nga yis 'di ltar bsgoms/ /de la rtogs pa 'di skyes pas/ khyed kyang 'di ltar gyis shig ces/ /rang gi nyams myong yin pa yi/ /tshul du byas nas chos/ log par 'chos/ /mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang*/ /phal cher mthun par ston byed cing*/ /gnad rnams log par ston pa'i chos/ /legs legs 'dra bar ston na yang*/ / kha zas bzang po la dug btab pa ltar/ bdud kyi byin rlabs yin no zhes/

/ rgyal ba'i yum la sogs pa mdo rgyud kun las gsal bar gsungs/ /'di dag ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ /mdo tsam nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /rin chen bzang po bzhugs pa'i tshe/ / stod mnga' ris su/ sangs rgyas skar rgyal zhes bya ba/ /dpral ba nas ni 'od 'byin cing*/ /bar snang la ni skyil krung 'cha'/ /res 'ga' 'jag ma'i khri la sdod/ /stong pa nyid kyi chos rnams ston/ /byams dang snying rje che bar snang*/ /de yi chos kyis gzhan dag la/ /ting nge 'dzin yang skye bar byed/ /de la 'jig rten thams cad mos/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa dang*/ /'dra min cung zad bcos par 'chad/ /de yi bstan pa shin tu 'phel/ /de tshe rin chen bzang po yis || sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad nas/ /ting 'dzin brtan pas de drung byon// sangs rgyas skar rgyal bar snang la/ /skyil krung bcas nas chos 'chad tshe// rin chen bzang pos gzigs tsam gyis/ /sa la lhung nas brgyal zhes grag | gal te rin bzang zhes bya ba'i/ /skyes mchog de tshe mi bzhugs na// sangs rgyas skar rgyal zhes bya ba'i/ /chos log bstan pa gsar pa zhig 'byung zhes snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams/ gsungs/ / khu nu zhes bya ba'i yul gyi rting du nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi/ /skar rgyal zhes bya'i klu chen zhig /skyes ngan zhig la zhugs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su brdzus zhes gsungs | | 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi bdud rigs 'ga'/ /mi 'am 'phags pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ /log pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ /chos dang bsres nas gnad rnams su/ /log chos bsres nas 'chad pa srid/ / pas de lta bu'i rigs deng sang yang shes dgos/ dper na kha zas bzang po la/ /sbyar ba'i dug gis phal cher gsod/ /dug rkyang yin par shes na ni/ /'ga' yang gsad par nus ma yin/ /de bzhin chos bzang 'ga' zhig la/ / chos log bslad pas pha rol slu/ /chos log rkyang par go na ni/ /'ga' yang bdud kyis slu mi nus/

/ri dwags rnga ma ma bstan na/ /bong sha btsong bar mi nus ltar/ /de bzhin bzang spyod ma bstan na/ /log pa'i chos kyis slu mi nus/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs thams cad kyang*/ /ngan pa kho na 'byung*| nges pa min/ / nam snyam ste de ltar nges pa med/ 'on kyang bzang po'i nang nas ni/ /gnad rnams cung zad bcos pa yis/ /phan pa lta bus pha rol slu | | 'di 'dra shes par byas nas ni/ /chos kyi gnad rnams mdo rgyud bzhin | | ma bslad par ni legs par zungs/ / dpe gzhan yang shing rta'i srog shing chag gyur na/ /'khor lo bzang yang 'gro mi nus/ /srog gi dbang po 'gags gyur na/ /dbang po gzhan dag bya byed med/ /de bzhin chos kyi gnad 'chugs na/ / gnad ma yin pa'i chos gzhan bzang yang nus med 'gyur/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas las mkhas pa yi/ /gang zag 'jig rten gsum na med/ /des na de yis gsungs pa yi/ /mdo rgyud rnam par dkrug mi bya/ /mdo rgyud dkrugs na chos spong zhing*/ /'phags pa rnams kyang smad 'gyur zhes/ /mgon po byams pas rgyud blar gsungs/ / rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog rnams kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur||nyon mongs rmongs bdag rnams kyis 'phags la skur ba dang*/ /des gsungs chos la brnyas gang de kun zhen ltas byas/ /des na zhen lta'i dri can de la blo mi sbyar/ /gos gtsang tshon gyis rnam 'gyur snum gyis gos pa min/ /zhes gsungs so/ / 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' sla chos su/ sun 'byin pa'i/ /rnam gzhag cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ / kha che'i yul du mu stegs ston pa dbang phyug sogs/ /mnan pa'i sangs rgyas dges rdor| bde mchog dus 'khor la sogs/ mthong nas ni/

/de bzlog pa yi bris sku zhig | mu stegs dbyangs can dga' bas sangs rgyas la snying nad du bsams nas rang dgar/ byas/ /mkhas pa chen po kha che/ dz+nyā na shrīs/ /de dang rtsod pa'i rtsod grwa ru/ /rang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams dang*/ gzhan mu stegs byed kyi paṇ+ḍi ta tshogs pa/ gnyis ka'i sde pa dang*/ /rgyal po dang blon po/ sogs kyi rgyus yod pa'i| dpang po'i grwar/ / khyod kyis byas pa'i sangs rgyas mnan pa 'i dbang phyug khyod rang gi rang bzo yin/ / gyi khyod rang gi gzhung gang las kyang bshad pa med do/ des na 'khrul pa yin par dz+nyā na shrīs/ bsgrags/ / mu stegs dbyangs can dga' ba de yi sa kyang dbang phyug mnan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas dges rdor/ bde mchog sogs khyod rang gis byas pa'i/ rang bzo yin zhes bsgres/ /de la mkhas pa dz+nyā na shrī sa 'di skad brtsad | | sangs rgyas mnan pa khyed kyi gzhung*/ khungs ma 'i rig byed chen po bzhi po/ rnams nas bshad pa med/ /mu stegs mnan pa nged kyi khungs ma'i/ rgyud | | sde bzhi po las/ gdod ma nyid nas bshad nas/ yod pa yin/ /des na nged kyi 'di/ rang bzo min / / pa thams cad kyis shes pa yin/ de nas mu stegs de/ spobs pa med par/ gyur pa'i/ tshe/ / dz+nyā na shrīs rgyal po khyod kyi yul 'di ru/ / 'di 'dra'i rang bzo 'phel na ni/ /da dung rang gzhan gyi chos thams cad la/ rang bza ོ'i brgyud pa/ gzhan mang po/ 'byung bas/ / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi la gnod pa 'di/ / mu stegs kho rang la yang cis mi gnod/ / de kho rang gi chos lugs kyang 'chol bar 'gyur ro// 'di 'dra'i rang bzo'i chos lugs ni/ /sangs rgyas pa la byung na yang*/ / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'chol bar 'gyur bas/ rgyal po khyod kyis dgag dgos so/ /de skad bsgo nas sangs rgyas mnan pa'i dbang phyug ga ི gyeng ris tshogs pa'i gseb tu chus/ bsubs/ /phyi nas dbyangs can dga' ba dang*/ grub mtha' brtsad pa la'ang*/

/mu stegs grub mtha' pham mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel zhes thos/ /gal te mu stegs byed pa'i gzhung*/ /gdod nas grub pa'i rig byed bzhi po/ las/ / sangs rgyas mnan pa'i chos log de 'dra gal te/ bshad na yang*/ /rang bzo yin zhes byar mi rung*/ / ste/ kho rang gi gzhung nas gdod nas bshad pa'i phyir ro// 'o na de dag ji ltar sun 'byin ce na/ grub mtha'i rnam gzhag bzung nas ni/ / 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi rigs pa gzhan gyis sun dbyung dgos | kyi/ lung 'gal gyis sun dbyung bar mi nus so/ / bdag gi grub mtha' dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la'ang*/ /gal te 'gal ba snang na ni/ /rigs pa dag dang 'gal gyur na/ /de ni rigs pas sun phyungs shig /gal te lung dang 'gal gyur na/ /de ni legs par sun 'byin pa'i/ /gdams ngag cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /pha rol lung de kho rang tshad mar/ khas len cing | | khas blangs pa de dang 'gal ba'i chos spyod na/ / khyed rang gi lung dang 'gal bas zhes pas/ sun dbyung bar/ bya/ /gal te lung de khas mi len/ / rang gi lung gzhan khas len na/ /de tshe nged kyi lung gis ni/ /de yi chos log dgag mi nus/ / te/ de la kho tshad mar mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ / 'on kyang kho rang tshad mar byed pa/ de yi lung nyid kyis/ /de yi chos log dgag dgos so/ / dper na pha rol phyin pa ba/ /gal te chos log spyod na ni/ /gsang sngags gzhung dang 'gal lo zhes/ /de ni sun dbyung nus ma yin/ /de bzhin gsang sngags pa 'ga' zhig /lag len log par spyod gyur kyang*// pha rol phyin gzhung dang 'gal zhes/ /sun dbyung bar ni nus ma yin/ / de ltar theg pa che chung la'ang*/ /phan tshun gyi ni lung 'gal gyis/ /so so'i gzhung lugs dgag mi nus/ / te nyan thos kyi lung dang 'gal bas theg chen gyi lugs dgag mi nus/ theg chen gyi lung dang 'gal bas/ nyan thos kyi lugs dgag par mi nus te/ de la tshad mar mi byed pa'i phyir ro/

/ nyan thos gzhung lugs khas len cing*/ /de yi lung dang 'gal gyur na/ /de yi lung gis dgag par nus/ /de bzhin bka' gdams la sogs kyang*/ /jo bo'i gzhung lugs khas len cing*/ / de yi lung dang 'gal gyur na/ / bka' gdams pa la gnod pa yin/ / de bzhin phyag rgya pa yang ni/ /nā ro pa la mos byed cing*/ /nā ro'i gzhung dang 'gal gyur na/ /phyag rgya pa la gnod pa yin/ /de bzhin gsang sngags spyod bzhin du/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde dang 'gal na/ /gsang sngags pa la gnod par 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lugs byed cing*/ / mdo sde rnams dang 'gal gyur na/ /phar phyin pa la cis mi gnod/ /de yi dper brjod mdo tsam zhig /legs par bshad kyis mnyan par gyis/ / jo bos mdzad pa'i bde mchog gsang 'dus la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs mang po yod jo bo gsang sngags spyod bzhin du/ / de'i rjes su 'brangs pa rnams/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus min zhes/ /smra ba jo bo'i lugs nyid dang*/ /'gal ba yin par shes par bya/ /sems bskyed jo bo'i lugs byed cing*/ /jo bo gtan nas mi bzhed pa'i/ / 'jug pa sems bskyed kun la byed pa dang*/ / jo bo mi bzhed pa'i don dam sems bskyed byed pa ni/ /gzhan dang 'gal ba smos ci dgos | | jo bo'i rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ / nā ro'i chos kyi rtsa ba lnga ni/ dbang bskur/ dam tshig rim gnyis/ spyod pa/ yan lag ste lnga'o nā ro ta pa dbang bskur dang | | rim gnyis chos kyi gtso bor mdzad/ /nā ro'i brgyud pa 'dzin bzhin du/ /dbang dang rim gnyis mi bsgom pa/ /rgyud dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs ni/ / bla ma mar pa lho brag pa la med/ /mar pa'i brgyud pa 'dzin bzhin du/ /phag mos chos sgo 'byed pa ni/ /rgyud dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid || mi la yan chad de las med/

/chos drug bor nas lam 'bras dang*// phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa/ / zhi byed/ rdzogs chen dang*/ bka' gdams la sogs pa cal col mang po bsres nas/ / gzhan gyi gdams ngag bsgom bzhin du/ /nā ro'i brgyud pa 'ded byed pa/ /gzhan dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ / chos gzhan nas byung nas brgyud pa gzhan du 'ded pa ni rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ / gter nas byung ba'i glegs bam dang*/ /gzhan nas brkus pa'i chos lugs dang*/ /brtsams chos dang ni rmi lam chos/ /blo bzung ma yi chos lugs la/ /rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa snyeg /de la'ang rang re la slob dpon gyi lung med par chos kyi slob ma/ gzhan dag la/ lung ster zhing*/ len du 'jug pa/ /chos dang 'gal ba smos ci dgos/ /rang tshig dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /gal te 'di 'dra'i rigs can gyi/ /'gal ba khas len pa lung dang rigs pa man ngag la| snang gyur na/ /de yi rigs su shes par bya/ /mdor na chos dang 'gal ba yi/ /chos zhig gang na 'dug na yang*/ /lung dang rigs pas sun phyungs shig

/gal te mu stegs la sogs pa/ / 'am sangs rgyas pa nang yin yang rung ste/ lung de khas mi len pa dang*/ /lung dang 'gal yang nged cag gi/ bla ma'i bka' srol yin zer ba/ /de dag lung de khas/ mi len yang*/ /rtsa ba'i brgyud pa gang yin dri/ / mu stegs kyi rig byed la sogs pa ltar gdod nas chos de yod na ni/ /'khrul yang mkhas pas khyod kyi rang bzo yin byas la/ bgrang rgyu med de shes na rigs par sun dbyung*/ mi shes na khros pas ci zhig phan// sems can las ngan spyod pa la/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ci byar yod/ /gal te gdod nas med pa'i chos/ /glo bur byas pa yin na ni/ /kun gyis rang bzor go ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas pa'am mu stegs byed/ /su la 'dug kyang dor bya yin | | nged la'ang de 'dra ba mdo rgyud nas ma gsungs pa/ lung rigs kyis mi 'grub pa'i rang bzor byas pa/ 'dug na ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhad gad gyis la lugs na 'dug na dor ma zhog/ gal te rgyal po'i khrims yod na/ / bstan pa dkrugs nas chos log byed pa'i mi de chad pas bcad pa'i 'os yin no/ / de'i rgyu mtshan nor la zog tshong byas pa la'ang*/ /rgyal po'i khrims mgo bcad pa/ la thug par/ gyur na/ /chos log brdzun mas sbyar ba la/ /rgyal po'i khrims la cis mi thug ste chos rgyal thams cad chos kyi khrims chen po mdzad pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa rnams bka' bsdu ba mdzad pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa de yin no/ / blun po mkhas par 'chos pa 'ga' | | lta sgom spyod pa dang*/ las dang po ba dang brtan pa thob pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag lung gi gnas skabs mi shes par/ / nga la'ang lung yod ces mdo rgyud lung sbyor byed mod kyi/ /de ni blun po'i kha shags 'ga' zhig dgra bo'i grogs su 'gro ba ltar/ /gang du 'gro ba mi shes so/ /dper na phyag dang mchod pa dang*// sbyin dag tshul khrims sogs mi dgos/ /sems bskyed dbang bskur bya mi dgos/

/bsam gtan klog pa 'dir mi dgos/ /dge dang sdig pa gnyis ka med/ /sangs rgyas sems can yod min sogs/ /'di 'dra gsungs pa'i lung rnams kun/ /lta ba yin gyi bsgom pa dang*/ /spyod pa gnyis kyi lung ma yin/ /dbang med pa la dngos grub med/ /cho ga 'khrugs na las mi 'chags/ /log par spyad na ltung ba 'byung*/ /lha bsgom 'khrul na byin mi rlob/ /the tshom za na nyes pa skye/ / des na cho ga ci byed kyang*/ /shin tu dag par bya dgos zhes/ /de 'dra'i lung kun spyod pa dang*/ /bsgom pa yin gyi lta ba min/ /gzhan yang lung sbyor byed pa la// 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i gnas skabs rnam gnyis yod/ /dbang dang dam tshig sdom pa sogs/ /'bad nas bsgrub par gsungs pa ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma brgal ba'i/ /'jig rten pa la gsungs pa yin/ /dbang dang dam tshig sogs mi dgos/ /phyag dang mchod pa kun las grol/ /bsam gtan bsgom pa kun spangs te/ /lam kun gzings bzhin dor bya zhes/ /gsungs pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// brgal ba'i gang zag rnams la gsungs/ /de 'dra'i gnas skabs shes nas ni/ /de dang 'tsham pa'i lug sbyor bya/ /de 'dra'i rnam bzhag mi shes pa'i | | lug sbyor mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas/ / rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la skabs brgyad kyi mtshams mi shes par lung sbyor byas na lung yod kyang gnas skabs 'khrugs nas mkhas pa'i bzhad gad du 'gyur ba bzhin no/ / mig ldan ji ltar lam nor yang*/ / g.yang sar gom pa 'jog mi srid/ /de bzhin mkhas pa 'khrul na yang / / nor ba chung bas/ sangs rgyas bstan las 'da' mi nus/ /mig med gal te lam nor na/ /g.yang sar mchongs nas lhung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin blun po 'khrul gyur na/ / nor pa kham can 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas bstan las 'das te ltung*/ /chag tshad shes pa'i bzo la ni/ /ring thung byung yang sor gang yin | | chag tshad med pa'i bzo 'ga' zhig /nyes na bzhad gad gnas su 'gyur

| | de bzhin gzhung lugs shes pa'i mi/ /'khrul yang tshig don cung zad yin/ /gzhung lugs gang yang mi shes pa/ /'khrul na nor ba kham can 'byung bas/ bstan pa 'jig la thug /des na sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhin/ / bsgrub par 'dod na chos kyi long khrid dam chag tshad lta bu yin pas/ gzhung bzhin bya// blun pos go ba'i dpe gzhan yang mig mangs rgya dang ma 'brel na/ /rde'u mang yang shi ro yin/ /de bzhin du nyan thos pa 'dul ba'am/ phar phyin pa mdo sde'am/gsang sngags pa rgyud sde'i/ khungs dang ma 'brel ba'i/ /chos lugs mang yang ro dang 'dra/ / ste snying po med/ snyan brgyud dang ni chig brgyud du/ /grags pa'i chos lugs mang po yod/ /rgyud dang mthun na blang du rung*/ /min na snyan brgyud chig brgyud du ming btags nas gzhan mgo bskor ba'i/ brdzun gyi bsdeb phyogs yin/ /rmi lam gyi ni chos lugs dang*/ /zhal mthong gi ni lha la sogs/ /'di dag mdo rgyud dang mthun na/ /blangs kyang skyon du 'gyur ba med/ /mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun na/ / phar phyin gyi bdud kyi le'u las 'di 'dra 'byung bar bshad pas/ bdud kyi byin rlabs yin zhes bya/ /bla ma'ang mdo rgyud dang mthun na/ /de ni bla ma yin par gzung*/ /sangs rgyas bstan bzhin mi gsungs na/ /bla ma yin yang btang snyoms su/ bzhag gi de'i gsung la bden par mi gzung*// des na rmi lam du rmi ba'i/ chos lugs dang*/ /'a ga' zhig gis zhal gzigs pa yi yi dam gyi lha/ dang*/ /lung bstan mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /bla ma'i gsung sgros la sogs pa/ /ma dpyad par ni gtam chol du/ /tshad ma yin zhes gzung mi bya/ /'di 'dra bdud kyi byin rlabs las/ /'byung ba srid par rgyal bas gsungs/ /des na sangs rgyas bstan pa mchog la gnyis yod pa'i drang don bor la/ / nges don tshad ma yin par gzung*/ /yang na dngos po stobs zhugs kyi/ /rigs pas grub pa mngon sum dang rjes dpag

tshad mar gzung | | skyes bu brdzun mas sbyar ba yi/ /mdo rgyud du ming btags pa/ tshad mar gzung mi bya/ / brdzun mas sbyar ba dper na ko'u shi ka'i mdo dang ni/ / de bzhin 'phags pa shig can dang*/ /blo gros bzang mo chung ngu sdong po rgyan/ sogs | | bod kyis sbyar ba'i mdo sde yin/ / snang brgyad dang*/ las dge sdig bstan pa la sogs rgya nag nas bsgyur ba yin/ gzhan yang gsang sngags gsar rnying la'ang | | lam lnga bkol ba dang*/ dbang bskur rgyal po'i rgyud la sogs pa/ bod kyis sbyar ba'i rgyud sde mang*/ /de 'dra'i rang bzo'i mdo rgyud la/ / sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin byas nas/ mkhas pas yid rton mi bya'o/ /gtsug tor nag mo bya khyung bsam yas ma/ la sogs pa/ /bod kyi lha 'dres sbyar ba yod/ /'phral gyi byin rlabs cung zad 'byung*/ /'on kyang tshad mar byar mi rung*/ /lha mo gnas mkhar nam mkha' lding gi rtog pa/ la sogs pa/ /mu stegs byed kyi rgyud kyang yod | | cung zad bden pa yod mod kyi/ /de la'ang lung du byar mi rung*/ / de yi 'thad pa rgyud bla mar/ /mgon po byams pas 'di skad gsungs/ / ma rig ldongs pa'i mu stegs la'ang*/ /srin bu'i yi ge 'dra ba yi/ /cung zad bden pa yod mod kyi//'on kyang yid rton mi bya gsung*/ /ring bsrel dang ni thugs dang ljags/ /sku gzug la sogs shi ba'i/ rus pa las/ / 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan cung zad dpyad/ / sangs rgyas/ rang sangs rgyas/ dgra bcom pa 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel ni/ /yon tan stobs kyis 'byung ba ste// lus can rnams kyi bsod nams bsags pa'i rten/ /'byung khungs kyi rgya mtsho'am gser kha/ las byung rin chen dang*/ 'dra/ / ste khungs nas byung ba yin/ ring bsrel la la gzhan bslu ba'i don du/ gdon gyis byed/ /la la 'byung bzhi'i stobs sa chu me rlung 'khyims pa'i nus pa 'ga' zhig las 'byung*/ ring bsrel kha cig bstan la dga' ba'i lhas/

/ 'das pa'i gang zag de la mi rnams dad par bya phyir sprul pa'ang srid/ /deng sang ring bsrel phal che ba/ rdo bug skyed dang*/ ram nye ba'i 'bras bu dang*/ nya'i mig dang*/ bal pos rus pa la bzo byas pa/ / brdzun mas byas pa'i ring bsrel yin/ /des na rnam dbye mkhas pas dpyad/ /thugs ljags sku gzugs la sogs pa/ /'byung ba chos nas gsungs pa med/ / 'on kyang de 'dra 'byung ba kun/ /phal cher brdzun mas byas pa thugs ljags ma tshig par me nang nas bton pa dang*/ bzo bos rus pa la brkos pa'i sku/ yin/ /gal te bzo bos ma byas par/ bden pa ra byung ba/ yin na yang*/ /lung nas 'di lta bu byung na bzang ngan 'di lta bu yin zhes bshad pa dang mngon sum rjes dpag gi rigs pa/ gnyis ka med pa'i phyir/ /bzang ngan gnyis kar lung bstan dka'/ /nyi ma du ma shar ba dang*/ /mkha' la mthongs khung lta bu/ bu ga dod pa dang*/ /mtshan mo gzha' tshon dkar po/ 'byung ba dang*/ /lus la 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ / glo bur du ma bsgrubs par/ lha 'dre mthong ba dang*/ / gson po'i lus la brdzun med par/ /ring bsrel 'dzag pa dang rgyu mtshan med pa'i mngon shes phra mo dang byin rlabs/ la sogs pa/ /blun po rtags su byed mod kyi/ /mkhas pas 'di 'dra mthong gyur na/ /bar chad rtags su shes par gyis/ /sku gzugs mchi ma 'dzag pa dang*/ /de bzhin gom pas 'gro ba dang*/ / sku gzugs gar byed pa dang sku gzugs skad 'byin dang*/ khrag gi char pa 'bab pa dang*/ /sa 'og bong bu'i sgra sgrogs dang*/ /dud 'gro mi skad smra ba dang sa 'og dang nam mkha' la rol mo'i sgra grags pa/ gnam rdo lhung ba/ sogs/ /blun po ngo mtshar skyed mod kyi/ /mkhas pas 'di 'dra mthong gyur na/ /yul der dgra bo gzhan dag 'jug /yang na nang 'khrug dang*/ yams la sogs pa/ ltas ngan gzhan dag 'byung | | 'di 'dra'i rigs can sa g.yo ba dang*/ lce 'bab pa la sogs pa/ gzhan mthong yang*/ /mkhas pa rnams la legs par dris/

/de dag don la 'khrul pa yi/ /rnam par dbye ba mdo tsam yin/ / rgyas par bshad na dpag tu med do| de nas tshig la 'khrul pa yi/ /rnam dbye cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ / bcom ldan 'das kyi bshad pa la/ / bdud bzhi bcom dbang phyug sogs drug ldan 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das zhes/ bshad pa dang*/ /glegs bam gyi ni bshad pa la/ /glegs shing glegs thag 'chad pa dang*/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bshad pa la/ / phyag lag pa rgya bsnol ba zhes lag pa'i sgra don 'chad pa dang*/ /ye shes kyi ni bshad pa la/ /gdod ma'i shes par 'chad pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor 'chad la sems rnal ma/ /rig pa 'byor ces 'chad pa dang*/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan dpung pa'i rgyan/ la/ /dmag gi dpung du 'chad pa dang | | gtum mo'i sgra bshad bdag 'dzin gsod pa'i shan par 'chad dgos pa la/ rnam rtog ni/ /chos nyid gtum par 'chad pa dang*/ /glu yi sgra bshad byed pa la ga sa ru bsgyur nas/ / sems can slu bar 'chad pa dang*/ /phur ma phye ma rgya skad du me tu ri rab nyid yin pas/ ri rab mnyam pa yin pa/ la/ /dri rab mnam par 'chad pa dang*/ /shākya'i bu mo go pā'i sgra/ /go ni sa yin pā yi sgra/ / pā la zhes pa 'tsho ba 'am skyong ba sogs la 'jug /des na bod skad sa 'tsho yin/ / de la go pā'i sgra bshad ni/ /rtogs pa'i don du bshad pa dang*/ / 'bum las byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dbal gyi bslab pa la bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don la rgya skad rat+na ke tu la/ / bod skad la rat+na rin chen/ ke tu'i sgra ni dbal dang tog / dang*| gza' du ba mjug rings dang rgyal mtshan/ sogs la 'jug /skad rnying rnams la dbal du yod/ / par/ gsar bcad man chad tog tu bsgyur/ / des na 'bum las rin chen dbal/ /gsar bcad kyis ni zhus pa yi/ / brgyad stong pa las rin chen tog gi bslab pa la bslab par bya'o/ / ces byar bsgyur ba mi shes par/ /rin chen dpal du bshad pa la de yin na rgya skad rat+na shrī 'ong dgos pa las de med pa/

dang*/ /po ta la zhes bya ba'i sgra/ /bod skad du ni gru 'dzin yin/ /ri bo gru 'dzin zhes bya bar/ /bsgyur na bod la 'thad mod kyi | | la las rgya skad sor bzhag nas/ /po ta la yi ri zhes bsgyur/ /de la sgra bsgyur la la yis/ /ri sgra gong du phyung nas ni/ /ri po ta la zhes byar bsgyur | | de don ma rtogs pa rnams kyis/ / po bo ru bsgyur nas ri bo ta lar bshad pa 'khrul/ /'khor gsum yongs dag ces bya ba/ /rgya skad du ni tri maṇ+ḍal | | pa ri shud+dha zhes byar yod/ /tri ni gsum yin maṇ+ḍal la/ /zhes bya bod skad dkyil 'khor yin/ /pa ri shung+ngha yongs dag pa/ /drang por bsgyur na dkyil 'khor gsum/ /yongs su dag pa zhes byar 'gyur/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis sgra bsdus nas/ /'khor gsum yongs dag ces byar bsgyur | | de yi sgra don mi shes par/ /'khor gsum dpon po'i/ g.yog lta bur| tu 'chad pa 'khrul/ /rgya skad laṅka pū ri la/ /pū ri'i sgra na grong khyer yin || bod skad laṅka'i grong khyer te/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling na yod/ / par laṅkar gshegs par gsungs/ 'on kyang rgya skad ma shes par pū ri'i sgra/ pu rangs su ni 'chad pa 'khrul ba/ dang*/ /rgya skad bi ma la mi tra/ /bod skad dri med bshes gnyen yin/ /de yi sgra don mi shes par/ / bi bye ru bcos nas chos/ bye ma 'i/ la tsam bsgyur bas bye ma lar 'chad pa/ dang mi tra mu trar bcos nas/ mu tra'i sgra/ phyag rgya yin par bshad pa 'khrul pa/ dang*/ /rgya skad nā ro ta yi sgra/ /bram ze'i rigs kyi bye brag yin/ /de yi rgyu mtshan mi shes par/ /dka' ba spyad pas a na na/ /ro ru song zhes rgya skad la bod skad kyi bshad pa byed cing*/ 'chad pa dang*/ /ti lo zhes bya ba/ til mar/ brdung ba'i rigs/ yin/ /de la ti tre ru bsgyur nas| tre lor 'chad pa 'khrul ba/ dang*/ / nya'i rgyu lto gsol zhing sgrub pa mdzad pas rgya skad lū hi

pa/ zhes bya ba 'i mtshan de byung ba las/ bod skad nya yi rgyu lto yin/ /de yi sgra don mi shes par/ / lu glu ru bcos nas/ glu yi pa ru 'chad pa 'khrul pa dang | | rgya skad in+d+ra bhū ti ni/ /bod skad 'byung po'i dbang po yin/ /de yi sgra 'gyur mi shes par/ / in+d+ra bhū ti bo dhir bcos nas brgya byin byang chub tu 'chad pa 'khrul te/ brgya sbyin byang chub yin na shaka bo dhir 'ong dgos pas so// dang*/ /rgya skad a ba dhū tī'i sgra/ a pa dwa gnyis spangs sam ni ā wa dhū kun 'dar yin// de la ci 'dod 'dod 'ong bas/ 'dod ster 'chad pa dang*/ /rgya skad do ha zhes bya ba || bod skad lhug pa'am ma bcos pa/ /zhes bya'i don la 'jug mod kyi// de yi rgyu mtshan mi shes par/ /do ni gnyis yin ha dgod pa/ /gnyis la dgod par 'chad pa dang*/ / la la gnyis la brdeg par 'chad pa nor/ rgya skad dza ba zhes bya ba/ /

bod skad du me tog dmar po zhig la 'jug /de yi brda don mi 'phrod par/ / rgya skad la bod skad kyi bshad pa byas nas/ byams pa'i mdza' bar 'chad pa sogs/ / bir+wa pa la bir+ya pa dang*/ mdo las/ 'di na gnyis cig byin/ zhes bya ba dngul gyi dong rtse'i bye brag cig yin pa la/ de la gnyis gcig byin par bshad pa lta bu mang po yod| blun po rnams la legs legs 'dra/ /mkhas pas mthong na bzhad gad gnas/ /rgyu mtshan ci yi phyir zhe na/ /saṃ skṛ ta yi sgra don la/ /bshad du mi rung nyid phyir dang*/ /rgya skad yin par mi shes par/ / 'khrul nas rgya skad la| bod skad yin par 'bru snon/ bshad phyir ro/ /des na de 'dra'i bshad pa nor ba mang po yod pa de dag kun/ /bod kyi blun pos sbyar bas na/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis dor bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bshad pa ga tar yod pa las 'gro ba dang rtogs pa gnyis ka la 'jug pa de/ ni/ /de nyid rtogs par 'chad pa dang | | dgra bcom sgra don ar+ha ta'i sgra'i khams mchod 'os la'ang 'jug pas/ mchod 'os dang*//rgyal po'i bshad pa rā dza'i sgra'i khams gsal ba la'ang 'jugapas/ gsal ba dang*/ /bzod pa'i bshad pa sa ha'i sgra'i khams mi 'byed pa la 'jug pas/ mi 'byed dang*/ / skan+dha'i sgra phrag pa la 'jug pas phung po phrag par 'chad pa dang*/ / dha tu'i sgra'i khams dbyings la 'jug pas khams la dbyings su 'chad pa dang*/ / bha ga'i sgra skal pa la 'jug pas bcom pa skal bar 'chad pa dang*/ / dur dzh+ya'i sgra thub dka' ba la'ang 'jug pas sbyang dka' thub dkar 'chad pa dang*/ / bā sa'i sgra gnas la'ang 'jug pas bag chags gnas su 'chad pa dang*/ /shākya 'i sgra phod pa la 'jug pas/ phod par bshad pa dang*/ sogs pra pa ta'i sgra thob pa'am phrad pa la 'jug bi'i sgra bral ba'am rnam par la 'jug su'i sgra legs pa'am/ bde ba'am/ bzang po la 'jug pas skabs cung zad 'chol bar bshad kyang mkhas pa rnams la skyon chung*/

/ bod la cung zad mi bde yang | | legs par sbyar ba'i sgra dag la/ /shin tu 'thad phyir mkhas pas blangs || sangs rgyas gsung rab dri ma med/ / pa la dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas/ bsdu ba dang po byas pa'i rjes/ / la/ bstan pa dag par gnas pa na/ /yangs pa can gyi dge slong gis/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi/ /mi rung ba yi gzhi bcu byas/ / hu lu hu lu yi rang dang*/ /kun spyod snod dang lan tshwa dang*/ / lam dang sor gnyis dkrug dang gding*/ /gser gyi rung ba byed pa ste/ / 'di dag mi rung gzhi bcu yin| de la dgra bcom pa grags pa dang seng ges gzhi mdzad nas/ 'phags pa bdun brgya yis/ /chos log legs par sun dbyung phyir/ / bya gag gi kun dga' ra bar chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis yon bdag byas nas bsdu ba gnyis pa mdzad ces lung las| grag /de ltar dag par byas pa'i rjes/ /lha chen zhes bya'i dge slong zhig | bstan pa 'di yi chom rkun byung*/ /de yis rang gi pha ma bsad/ / slob dpon yin pa'i dgra bcom bkrongs/ / rang nyid kyi ngur smrig gyon/ skra bzhar nas| mkhan slob med pa'i dge slong byas/ /phyi nas dgon par bsdad nas ni | | sbyin bdag rnams kyi dad rdzas zos/ /blun po rnams kyi mkhan slob byas | | blun po longs spyod can rnams kyis/ /phul ba'i zas nor char bzhin bab/ /skal med dad can 'dus pa yi/ /dge 'dun 'bum phrag du mas bskor/ /de nas brdzun rlabs chen po de/ kho rang dgra bcom yin par khas blangs so/ /'khor gyis rdzu 'phrul zhus pa na/ /rdzu 'phrul mdang*/ tho rangs nyams zhes zer/ / ba dang*/ mtshams med la sogs pa'i rang gi sdig pa dran pa yis/ / kye ma sdug bsngal lo zhes tho rangs smre sngags chen po bton pa la/ / 'khor rnams kyis 'phags pa sdug bsngal dang bral ba la/ de tsam gyi sdug skad 'dod na pa ci lags| zhes dris pas/ nga'i sdug skad ma yin/ sdug bsngal gyi/ bden pa bos pa'o// zhes bsgrags

| | so/ de la chos dris pas rtugs pa la/ dgra bcom pa yin gyi/ thams cad mkhyen par khas ma blangs zhes bya ba/ sogs pa'i brdzun tshig gis/ /tshogs pa rnams kyi mgo bo bskor/ /'phags pa rnams la 'bul rgyu yi/ /dad rdzas rnams kyang blun po rnams kyis 'phags pa rnams bor nas/ de la 'gyur/ /rab byung blun po phal cher gyis/ /dgra bcom bor nas de la 'dus/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /so so skye bos 'khor bsdus pa/ /de las mang ba med ces grags/ /de yis chos log bshad pa yi/ /rjes su slob ma rnams 'brangs nas/ /'khrul pa'i grub mtha' du ma byung*/ /lha chen blun po de shi nas/ /sems can dmyal bar gyur ces grag /de yi log pa'i chos de dag /dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya/ rnams kyis sun phyung nas/ / yul dzā lan+dha rar rgyal po ka ni kas yon bdag byas nas bsdu ba gsum pa byas zhes thos/ /'on kyang de yi le lan gyis/ /sde pa bco brgyad rnams la yang*/ /cung zad bslad pa yod ces zer/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dbyig gnyen gyis/ /yang dag bsdus pa'i gzhi nyams phyir | | mtha' dag min par rtogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yang de la dgongs || de ni nyan thos rnams kyi yin/ /theg pa chen po'i bstan pa ni// shin tu dar bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma bsgrub pa'i mu stegs byed/ /sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub kyis/ /gtsug lag khang rnams bsregs pa'i tshe/ / dam chos mngon pa la sogs pa/ /sde snod phal cher bsregs zhes grag ste| chos mngon pa theg pa chen po gtan nas nub/ phal po che/ laṅkar gshegs pa/ zla ba sgron ma/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa la sogs pa gzhung 'bum phrag re yod pa rnams da lta dum bu re las med pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ rgyud kyang la la gtan nas nub/ la la dum bur song ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no/ / de nas 'phags pa thogs med kyis

/ / lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs pa'i mthar mi pham mgon po byams pa/ la gsan nas ni/ / theg pa chen po de yi gzhung lugs dar bar mdzad/ /de yi rjes la mkhas pa dang*/ /blun po rnams kyi bye brag gis/ /bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib du ma byung*/ /phyi nas gangs ri'i khrod kyi bod/ 'di ru/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa legs par bsgyur/ /de nas bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ /rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsnubs/ /de rjes chos log du ma 'phel/ /de tshe bla ma ye shes 'od/ /chos rgyal de yis skyes bu mchog /rin chen bzang po la sogs pa brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ kha cher brdzangs | | pa la/ jo bo rin chen bzang po dang*/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab gnyis bod du thon pa las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /mkhas pa rin chen bzang po/ de yis sngon med pa'i/ /chos rnams phal cher bsgyur cing zhus/ / chos dang chos min rnam 'byed pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad nas ni// chos log thams cad nub par mdzad/ /de yi slob ma zhi ba 'od/ /des kyang sngags log sun 'byin pa//zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad ces zer//de dag 'das pa'i 'og tu yang*/ /chos log 'ga' zhig 'phel ba'i rgyus// lhas btsas zhes bya'i lo tsā ba/ /des kyang chos log sun 'byin pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad nas ni/ /chos dang chos min rnam par phye/ nas/ chos log 'ga' zhig la 'di chos yin re zhes mna' tshun chad bskyal ba'i yi ger btab nas bstan 'chos byas so/ / de nas chos rje sa skya pa/ /chen po bzhugs pa yan chad du | | chos log spyod pa nyung zhes thos/ /phyi nas dbang bskur gyi dod/ phag mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sems bskyed rmi lam ma la sogs/ /yi dam bsgom pa dkrongs bskyed dang*/ /dkar po chig thub la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi/ /chos log du ma deng sang 'phel/ /mkhas rnams 'di la mi dgyes kyang*/ /dus kyi shugs kyis bzlog ma nus/

/ blun po sbyangs pa chung ba rnams/ /'di 'dra spyod pa bden mod kyi/ /mkhas pa sbyangs par rlom pa yang*/ /ri bong chal bzhin 'di la spyod/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can 'phel gyur na/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod mi gnod | | mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyod la smros/ /gal te 'di 'dra'i chos log gis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mi gnod na/ /mu stegs sogs kyi chos log kyang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan la ci ste gnod/ /chos log gzhan gyis gnod na ni/ /'di dag gis kyang mi gnod dam/ /gnod kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs la/ sun 'byin mi 'thad na/ /mu stegs byed dang nyan thos sogs || 'di la'ang sun dbyung ci ste bya/ /'di dag bstan la gnod pa'i phyir | | mkhas rnams sun 'byin mdzad na ni/ /bstan la gnod pa bod kyis byas| pa'i chos log kyang*/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis su phyungs shig /ci phyir zhe na rgyal ba yis/ /rin chen chos kyang dkon la ni/ /rtag tu 'tshe ba mang zhes gsungs/ / sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang*/ /zhes gsungs so// 'di la bsams la mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtag tu bstan pa'i byi dor bya/ /nyi ma gcig gi bza' btung la'ang*/ /bzang ngan rtog dpyod sna tshogs gtong*/ /gos dang mkhar lhan la sogs pa'i/ /bya ba gang la'ang legs nyes dang*/ /bzang ngan mkhas dang mi mkhas zhes/ /blang dor rtog dpyod sna tshogs byed/ /rta dang nor bu la sogs pa/ /cung zad tsam gyi nyo tshong la'ang*/ /kun la 'dri zhing brtags nas dpyod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad la'ang*/ /de 'dra'i 'bad pa byed pa mthong*/ /skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni/ /dam pa'i chos la rag las kyang*/ /chos 'di khyi la gtsang mi gtsang gang byin yang za bas khyi yi zas bzhin du/ /bzang ngan gang du'ang mi dpyod par/ /gang phrad de la gus par 'dzin/ /nyin gcig gi ni skyel ma'am | | tshe gcig gi ni gnyen 'brel la'ang*/ /'bad de brtags nas len pa mthong*/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzaugs pa yi/

/sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi don/ /bla ma mchog la rag las mod/ /'on kyang rtog dpyod mi byed par/ /tshong dus ngan pa'i zong la brtad pa mi rnyed pas gang phrad pa nyo ba/ bzhin du/ /su phrad rnams las len pa mthong*/ /kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar/ /'bad mi dgos la 'bad pa byed/ /'bad dgos chos dang bla ma ni/ /ci yang rung bas tshim par snang*/ /bdag ni sems can kun la byams | | gang zag kun la bdag mi smod/ /brgya la mnyam par ma bzhag pas | | smad pa srid na'ang sdig de bshags/ /dam chos 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba/ /skye ba gtan gyi gros yin pas/ /'di yi legs nyes dpyod pa la | | sdang zhes de skad du/ smra na 'ang*/smra mkhan/ rang gi skyon yin/ /klu sgrub dang ni dbyig gnyen dang*/ /phyogs kyi glang po chos grags dang zla grags/ sogs/ / mkhas pa kun gyis sangs rgyas pa/ rang dang*/ gzhan mu stegs byed/ gyi/ /chos log thams cad sun phyung ba/ /de la'ang sangs rgyas dang mkhas pa rnams gzhan la/ sdang zhes zer ram ci/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang*/ /bdud dang mu stegs sun phyung ba/ /de la/ yang sangs rgyas bdud dang mu stegs la/ phrag dog byed pa/ nyid du/ 'gyur ram/ /mkhas rnams blun po'i long khrid yin/ /nor pa'i chos dang ma nor pa'i/ /long khrid legs par byas pa la/ / 'khrul ma 'khrul ma phye na ni mi go phye na phrag dog tu go nas sdang zhes smra na da slan chad/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ji ltar bsrung*/ /long khrid kyis ni long ba la/ /g.yang sa bkag cing lam bzang por/ khrid pa'ang phrag dog yin nam ci/ /'o na long ba ji ltar bkri/ /nad pa la ni gnod pa yi/ kha zas spongs shig phan pa bsten/ /de skad sman pas smra na yang*//sdang dang phrag dog 'gyur na ni// 'o na nad pa ji ltar gso/ /chos log pa dang ma log pa'i/ /rnam par dbye ba byas pa la/ /sdang dang phrag dog yin zer na/ /'o na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can rnams ni ji ltar bsgral/

te nor ba bshad na sangs mi rgya|ma nor ba bshad na phrag dog tu 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa dang || mkhas rnams bshad pa byed pa la/ / chos log sun 'byin/bdud yi mugaskyes bu dam pa rnams dga' ba bskyed pa ste/ 'bras bu rnam gsum 'byung ba 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi lugs yin/ /ma khol gyis kyang bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las| 'di skad gsungs/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi bstan pa ni/ /mu stegs thams cad skrag mdzad cing*/ /bdud ni sems khong chud mdzad la/ /dang mi rnams dbugs kyang 'byin/ /zhes gsungs deng sang 'di na yang*/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis chos bshad na/ /chos log spyod pa pham byed cing*/ / bdud rigs thams cad yi mug 'gyur/ /mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed/ /'di 'dras bstan pa 'dzin par nus/ /'di las bzlog pa ste/ chos log la bsngags par byed/ bdud spro ba bskyed/ skyes bu tha shal rnams dga' bar byed/ byung gyur na/ / sangs rgyas kyi/ bstan pa/ la gnod par shes par gyis/ /bdag kyang rdo rje phag mo yi/ /byin rlabs tsam re byas pa la/ /dkar po chig thub bstan nas kyang*/ /myong ba cung zad skyes pa la/ /mthong lam du ni ngo sprad nas | | rtsol bsgrub med pa'i don bstan na/ /tshogs pa'ang 'di bas mang ba 'du/ /longs spyod 'bul ba'ang mang bar 'gyur/ /blun po rnams kyi bsam pa la'ang*/ /sangs rgyas lta bur mos pa skye/ /chos kyi gnad rnams mi shes pa'i/ /sde snod 'dzin par rlom pa yang*/ /de la lhag par dad 'gyur bar/ /bdag gis legs par go mod kyi/ /'khor dang zang zing bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis sems can bsdus pa min/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /phan par bsams nas bshad pa yin/ / skyes rabs las/ phan par smra la mchod par byed pa ni/ /bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin gus pas nyan pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhin bsgrubs na/ /sangs rgyas bstan la phan par bsams/

/mu stegs byed dang nyan thos dang*/ / theg pa chen po 'ga' zhig la'ang*/ /'khrul pa yod mod sngar gyi/ mkhas pa/ rnams kyis/ /sun phyung ba'i/ phyir na 'dir ma bshad/ /deng sang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /rigs pas bsgrubs par mi nus shing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi/ /'khrul pa gsar pa du ma byung*/ / bye brag tu rdo rje theg pa'i gnad 'chugs pas/ /rgyud sde rnams dang grub thob kyi/ /dgong sa pa rnams dang 'gal ba'i gnad/ /dpag tu/ med pa zhig bod 'di na/ yod mod kyi de sun 'byin pa la/ gsang sngags kyi lugs zab mo rnams bshad dgos pas de ni/ gsang sngags nyid/ /yin phyir kho bos 'dir ma bshad de/ gzhan du bshad/ / par bya'o// 'di ni dbang bskur thob ma thob/ kun la bshad du/ rung ba'i/ /'khrul pa rags rim ci rigs pa/ /'phel na bstan la gnod mthong nas/ /che long tsam zhig bshad pa yin/ / gyi 'khrul pa dpag tu med pa yod de/bshad kyis ma langs pas/ rang res ci rigs pas dpyod/ da dung 'khrul pa'i rnam gzhag ni/

/ skyon can dpag med snang na yang*//gzhung mang dogs pas re zhig bzhag/gal te lung dang rigs pa'i gnad/ /shes pa'i blo can rnams kyis de/ / legs par dpyod la dgag bsgrub gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang phrad dka' zhing*/ /dal ba 'byor pa'ang rnyed dka' bas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis legs rtogs la/ / chags sdang gi rjes su ma 'brangs par gzu bor gnas pa'i blo yis dpyod/ /bdag gis sgra kā la pa dang*/ tsan+d+ra pa/ dang tshad ma kun las btus dang sde bdun dang bcas pa/ bslabs/ /tshig gi sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas sogs| rnams kyang shes/ /rgyan tshig gi bstan 'chos dbyangs can gyi mgul rgyan dang*/ dan+ḍi la sogs pa/ dang mngon brjod a ma ra ko ṣa dang*/ sna tshogs gsal ba sogs/ phal cher go /'dul ba mdo la sogs pa/ dang ni mngon pa gong 'og gnyis ka dang*/ / pha rol phyin pa'ang 'grel chung mdo 'grel dang bcas pa/ phal cher thos/ /gsang snga gas rgyud sde bzhi po yang*/ / deng sang rgya gar dang bod gnyis kar nyan bshad yod pa phal cher thos/ /thos pa de dag thams cad kyang*/ /ming rkyang tsam du ma bzhag par tshig dang don du bcas pa legs par shes/ go /bye brag smra ba'i bden dang log pa| dang mdo sde pa/ /sems tsam rnam bcas rnam med gnyis ka dang ni dbu ma rang rgyud thal 'gyur gnyis ka yi/ /gdams ngag ji snyed phal cher thos/ /deng sang bod la grags pa yi/ /zhi byed rdzogs chen gcod la sogs/ / jo bo'i gdams ngag skabs brgyad cig car bsgom pa dang*/ /pha rol phyin pa'i blo sbyong dang*/ /bka' gdams gdams ngag pu to ba'i skor dang*/sne zur ba'i/ lugs gnyis dang*/ /sa ra ha dang ti lo pa/ /nag po spyod pa'i do ha dang*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i/ /do ha seng ge zhes bya slob dpon tha ga pa dang*/ dha wu ri pa'i do ha/ sogs/ /do ha'i bye brag du ma thos/ / 'khon gad pa kirti nas brgyud pa'i rim lnga stan thog gcig pa dang*/

/ mes ston tshon po/ dwags po'i slob ma rtsa bzhir dang*| rmog lcog pa nas brgyudapa ste nā ro chos drug lugs gsum dang*/ /gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs// kyi lugs kyi gzhung dang gdams ngag dang*/ de bzhin 'phags skor gyi lugs gnyis kyi gzhung*/ gdams ngag dang*/ /dges pa rdo rje snying po'i gzhung gdams ngag gi skor/ /gshin rje gshed dang 'jigs byed kyi gzhung*/ sogs | | de yi gdams ngag gsar rnying dang*/ / bcas pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i gzhung*/ gdams ngag dang bcas pa/ dang*/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung*/ sbyor drug gdams ngag lugs gsum/ sogs/ /mtshan brjod bshad pa 'grel ba rgyas bsdus gsum/ dbu ma la dga' bas byas pa/ dus 'khor lugs kyi gzhung*/ lam 'bras kyi lugs te/ lugs drug dang*/ /'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ /lam 'bras la sogs lam bskor dgu/ /de las 'phros pa gdams ngag du ma dang || gzhan yang kha rag skor gsum la sogs/ bod dang go rak+ṣa sogs rgya gar la// deng sang grags pa phal mo che/ /bdag gis 'bad de legs par mnyan// bslabs pa de dag ming rkyang min/ / don dang bcas pa legs par go de phyir bod dang rgya gar la yongs su grags pa'i chos rnams phal cher thos/ /des na bdag la phyogs lhung med/ de mi shes pa la phyogs lhug 'ong*/shes na phyogs lhung mi 'ong ba'i phyir ro// de phyir gzu bos dpyad pa 'di/ /blo ldan rnams kyis lugs/ 'di ltar zungs | | thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen nyi ma'i gzhal med khang*/ /log lta'i mun nag tshang tshing rnam par bsal/ /blo gsal blo yi pad+mo kha 'byed pa/ / bstan bcos nyi ma'i snang ba dang chos mthun pa/ deng 'dir bshad/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin zhes/ /'gro la phan pa'i bsam pas bdag gis bshad/ /mkhas pa kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin mod/ /da dung shes rab med pa/ bsod nams chung la zhan pa/ blun po rnams kyis rtogs par dka'/ / shes rab dang bsod nams che ba'i

kun dga'i nyi mas sangs rgyas bstan pa yi/ / pad+mo rnam par phye ba las byung ba'i/ /dam pa'i sbrang rtsis 'gro ba'i bung ba kun | | rgyun du bde ba'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /gang gi thugs brtses nyer bzung nas/ /log pa'i chos rnams spangs nas kyang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang legs sprod pa'i/ /'jam mgon bla ma de la 'dud/ / sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba/ chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par dbye ba'i bstan bcos/ mang du thos pa'i nor dang ldan pa/ rigs pa dang mi rigs pa dpyod par nus pa'i blo gros can/ sde snod 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba rdzogs so// //bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi gnad gtan la dbab pa/ gsang chen yin pas kho bos logs su bshad par blta'o// // 'di nyid kyi ma dpe snga phyir dpar bris mi 'dra ba lnga lag son byung ba dpe gzhi mi 'dra ba rnams rtsa tshig 'dra min sna tshogs 'dug kyang de dag la bris pa'i mchan rnams phal cher gcig mtshungs red/ 'di ni sngon chad rtsa ba'i bla ma ngag blo rdo rje 'chang gis gnang ba'i mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi phyag dpe de nyid gtso bor bzung*/ de la shog ldeb ma tshang ba'i mchan chad rnams gsab 'bri dang*/ mchan thag 'dogs sa sogs legs bcos phran bu dgos rigs rnams ma dpe dag pa dang bsdur bcos kyis zhu dag bgyis so/ /mkhyen rab chos rjes bzhengs pa'i ri sbug bla brang gi sa skya bka' 'bum gyi nang gi rang mchan dbu med bris ma'i mjug tu/ mchan bu 'di nyid rang mchan du grags pa de yin no/ /mchan thag 'dogs sa nor ba dang 'dra mi 'dra mang du snang ste/ kho bos cung zad dag tu song mod/ 'on kyang da dung rang mchan ma dang*/ rang mchan gyi steng du gsung sgros kyi mchan bsnan pa sogs la bltas te zhu dag byed rigs so/ /zhes bkod pa dang*| yang dbu can bris ma zhig gi dbu shog steng du/ bdag nyid chen po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mchan 'di rnams rang 'grel ltar gces pa yin/

zhes bris 'dug pas gzur gnas dpyod ldan rnams yid ches par mdzod cig tshul rgyan pas/ ཾ《zha》ta mchan bu 'di nyid rang mchan du grags pa de yin no mchan thag 'dog sa nor ba dang 'dra mi 'dra mang du snang stai/ kho bos cung zad dag tu song mod 'on kyang*/ da dung rang mchan ma dang*/ mchan rang gi steng du gsung bgros kyis mchan bsnan pa sogs la bltas te zhus dag byed rigs so/ /'di rnams gting du ngor nas kyi phyag dpe la zhu dag byas zer ba la bris pa gong gi ser ma rnams mchan sna srings zer ba rnams yin nam mnyam pa'i lugs lags so// // ཾ ༄༅/ /ston pa blo gros rab gsal gyi dri lan bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta drug cu re gsum pa la mi nyag gi yul byang ngos su phebs/ de'i tshe mdo khams kyi ston pa blo gros rab gsal zhes bya ba chos kyi dri ba zhus pa la | lan 'di ltar gnang nas gzhug lugs kyi don gsal bar mdzad do// dris lan dngos ni/ ston pa blo gros rab gsal gyis/ /dri ba 'bring dar rten bcas pa/ /bdag gi sug par 'phrod gyur pas/ /de la spro ba rab tu 'phel | khyed kyi dri ba dang po rigs gter las/ /gang yod de 'jig bum pa bzhin/ /sgra yang yod ces rang bzhin rtags/ /zhes gsungs pa dang | sdom gsum rab dbye las/ chos dbyings yod pa'ang ma yin te/ / yod tsam mi rtag gis khyab par/ /chos kyi grags pas gsal bar gsungs | | zhes gsungs pa'i don sgra ji bzhin pa lags sam zhes pa ni/ dpal chos kyi grags pas rtog ge'i skabs su/ dom dam don byed nus pa gang*/ /de 'dir don dam yod pa ste//gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa yin// de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /ces don byed nus pa la don dam du yod par dang*/ don byed mi nus pa la kun rdzob tu yod pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad | yang*/ 'jig la 'bras dang yod nyid bzhin/ /zhes sgra 'jig par sgrub pa la 'bras bu rtags su bkod pa dang*/

don gyi yod pa nyid rtags su 'god pa mdzad/ de phyir dngos dngos med rten can/ /phyi rol rten min sgra don la/ /brten nas 'dir ni sgrub pa dang*/ /dgag pa thams cad 'dod pa yin/ /de yang sgra 'jug pa nyid las/ /yod ces tha snyad brten par 'dod/ /ces dang*/ de nyid ni/ med pa ma yin sgra sbyor phyir | | zhes sgra don la yod pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa dang*/ yang*/ de la dmigs rung rnams kyis ni/ /yod pa dmigs pa las gzhan min/ / zhes tshad mas dmigs pa yod pa'i mtshan nyid du gsungs/ de dag gi don yang 'di yin te/ 'dir ni yod pa rnam gnyis te/ /don dang tha snyad dag gis so/ /don gyi yod pas bya ba byed/ /tha snyad yod pas dgag sgrub brten/ /zhes pa'o/ /dri ba gnyis pa/ chos kyi dbyings shes bya ma yin lags sam zhes pa'i lan ni/ rdo rje gcod pa las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /'dren pa rnams ni chos nyid blta/ /chos nyid shes bya ma yin te/ /de ni shes par nus ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod | | ces gsungs pa'i don chos dbyings rang ngos nas shes brjod kyi yul las 'das mod/ gzhan sel gyi sgo nas shes byar tha snyad mdzad de | rgyud bla ma las/ gal te sangs rgyas khams med na/ /sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ /mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang*/ /don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dbus mtha' las/ de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /gzhan min phyin ci log ma yin/ /de 'gags 'phags pa'i spyod yul dang*/ /'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /rnam grangs don de go rim bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang*/

/mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te | de dag gi don ni 'di yin te/ dom dam mtha' bzhi'i spros pa bral/ / kun rdzob yod med la sogs pa'i/ /gzhan sel phan tshun dngos 'gal gcod | | yod pa min la med par gsungs/ /zhes pa'o/ /de'ang rnam 'grel las/ sgrub dang dgag pa ma gtogs pa/ /sgra las byung ba'i tha snyad gzhan/ /yod min de phyir med pa la/ /med phyir de ni mi smra thob/ / ces gsungs so/ /dri ba gsum pa/ 'gog bden ma byas pa'i dge ba lags sam zhes pa ni/ 'gog bden ma byas pa yin mod/ dge ba mtshan nyid par mi bzhed de/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rtsa sher las/ ci ste las rnams ma byas na/ /ma byas pa dang 'phrad 'jig 'gyur/ /tshangs spyod gnas pa ma yin pa/ /de la skyon du gnas par 'gyur/ /tha snyad thams cad nyid dang yang*/ /'gal bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /bsod nams dang ni sdig byed pa'i/ /rnam par dbye ba'ang 'thad mi 'gyur/ /gal te de ni rnam smin na/ /yang dang yang du rnam smin 'gyur/ /zhes ma byas pa'i dge sdig mtshan nyid pa yod pa bkag par shes par bya'o/ /blo gros ldan pa'i blo gros gyis/ /tshul bzhin dris pa'i dri ba kun/ /kun dga'i ming gis kun mkhyen ltar/ /legs par phye la legs par gzigs/ /mdo smad kyi ston pa blo gros rab gsal gyi dris lan bi ji rin chen grags kyis gling khar bris pa'o zhes so// //yang mdo smad kyi lam du rnal 'byor pa phru ma pa zhes pas dris pa'i lan gsungs pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas hor yul du phyag phebs pas mdo smad kyi lam khar chibs gong du byon nas lam la gshegs pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pa phru ma pa zhes bya ba'i sgom chen pa bzang po gcig gis/ chos rje pa la gos phyi nang gcig phul nas/ chos rje pa khyed kyi chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos las/

blun pos phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /min na gzugs med khams su skye/ /yang na nyan thos 'gog par lhung*/ /gal te de ni bsgom legs kyang*/ /dbu ma'i sgom las 'da' ba med/ /dbu ma'i sgom de bzang mod kyi/ /'on kyang 'grub pa shin tu dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ci lags zhu yin 'dug pa la/ chos rje pa'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung bar gda'/ rnam rtog kha 'tshoms zhi gnas dang*/ btsan thabs su ci yang yid la mi sems par sems lteng nge rgyun du mi gnas shing gnyid rmugs 'dren pa'o/ / stong pa thal byung lhag mthong gnyis/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis ma dpyad par snang zhen gyi chos ci yang med par 'dzin pa dang mthong yul 'gags pa'i stong nyams shar ba'o/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis/rmongs pa'i bsgom pa gang yin pa// rmongs pas rmongs pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na/ /shes rab chung rnams 'phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ / ngan 'gror ltung ba'i rgyu chen te/ /legs 'dod rnams kyis spangs na legs/ /sems rgyu mi gsal zhi gnas dang*/ sems kyi rgyu ba mi gsal bar lhag mthong shas chung ba'i stobs kyis ngang gis dmigs pa la gnas pa'o/ / gzugs snang bkag pa'i lhag mthong gnyis/ 'di'i don mngon pa la sogs par gsal/ ma dpyad par chos thams cad nam mkha' dang*/ sems ci yang med pa dang*/ yod min med min ngo 'phrod nas nyams shar ba'o// gzugs med skye ba'i rgyu chen te/ gzugs med du skye ba'i mi g.yo ba'i las sog pa'o// thar 'dod rnams kyis spangs na legs/ /dran tshor med pa'i zhi gnas dang | ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshe ci yang mi dran par yun ring du gnas pa'o/ / tshogs drug bkag pa'i lhag mthong gnyis/ mig la sogs pa'i rnam shes tshogs drug rgyu ba mi gsal ba'o/ / nyan thos 'gog pa cha mthun te/

'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang 'brel ba'i nyams skyes pa'o// mchog 'dod rnams kyis spangs na legs/ /shin sbyangs bde ldan zhi gnas dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de nas de yi lus dang sems/ /shin tu sbyangs pa che thob nas//yid la byed dang bcas zhes bya//zhes gsungs so// spros kun nyer zhi'i lhag mthong gnyis/ ār+ya de ba'i zhal snga nas/yod min med min yod med min//gnyis ka'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min/ /mtha' bzhi las grol don gyi mchog /de ni dbu ma pa yis rig /ces gsungs so/ / phar phyin theg pa'i lam chen te/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis bsgru bas na legs/ /mtshan rtog nyer zhi'i zhi gnas dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ tha mal kun rtog rgyu ni ma gtogs pa/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba gzhan ni yod min te/ / de dang rnam pa 'gal bar gyur pa'i sems/ /gang yin der ni kun rtog snang mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs| | bde stong zung 'jug lhag mthong gnyis/ spyan ras gzigs pad dkar gyis| phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das//pra phab pa yi rnam pa can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa//

phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gsang sngags phyag chen lam mchog ste | | tshe 'dir grol 'dod bsgrubs na legs/ / tshigs su bcad pa lnga po 'di'i don khong du chud na phyag rgya chen po dag pa dang ma dag pa shes par 'gyur bas 'di la dpyod mdzod gsung gin 'dug rnal 'byor pa phru ma pa la gdams pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa bi jis mdo smad gling khar bris pa'o/ /mchan bu 'di yang chos rje pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin du bi jis bris pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ / dris lan gyi rim pa gsum po 'di sngon chad dar ba ma byung yang*/ mdo khams nas rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dbang phyug gi phyag tu byung ba las bris pa yin no// // yang mdo srang du phebs pa'i tshe/ mi gcig gis dar nag po gcig la gser gyi theg le mang du byas pa gcig phyag rten la byung*/ de lha rje bi ji la gnang nas khyod rang tshags gyis gsungs/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la skar ma bkra ba lta bu'i bstan pa zhig 'o cag la 'ong ba yin gsung*/ sa skya pas ring bsrel bkag zer ba yod pa la/ de yang*/ ring bsrel phal cher gdon las byung*/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyis byas pa'ang srid/ / 'byung bzhi dag gis bskyed pa'ang yod/ /'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel ni/ /yon tan stobs kyis 'byung ba ste/ /'byung khungs las byung rin chen yin/ /de la grangs ni rtsi ru med/ /mi 'grib 'phel ba'i rig bsrel yin/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ nga la rten byon na grangs rtsi ru med pa zhig byon pa yin te/ khyod rang tshags gyis la dar 'dis de'i na bzar gyis gsungs/ ngas ku re byas pa yin mi la ma zlo sdig pa sog pa'i rgyu yin zhes gyur gsungs so/ /dge'o// // ༄༅/ /mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi rtsa ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ bita ga tā a ba ta ra dwā ra/ bod skad du/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dpal la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/don bzang chos spobs nges tshig dri ma med/ /rang gzhan don brnyes spangs dang nges par 'byung*/ /ston pa'i chos smra seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa'i | | 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'ga' zhig sgra dang rnam pa dbye ba dang*/ khams dang byed tshig dpe dang tshig gi rgyan/ / dbye bsdu grangs dang nges pa go rim la/ /'di la ( na ) phal cher rmongs par mthong nas 'di/ /mang du thos shing mthong nas goms pa dang*/ /man ngag dbang gis dpal ldan kun dga' yi/ /rgyal mtshan 'di na 'ga' tsam 'chad pa la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dga' ba bskyed de nyon/ /mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ /bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes pa/ /de yang de la mkhas pa yin/ /de yul brda sprod rtog ge dang*/ /gso ba phyi nang rig ces gsungs/ /gzhan las gzhan dag rnam bshad pa/ /'di yi nang du 'dus shes bya/ /bstan bcos byed pa'i dam pa yis/ /ston pa la ni mchod brjod bya/ /bstan pa spel phyir dag pa'i tshig /'di la 'thad pa bzang po mthong*/ /mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can/ /shis par brjod sogs mi 'gal te/ /thams cad du yang ston pa yi/ /che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir ro/ /dam bca' ba dang bskul tshig sogs/ /'chad phyir spro ba ston pa ste/ /mchog rtogs 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ khas len pa la 'gal ba med/ /nus pa med kyang 'bad bzhin du/ /bstan bcos la yang 'jug pa'i tshig /bstan bcos dang ni ston byed pa/ /gnyis ka dam par bstan phyir yin/ /bshad sla ba dang gzung bde zhing*/ /bstan bcos la yang rtsod bral phyir/ /mkhas pa la la bstan bcos lus/ /bsdus te thog mar dgod par mdzad/ / bstan bcos dam par bstan pa'i phyir/ /ston pas thog mar dgos pa bstan | | yongs su rtog pas de mthong na/ /dpyod pa la yang cis mi 'jug | dngos su brjod 'dod mi ston cing*/ /brjod pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /yi ge zhes bshad dbyangs gsal byed/

/de yi dbye bsdu 'dir ma bshad/ /yi ge 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /don gyi ngo bo brda sprod pa// ming yin de yi khyad par dag /ston pas tshig ces rab tu bshad/ / de dag phan tshun sbyar ba las/ /brjod 'dod gsal bar ston te ngag /de bsags pa las rab byed sogs/ /chos kyi phung po'i bar du'ang 'grub | | ming tshig de dag rgan po yis/ /thog mar sbyar ba brda yin la// phyi nas dpyod pa tha snyad yin/ /de yi dang po 'dod rgyal sgra/ /de la brten nas phyi nas don/ /gzhan la sgro 'dogs rjes sgrub sgra/ /brda sprod byed pa 'dod rgyal sgra/ /don chen sgrub pa ma gtogs pa/ /slan chad mi sbyar don de la/ /brda 'jug na yang mi rtogs phyir/ /brda yi khyad par gzhan dag tu | | ma grags gzhan du grags pa la/ /de ltar mi bsam gzhan dag tu// grags pa grags pa nyid du gsal/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya'i ngor | | 'jig rten bstan bcos la med pa'i/ /brda ni skye bo'i spyod yul min | | kun mkhyen dgongs pa bsam mi khyab/ /sngon chad gzhan du ma grags kyang*/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis ngo 'phrod pa'i/ /brda ni rjes sgrub nyid yin te/ /rgyu mtshan dag la ltos phyir ro/ /rjes su mtshungs dang log pa yis/ /rjes su sgrub pa rnam pa gnyis/ /phan tshun 'brel ba la sogs pa | | rgyu mtshan 'ga' la ltos nas de/ /de yang grags 'jug 'gal ba dang | | mi 'gal 'gal zhing mi 'gal ba'i/ /sgra yi 'jug tshul rnam pa bzhi || brda sprod byed pa rnams la grags/ /sbyar ba snga ma sngon 'gro can/ / de yi rgyu mtshan mi 'jug cing*/ /brjod 'dod kho nas dbang bsgyur ba/ / log par sgrub pa yin par 'dod/ /dga' dang smre dang ngo mtshar dang*/ / sil snyan la sogs mi 'gal sgra/ /nye bar mtshon sgra gang ston pa/ /rjes su byed pa'i sgra zhes bshad/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg pa dang*/ /sems las byung ba'i khyad par 'ga'/ /phyogs gcig nges par mi nus pa/

/ ston te nye bar sbyor ba'i sgra/ /de sogs sbyor ba'i ngag phal cher/ /nye bar ston na zlos sgra 'jug /don la 'jug pa'i sgra ji snyed/ /de kun rigs dang ming du 'dus/ /de ma yin las log pa can/ /rnam pa kun tu spyi 'dra ba | | phan tshun blang dor mtshungs grub pa/ /de ston byed pa rigs kyi sgra/ / don la dmigs nas mtshon bya ste/ /de yi don ldog mtshan nyid yin/ /rgyu mtshan med pa'am yod kyang rung*/ /log pa'i rgyu mtshan yin yang bla/ / mtshan nyid don la ma ltos pa'i/ /btags pa thams cad ming gi sgra/ / dam pa'i don du dgag sgrub med/ /tha snyad pa la rang spyi gnyis/ /rang mtshan 'dzin pa snang ba la/ /spyi 'dzin pa ni gzhan sel yin/ /gzhan sel la ni dgag sgrub gnyis/ /sgrub pa yod dang yin pa ste/ /dgag pa med dang ma yin dgag /'ga' zhig 'gog pa sgrub pa'i tshig /la la sgrub pa dgag sgra can/ kha cig don bzhin 'jug pas na/ /phal cher gnas skabs gtso bo yin/ /ming sgrub pa la su ban+ta/ /de la rnam dbye nyi shu bzhi/ /ngo bo bya byed dgos pa dang*/ /'byung khungs 'brel gnas bod pa'i tshig /gcig gnyis mang pos rnam dbye bas/ /rnam par dbye ba nyi shu bzhi | | dbyangs yig so so'i mtha' can la/ /rtags gsum so so'i rab dbye bas/ /rnam dbye tha dad rab sbyar nas/ /don gcig rnam par sgrub bo zhes || legs par sbyar ba'i rjes 'gro ba'i/ /brda sprod pa dag de skad smra// 'dir ni mi nus mi dgos la/ /rnam par dbye la rang gnas min/ /sbyor ba dag kyang tha dad pas/ /don de'i spros pa re zhig bzhag /'di ni grong khyer ba yi sgra/ /rnam pa kun tu ring thung med/ /rtags kyang kun tu 'chol ba dang*/ /nges pa dag kyang ma mdzad mod/ /de lta na yang brjod 'dod dang || shugs kyis rnam par dbye ba'i tshig /don gcig na yang sgra 'gyur ba || mthar gnas yi ge'i stobs las 'byung*/ /'di 'dra'i sgra sbyor mkhas rnams la/

/sngon chad grags pa kho nar zad/ /'ga' zhig 'khrul par dogs pa'i phyir/ /'bad pa yis kyang gzhan du bsgyur/ /la la grags pa'i bye brag gis/ /rnam par dbye ba bsnol ma mdzad/ /de lta na yang de dag nyid/ /gzhan du sbyar yang mi 'gal phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis 'brel med pa/ /des na brjod 'dod kho nar grub/ /brjod 'dod stobs kyis grangs gsum dang*/ /rtags gsum la yang 'chol ba mthong*/ /de 'phen byed pa tshig gi rkyen/ /dngos sam mi mngon pas kyang 'grub/ /ring thung drag zhan la sogs sgra/ /don la 'jug pa yod mod kyi/ /skabs kyis rtogs par dgongs nas de/ /dngos su bkod pa btang snyoms mdzad/ khams sgrub pa ni ti ngan ste/ /de la skyes bu rnam pa gsum/ /mdor na rnam dbyes ming sgrub cing*/ /byed pa'i tshig gis khams bsgrubs nas/ /brjod bya ston pa'ang ngag ces bshad/ /'di dag brda sprod byed pa'i gzhi/ /rang bzhin yon tan las rnams la/ /ngo bo bstod smad brjod pa'i tshul/ /drang po zur mig tshig dang don/ /dngos shugs dpe yi sgo nas de/ /sgro btags nas ni tshig gi rgyan/ /nyams dgu'i ro dang sbyar te spel/ /sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje ngam dang zhi ba dgu /'chi med mdzod las brgyad du bsdus/ /sgeg pa lus ngag cha lugs dang*/ /yul sogs mdzes pa'i khyad par yin/ / dpa' ba 'jigs med brtul zhugs yin/ /dbye na sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs | | dam pa'i chos yin g.yul ngor dgra/ /'joms pa la sogs 'jig rten pa'i/ /dpa' ba yin par shes par bya/ /mi sdug pa ni mdzes pa 'gog /de yang lus ngag cha lugs dang*/ /yul sogs sgo nas rnam par dbye/ /dgod pa bzhad gad 'byin pa'i tshig /lus ngag cha lugs rnam 'gyur dang*/ /spyod tshul yon tan skyon rnams kyi/ /sgo nas gzhan la 'phya ba yin/ /drag shul rtsub par spyod pa ste/ /sgrib pa rnam gnyis bag chags dang*/

/bcas pa 'bad pas 'joms pa sogs/ /chos yin pha rol gnon pa dang*/ /lus ngag yid kyi rtsub pa'i chos/ /'jig rten pa yi drag shul yin/ /'jigs rung bag 'khums byed pa'i tshul/ /lus ngag rnam 'gyur mi bzad pa/ /sbyin sogs spyad par dka' ba chos/ /de las gzhan pa 'jig rten pa/ /snying rje brtsi ba bskyed pa'i sems/ /dman pa mthong dang rgyal sras kyi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa ngo mtshar can/ /thos pas snying rje khyad par skye/ /ngam pa gzhan las 'phags pa'i sems/ /'jig rten pa yi 'byor pa dang*/ /mkhas pa'i yon tan phun tshogs pas/ /pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /zhi ba nga rgyal bcom pa'i chos/ /ngam pa bzlog pa nyid la 'dod/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan la mi sdug dang*/ /drag shul ngam pa'i rgyan mi sbyar/ /dpa' ba'i rgyan la dgod pa dang*/ /snying rje zhi ba'i rgyan rnams spang*/ /mi sdug pa la sgeg pa dang*/ /snying rje zhi ba'i rgyan mi sbyar | | dgod pa'i rgyan la drag shul dang*/ /'jigs rung snying rje zhi ba spang | | drag shul 'jigs rung rnam gnyis la'ang*/ /de bzhin snying rje zhi ba spang*/ /snying rje zhi ba rnam gnyis la/ /sgeg dang dpa' dgod drag shul dang || 'jigs rung ngam pa drug po spang*/ /ngam pa'i rgyan la snying rje dang*// zhi ba gnyis ni rnam par spang*/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan la snying rje dang*/ /ngam dang zhi ba 'jug pa srid/ /dpa' ba'i rgyan la drag shul dang*/ /'jigs rung ngam pa'i rgyan mi 'gal/ /mi sdug pa la drag shul dang*/ /'jigs rung skabs 'gar 'gal ba med/ /snying rje zhi ba'i rgyan phan tshun/ /skabs kyis 'gal ba med pa'ang srid/ /dgod pa'i rgyan la sgeg cing dpa'/ / mi sdug ngam pa'i rgyan sbyor srid/ /drag shul 'jigs rung rnam gnyis la// dpa' dang mi sdug ngam pa 'jug /ngam pa'i rgyan la sgeg cing dpa'/ / dgod cing drag shul 'jigs rung 'jug /sgeg dgod ngam pa rnam gsum la | | bsgyings dang 'phyar dang zil gnon dang*/

/dpe rgyan sgro btags sna tshogs pa/ /rol cing sgeg pa'i tshig rgyan 'jug /dpa' drag 'jigs rung rnam gsum la/ khams gsum za ba'i ngang tshul can/ /ngo bo nyid kyis 'jigs rung ba/ /spu zing zhes ni byed pa'i chos/ /rtsub pa'i tshig rgyan sbyar bar bya/ /mi sdug pa ni lus ngag yid/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi | | skyon dang 'brel ba'i ngang tshul can/ /yid 'byung byed pa'i tshul yin no | | dgod pa'i rgyan la rang bzhin dang*/ /bsgrubs pa las byung rnam pa gnyis | | rang bzhin phal cher blun po la/ /bsgrubs pa mkhas pa rnams la yod/ /snying rje zhi ba rnam gnyis la/ /sgeg cing dpa' ba la sogs pa'i | | tshig rgyan sbyar na gnyis po 'jig /de phyir bcos ma'i dpe rgyan spang | | sgeg sogs rnams la zhi ba'i dpe/ /mi 'jug zhi la sgeg sogs bzhin | | de bzhin phan tshun 'gal ba'i dpe/ /kun la rang gis brtags te sbyar/ /dpe yi rgyan rnams phal cher ni/ /rang gi chos dang mthun par sbyar | | dpe don 'brel bar ma gyur na/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis smad pa srid | | grags pa'i dpe la dkar ba dang*/ /mtho dang 'od dang ba dan sogs | | sbyar zhes dbyangs can mgul rgyan smra/ /dpa' la seng ge stag la sogs/ /zhum pa wa skyes ce spyang sogs/ /mkhas pa 'jam dbyangs stobs sred med/ /blun la ba lang zhe sdang sbrul/ /gsal ba skye rgu'i sgron me sogs/ /rgyas par sbyar zhes mkhas rnams smra/ /tshig kyang tshogs par dbyung bya ba/ /legs par sbyar dgos smad pa'i tshig /snyan ngag mkhan gyis spang bar bya/ /dper na mchog lus nyer gnas dang*/ /bskul dang yang zhing g.yo sogs bzhin/ /bstan bcos byed pas tshigs bcad dang*// rkyang pa dang ni spel ba gsum/ /tshigs bcad lung la grags pa dang*/ / sdeb sbyor mkhan la grags pa gnyis/ /lung la rkang pa gnyis pa nas/ / brtsams te drug gi bar du bshad/ /sdeb sbyor tshigs bcad rkang bzhi pa// 'jug dang rigs kyis dbye bas gnyis/

/snyan ngag la ni lus dang rgyan// rnam pa gnyis su bsdus te bshad/ /tshigs bcad gcig gis brjod bya'i don || rdzogs pa grol ba yin par 'dod/ /tshigs bcad phan tshun 'dus pa las/ /brjod bya rtogs pa rigs 'brel yin/ /gnas skabs gcig la yul tha dad/ /bya ba tha dad ston pa mdzod/ /yul gcig bya ba du ma yis | | bsngags pa tshogs pa yin par bshad/ /tshig don phun sum tshogs gyur cing*/ /skyon med mkhas pa mgu byed na/ /yon tan 'ga' zhig ma tshang yang*/ /snyan ngag skyon can min par bshad/ /gtso bo'i yon tan sngar brjod nas/ /de yis dgra zla zil gnon pa/ /phyi nas 'chad pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan rnams kun la grags/ /rigs rgyud shes rab thos sogs kyis/ /dgra yi yon tan sngar brjod nas/ /phyi nas de nyid zil gnon pa'i/ /skyon yon brjod la 'ga' zhig dga'/ /de lta'i tshigs bcad sbyor ba la/ /bai dhar+bha dang gau ḍa ba'i/ /tshig gi sbyor tshul rnam pa gnyis/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas la grags/ /dang po 'jam zhing cung zad zhi/ /gnyis pa gsang mtho cung zad rtsub/ /bai dhar+bha la yon tan bcu/
