/yon tan 'di bcu phal che ba/ /bzlog pa gau ḍa ba zhes bshad | | shin tu grags pa ma yin pa'i/ /tshig sbyor legs zhes gau ḍa 'dod || chings dang yi ge mtshungs pa yi/ /tshig sbyor rjes su mtshungs zhes bya || yi ge 'khor mo mtshungs pa la/ /snga ma'i 'du byed nyams myong ba/ /mi ring bar gnas tshig mi rtsub/ /de ni shin tu gzhon zhes bya/ /chings la gcam bu'i skyon mthong gi /mnyen pa'i sgo nas skyon ma yin/ /'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /yang dag gtod par byed pa dang*/ /cig car du ni chos du ma/ /brtags pa'ang ting nge 'dzin du brjod/ /tshig rgyan sbyor ba 'di rnams ni/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bstan/ /mnyam gzhag ces bya'i tshigs bcad rgyan/ /snyan ngag mkhan rnams thams cad 'dod || 'di dag gcig gi khyad par gyis/ /dbye na shin tu mang mod kyi// mngar ba'i ngo bo'i khyad par ltar/ /dbye ba dka' phyir 'dir ma bshad/ / ngo bos dngos su bsngags pa ni/ /rang bzhin brjod dang rigs yin te/ / de sogs de yi rgyan bshad bya/ /de lta'i dpe yi rab dbye ba/ /sngon gyi mkhas pas 'di ltar bshad/ /chos dang dngos po bzlog pa dang*/ /phan tshun dpe dang nges pa'i dpe/ /nges pa med dang sdud pa'i dpe/ /de sogs dpe ni spros te bshad/ /mtshungs dang 'dra dang ji ltar sogs/ /mnyam dang rjes mtshungs rjes su 'dra/ /de yi 'gran zla dgra zla dang*/ /rigs mthun rjes su sgrub la sogs/ /rang bzhin mtshungs dang gzugs brnyan sogs | | mtshan nyid gcig dang mthun phyogs dang*/ /dpe dang dper bya rtags mtshungs dang*/ /gnas mtshungs dang ni mtshungs pa dang*/ /'gran dang zil gyis mnan pa dang*/ /sgra sgrogs pa dang yal bar dor/ /gdung bar byed dang sma 'bebs dang*/ /dgod dang phrag dog mi bzod dang*/ / de yi skal bzang 'phrog pa dang*/ /de yi mdzes dang sbed la sogs/ / mtshungs las de ni gong du brgal/ /de yi rkang rjes rkang pas 'jog

/de yi gnas la brgal ba sogs/ /mtshungs pa gsal bar byed pa yin/ / rtag tu sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sras/ /rnam pa kun tu mchod byed cing*/ / skye ba kun tu sangs rgyas kyi/ /snyan ngag mkhan du 'gyur bar shog /mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo las rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i le'u ste dang po'o || || ༈ 'chad byed bshad par bya ba'i yul/ /bshad par bya ba rnam pa gsum || gtsang mkhas gzhan la phan par 'dod/ /blo gsal shes 'dod bla mar gus/ /lung rigs rjes su gdams pa'o/ /sgo gsum kun spyod rnam dag pas/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas bsgrub/ /bsdus pa'i don la rnam pa gnyis/ /ngag don bsdus te bstan pa dang*/ /gzhung don so so'i bsdus don no/ /don 'dus tshig gsal brjod pa bde/ /ngag nyung tshig snyoms gzung ba sla/ /bsdus don nyid kyis gzhung go ba/ /de 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas/ /de yi skyes bu la sogs pa/ /tshig sdud pa yi sbyor ba yin/ /de dag phye na mang 'gyur la/ /bsdus na nyung phyir 'dir ma bshad | | gzhung lugs gang dang gang 'chad pa/ /byed pa'i tshig gis rab sbyar te/ /tshig don legs par sbrel nas ni/ /'chad pa brda sprod byed pa'i lugs/ /las dang byed po bya ba yi/ /tshig don sbrel la ngag don blang | | thog mar sgra la mkhas pa yis/ /tshig don rnam par phye ste bstan// de nas don la mkhas pa yis/ /lhag chad 'khrul pa med par bshad/ / gcig la du ma du ma gcig 'gyur zhing*/ /du ma du ma gcig la gcig gi cha | | rkyen dang phrad na gzhan dang gzhan 'gyur ba/ /lugs 'di mkhas pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /gang gang de dang de la sogs/ /snga ma'i tshig gis phyi ma 'dren/ /skabs su 'brel ba med pa'i ming*/ /snang na de ni bod sgra yin/ /'chad pa'i skyon rnams spangs nas ni/ /shin tu brtse ba'i bsam pas bshad/ /nyan pa'i skyon rnams spangs nas ni/ /shes par 'dod pas legs par mnyan/

/zhum la gzengs bstod rgod pa la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs par bshad | | rmugs pa rnams ni ngo mtshar gyi/ /gtam bshad nas ni nyan du gzhug | blo chen rnams la zab rgya che/ /blo chung gzung bde go sla ba/ / phyi nas tshig don 'brel chags nas/ /don phra 'gal 'brel dpyad cing bshad | | de las bzlog na mkhas rmongs kyis/ /slob ma dga' ba skyed mi nus | | gzhung lugs phal cher mi shes na/ /'chad pa sbyangs pa chung ba'i skyon | | gzhung don go yang tshig 'ga' zhig /ma rtogs de yi rgyu mtshan brtag | legs par sbyar la ma grags pa'i/ /sgra yi sbyor ba rtogs par dka' | | de phyir 'chi med mdzod la sogs/ /legs par shes na the tshom med | | bod kyi skad la mi shes pa/ /phal cher thos pa chung ba'i skyon/ / 'ga' zhig 'gyur gyi bye brag dang*/ /yul skad dag gis bsgribs pa yod// 'ga' zhig rnam grangs nor ba dang*/ /la las sa mtshams 'chugs pa dang | | la la mun sprul gyis bslad pas/ /log par bsgyur ba go ba dka' | | la la sngon rabs las byung ba'i/ /gtam rgyud legs par mi shes pas/ /ming gi rgyu mtshan ma rtogs nas/ /log par bsgyur ba cung zad mthong*/ /'ga' zhig bod la go bde'i phyir/ /legs par sbyar la med na yang*/ /cung zad lhag par bsgyur ba yod/ /de la mkhas pas bshad mi dgos/ /'ga' zhig dogs pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rnam grangs zlos par bshad na yang*/ /de dag skyon du mi gzung ste/ /dgos pa mthong nas bshad phyir ro/ /'ga' zhig gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bzlas pa'i tshig don sbyor bar byed/ /gzhan yang bstan bcos chen po las/ /dpe dang tshig sbyar mang bshad pa/ /de dag kyang ni mdor bsdus te/ /bshad par bya ba cung zad nyon/ /sgra dang don gyi dbye ba yis/ /mtshams sbyar ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /don ni mdor bstan rgyas bshad dam/ /'gal 'brel sgo nas mtshams sbyor byed/ /brgal lan sgo nas gzhung gi don/ /lung dang rigs pas gtan la dbab/

/mtha' drug gang gis shes pa de/ / gzhung bshad pa la shin tu mkhas/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun la brtse ba yis/ /chos ltar bcos pa thams cad sun phyung ste/ /thub pa'i gsung rab legs par bshad pa yis/ /dge legs chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo las bshad pa la 'jug pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //༈ 'bel ba'i gtam la sbyor dngos rjes/ /sbyor ba rtsod pa'i lam sbyang phyir/ /rgol ba gnyis dang dpang po rnams/ /nges par byas nas brtsad la 'jug /rgol ba gnyis dang dpang po la/ /tshar gcad gnas ni bcu drug zer/ /la la dpang po mi dgos zer/ /mkhas pa'i dpang pos ma phye na/ /rgol ba'i mkhas rmongs mi shes pas/ /rtsod pa'i rigs par dgos par gsungs/ /dam bca' la gnod dam bca' gzhan/ /dam bca' 'gal dang dam bca' sel/ /gtan tshigs gzhan dang don gzhan dang | | don med pa dang don mi shes/ /don bral dus la ma bab dang*/ / ma tshang lhag dang yang brjod dang*/ /rjes su mi smra mi shes dang*/ /spobs pa med dang rnam g.yeng dang*/ /'dod pa khas len brgal brtag 'dor/ / rjes su sbyor med la sbyor dang*/ /grub mtha' nyams dang rtags ltar snang | | thub pa rkang mig gis bshad pa'i/ /tshar gcad nyi shu rtsa gnyis yin | | de la dpal ldan grags pa yis/ /'ga' zhing tshar gcad min par bshad/ /tshad gcad yin na gnyis por sdud/ /phrad dang ma phrad gtan tshigs dang*/ /rtags dang ma smras ma skyes dang*/ /'bras bu chos mthun mi mthun dang*/ /rnam rtog khyad par dmigs pa dang*/ /the tshom don go thal 'gyur rnams/ /kun las btus yin rigs brtags la/ / 'phel 'grib brjod dang ma brjod dang*/ /rigs pa dang ni so so'i dpe// bsgrub bya mi rtag rab byed dang*/ /dus 'das mtshungs pa'i ltag chod ni// nyi shu rtsa bzhi phyogs glang gis/ /bkag phyir grags pas btang snyoms mdzad | | tshar gcad gnyis las phye bas bzhi/ /nyid yin de las gzhan mi dgos/

/chos dang mthun pa'i rtsod pa la/ /log rtog bzlog phyir brtsad bya yi/ /chags sdang dbang gis rgyal 'dod dang*/ /pha rol pham pa bskyed phyir min/ /des na mkhas pas grub mtha'i skyon/ /gzu bor brjod pas tshar gcad kyi/ /gang zag skyon dang bdag bstod pa/ /ngan 'gro'i rgyu phyir mkhas pas smad/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir dam pas kyang*/ /g.yo sgyus smra ba 'thad ce na/ /g.yo sgyus bstan pa 'dzin mi nus/ /de 'dra rtsod pa'i rigs par bkag /rgol ba rnam gnyis rang rang gi /grub mtha' bzung nas rtsod pa ni/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs/ /phyir rgol grub mtha' mi 'dzin par/ /rgol ba'i grub mtha' sun 'byin pa/ /rigs pa'i gzhung lugs 'ga' la snang*/ /gal te grub mtha' khas len yang*/ / gzhung nas bshad pa'i grub mtha' kun/ /rtsod pa'i skabs su blang mi dgos | | rtsod pa'i skabs kyi grub mtha' nyid/ /sgrub pa mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs/ /dper na phyi rol don sgrub tshe/ /rnam rig gzhung gis 'dir mi gnod/ /de bzhin grub mtha' kun la sbyar/ /lung dang rigs pa'i rtsod pa gnyis/ /legs par shes na mtshungs mod kyi/ /gzhal bya gnyis la mngon sum dang*/ /rjes su dpag pa'i rigs pas gnod/ /gzhal bya gsum pa dpyod pa na/ /rang rang lung dang 'gal na gnod/ /dper na chags sogs sdig pa dang*/ /chags bral chos su 'chad bzhin du/ khrus kyis sdig pa 'dag pa dang*/ /'tshe ba chos su smra ba bzhin/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /nyan thos dang ni theg chen gnyis/ / rnam gzhag phar cher mi mthun pas/ /de dag kyang ni 'gal zhe na/ /gang zag gzhug pa'i rim pa dang*/ /'chad tshul shes na 'gal ba med/ /'di 'dra'i rnam gzhag mi shes pa/ /'gal bar bsams nas rtsod mod kyi/ / legs par shes na 'gal ba med/ /theg pa 'gal ba ltar snang ba/ /gang zag rim gyis gzhug phyir gsungs/ /pha dang ma ni bsad bya sogs/ / las dang nyon mongs sogs la dgongs/

/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po sogs/ /bdag 'dzin can rnams drang phyir yin/ /bsad pas byang chub thob pa sogs/ /sgra de bdag 'dzin gsod la 'jug /de 'dra'i 'gal bas rtsod pa la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis lan 'di gdab/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /lung la rtsod pa'i gnas skabs su/ /lung gi don la 'dri ba'am/ /min yang shin tu lkog gyur gyi/ /don la 'dri ba 'gal ba med/ /mdo las lan gdab rnam bzhir gsungs/ /mgo gcig rnam phye dri dang bzhag /rim bzhin 'chi dang skye ba dang*/ /bzang dang bdag gi yon tan sogs/ /lung gi skabs su 'di 'dra yi/ /rtsod pa'i lan la 'gal ba med/ /rigs pa la yang mi 'gal mod/ /'on kyang blun pos go bar dka'/ /yang na lung gi lan rnam gnyis/ /lung ngam lung la brten pa yi/ /rigs pa nyid kyis de bzlog bya/ /lung yang gang la rtsod pa yi/ /skabs dang 'brel ba de lung yin/ /skabs min rgol ba mi 'dod pa'i/ /lung gzhan 'gal yang skyon ma yin/ /dper na nyan thos theg chen dang*/ /rnam rig ngo bo nyid med sogs/ /phan tshun 'gal yang skyon min bzhin/ /rang 'dod lung dang 'gal gyur na/ /de yi dgongs pa phye ste bshad/ /gal te dgongs pa mi shes na/ /tshar gcad pa yi gnas su 'gyur/ /bsdu ba'i tshigs bcad do/ /rigs pa'i sgo nas rtsod pa na/ / grub mtha'i rjes su 'brang mi 'brang*/ /rnam par phye ste gsal bar rtsod/ / grub mtha'i rjes su mi 'brangs na/ /de yi rtsod gzhi nges byas pas/ /phal cher grub mtha'i phyogs su ltung*/ /grub mtha'i phyogs su mi ltung na/ /de yi phyogs snga nges byas pas/ /phal cher blun po'i rigs par 'gyur/ / mkhas na grub mtha' 'ga' zhig gi /rjes su mi 'jug mi srid do/ /gal te khas blangs gtan mi 'dod/ /de la brtags nas gnyis su 'gyur/ / spros bral yin phyir mi 'dod na/ /shes na dbu ma'i grub mthar 'gyur/ / yod kyang khas len mi nus na/ /de ni ngan g.yo'i lta bar bshad/

/ces bya ba bsdu ba'i tshigs bcad do/ /la la grub mtha' mi 'dra ba/ /phan tshun bsres pa'i grub mtha' 'dod/ /skyon can yin na so sor dgag /skyon med na ni de rjes 'brang*/ /mkhas pas 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' ni/ / sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs gnyis/ /de las gzhan pa blun po yis/ /glo bur brtags pa'i grub mtha' yin/ /gangs can 'di na de las gzhan/ / blun po'i grub mtha' mang mod kyi/ /de ni blun por go sla'i phyir/ /mkhas pas phal cher btang snyoms bzhag /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /mu stegs byed la rtog ge lnga/ /rig byed grangs can 'ug phrug pa/ /zad byed tshu rol mdzes pa 'o/ /snga ma gsum po rig byed 'dzin/ /phyi ma rnam gnyis rig byed 'dor/ /bdag yod par ni thams cad mthun/ /lta ba'i bye brag gzhan mi 'dra/ /bod kyi rtog ge ba rnams ni/ /'di yi rnam gzhag 'khrugs pa mang*/ /de phyir de dag gis spel ba'i/ /bstan bcos bden par gzung mi bya/ /sangs rgyas pa la grub mtha' bzhi/ /bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnam rig ngo bo nyid med smra/ /'di dag gi ni dbye ba la/ / grub mtha'i dbye ba ci rigs yod/ /rgyas par grub mtha' rnam 'byed ltos || de dag grub mtha' khas len na/ /thog mar rtsod gzhi nges par bya// mu stegs byed dang nyan thos rnams/ /phyi rol don 'dod de dag dang*/ / rtsod na phyi rol don khas blang*/ /min na rtsod gzhi mi mthun pas/ /rtsod pa'i gnas skabs 'jug par dka'/ /phyi rol dpyod na mdo sde pa'i/ / grub mtha' dngos po'i stobs zhugs yin/ /de phyir mkhas pa thams cad kyi | | gzhung lugs thams cad de ltar yod/ /'di la sems tsam phyi rol don | khas blangs yin zhes bod rnams sgrogs/ /rtag dngos bzhin te 'di mi srid/ /mdo sde pa la btags par zad/ /phyi rol don rnams 'gog pa na/ /rnam rig dngos po stobs zhugs yin/ /chos nyid gtan la 'bebs pa na/

/dbu ma'i gtan tshigs dngos stobs yin/ kha cig grub mtha' khas len na/ /dngos po stobs zhugs med ces zer/ /ma yin dngos po'i stobs med na/ /rigs pa'i dgag sgrub ji ltar 'thad/ / rigs pa la yang rnam pa gnyis/ /gzhan sde mu stegs rnams kyi lugs/ / tshad ma gcig dang mang po dang*/ /de dag so so'i mtshan nyid dang*/ /dbye bsdu'i bye brag mang mod kyi/ /'khrul par grags pas 'dir ma bshad/ / rang sde sangs rgyas tshad mar 'dzin/ /de la snga phyi rnam pa gnyis/ /snga ma dbyeg gnyen legs ldan sogs/ /don la 'khrul pa med mod kyi/ /dbye bsdu'i khyad par 'ga' zhig dang*/ /brjod pa'i tshul la khyad par yod/ / phyi ma phyogs glang chos grags sogs/ /grangs dang dbye bsdu'i bye brag dang | | brjod pa'i tshul la nyung rgyas sogs/ /snga ma'i tshul las khyad par 'phags | | rtsod pa'i tshul la rnam gnyis mthong*/ /chos grags sgrub pa'i ngag bkod nas/ /gtan tshigs tsher ma 'byin par mdzad/ /gzhan du tshar gcad gnas su bzhed/ /phyi ma'i rigs pa smra ba 'ga'/ /sgrub byed brjod la phyir rgol gyis/ /skyon brjod nas ni tsher ma 'byin/ /bod rnams de dang mthun par rtsod/ /tshul 'di chos kyi grags pa yi/ /bzhed pa min phyir 'thad pa dka'/ /'di 'dra'i rtsod pa sde bdun dang*/ /rigs pa'i gter du shes par gyis/ /'dir ni gsar bu rtogs sla ba'i/ /rnam par bzhag par cung zad bshad/ /'dri na skabs su bab pa dri/ /cig car rnam grangs mang po min/ /bsgrub bya gcig la rtags mang po/ /'jug kyang rtsod na mang po min/ /snga ma rtags min tshar gcad gnas/ /rtags yin phyi ma tshar gcad 'gyur/

/chos can ma grub pa la sogs/ /gtan tshigs dris pas 'grub par gsal/ /dbu ma pa dag stong nyid kyis/ / brtsad na gzhan gyi lan rnams kun/ /bsgrub bya dag dang mtshungs pa yi/ / ma grub pa zhes slaub dpon bzhed/ /bod rnams thal 'gyur lan la gsum | | gtan tshigs khyab pa ma grub dang*/ /yang na 'dod pas lan 'debs so/ /de ltar na ni thal 'gyur skyon/ /thams cad ma grub gcig pur 'gyur/ /de 'dra sde bdun las ma bshad/ /'gal ba'i thal 'gyur brjod pa la/ /yod kyang yin na ci sto zhes/ /sdud par byed pa'i tshig phrad kyi | | nus pa phyin ci log tu 'gyur/ /'di ni ma grub 'gal ma nges/ / gsum yin min na 'dod pa grub/ /de dag min na yang dag gi /thal 'gyur yin phyir bzlog mi nus/ /de ltar chos dang mthun pa yi/ /rtsod pa bstan pa 'phel ba'i rgyu//dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa'i skye bos legs par sbyar/ /de ltar legs par gtan phab nas/ / dpang pos 'dzin du gzhug pa'i phyir/ /rtsod pa'i ngag rnams bsdus te bsgrags | | 'di ni mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs yin/ /gal te tshogs pa blun po'am/ /chags sdang sgo nas mi 'dzin na/ /gnas der rjes brjod bris nas ni/ /mkhas pa'i gzu bo gzhan la bstan/ /bde gshegs bstan pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /log lta'i ri dwags thams cad pham byas te/ /rtsod pa med pa'i go 'phang la gnas nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyun du 'dzin par shog /mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo las 'bel ba'i gtam la 'jug pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// //༈thub pa'i bstan pa phyogs su 'phel ba dang*/ /'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pa'i lugs 'dzin mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sga /rnam gsum phye 'dir mkhas rnams 'jug par bya/ / snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can bsod nams chung*/ /de phyir mkhas pa slob pa'i skal ba med/ /bdag gis 'bad kyang gzhan gyis 'dzin pa nyung | | des na gzhan la phan pa'i go skabs dka'/

/da dung bdag la legs spyad ( bshad ) yod mod kyi/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba'i spyod yul min/ /mkhas pa 'dod pa'i skye bo nyung bas na/ /byed pa chung phyir rgyas par 'dir ma spros/ /bstan pa'i mjug 'dir bstan la rab gus shing | | bstan pa mtha' dag bsrung zhing 'dzin 'dod pa/ /shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang pos bstan la phan phyir 'di sbyar ro/ /deng sang shākya seng ge'i bstan pa 'di/ /'bab chu zad pa'i rdzing bzhin nyin re 'bri/ /blo gsal rnams kyis tshul 'di legs rtogs la/ / thar pa 'dod pa dag gis 'bad dgos so/ /bdag gis bstan pa spel phyir 'di bkod pas/ /mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo ni rab phye bas/ /'gro kun thar pa chen po'i sgor zhugs te/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa thob par shog /blo gros gsal ba'i skye bo rnams thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i sgo/ dam pa rnams kyis bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs/ rtsom pa dang*/ 'chad pa dang*/ rtsod pa'i tshul gtan la 'bebs par byed pa | mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di ni yul byang phyogs kyi rgyud kha ba can gyi ljongs/ byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje'i gdan las dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i gnas/ ( gtsang la stod grom pa dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang na gnas pa/ ) 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs kyi 'od zer gyis yid kyi mun pa cung zad bsal bar byas pas/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor phal mo che la blo'i snang ba thob pas 'chad pa dang*/ rtsom pa dang*/ rtsod pa'i tshul la spobs pa dge ba can shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ / 'di'i sbyar byang nang gug rtags gnyis kyi bar bcug tshig de rnams sde spar du chad dam snyam pa 'dug pas mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/ zhes gzhung 'di rtsa 'grel sbrags mar bzhugs pa las blo 'dzin bde ched tshul rgyan pas rtsa ba logs su phyung ba dge legs 'phel/

/smras pa/rnam dkar 'phrul gyi yi ge 'di/ /rnam 'dren gsung gi bdud rtsi'i mdzod/ /rnam par rol ba'i bsoXd namaXs can/ /rnam kun tsheX blo 'pheXl des bgyis/ /dgeX bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /dgeX legs dam pa'i dpal thob cing*/ /dgeX ba'i bshes kyi zhabs pad kyang*/ /dgeX ba gang mthus brtan gyur cig /bstaXn la lhag bsam dag pa'i rgyus/ /bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs brtan nas||bstaXn pa yun ring 'phel ba dang*/ /bstaXn pa 'dzin nus 'gyur bar shog /ces pa ni ye ge pas so// // ༄༅/ /dag par byed pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /spyir na bod kyi yi ge la/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed gnyis su dbye/ /dbyangs yig i u e o bzhi/ /gsal byed ka sogs sum cu yin/ /gsal byed yi ge sum cu las/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu dbyung la/ /de las sngon 'jug lnga dbyung bya/ /ga da ba ma 'a sngon 'jug /ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ /ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug go /da sa gnyis ni yang 'jug ste/ /da ni na ra la gsum dang*/ /sa ni ga nga ba mar thob/ /su ru ra du na la tu/ /la don rnam pa bdun du 'dod/ /sa su ga ba da drag tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /'a dang mtha' med ra dang ru/ /gi gyi kyi 'i yi lnga po/ / rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra dang*/ /de rnams sa mtha' can lnga ni/ /rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa'i sgra/ /sbyor tshul na ma ra la gyi/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi | 'a dang mtha' med 'i dang yi/ /kyang yang 'ang gsum rgyad sdud de/ / ga da ba sa drag mtha' kyang*/ /nga na ma ra la mthar yang*/ /'a dang mtha' rten med pa'i mthar/ /'ang dang yang gnyis skabs bstun sbyor/ /de te ste gsum lhag bcas te/ /na ra la sa drag mthar te/ /da de ga nga ba ma 'a/ / mtha' med rnams la sa ste 'thob/ /phrad dang rnam dbye la rmongs na/ /sdeb legs tshig phreng spel nus min/ /de phyir brda sprod gzhung don la/ / brtson pa drag pos slob par 'tshal/

/ka ra ku shu'i zhal zas dang*/ /ka ba ko ba ka rkyang yin/ /skor ba skor dang skor mdzod dang*/ /sa mthar skor ba sa skor yin/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni sa sku la/ /rkun ma dag ni ra rku yin/ / ku co byed pa ku rkyang la/ /lkugs pa dag ni la lkugs yin/ /bkra shis tshon bkra ba bkra la/ /mgo bo'i skra ni sa skra yin/ /mgo mjug mgo ni ma mgo la/ /nad sogs 'go ba 'a 'go yin/ /dus tshod snga ba sa snga la/ / thugs la mnga' ba ma mnga' yin/ /brdung bya'i rnga ni ra rnga la/ /grangs kyi lnga ni la lnga yin/ /gong mas mngags pa ma mngags la/ /sngags 'dren pa dang sngags pa rnams/ /sa sngags yin pas shes par bya/ /gong ma'i drung ni da drung la/ /spyang grung 'dzoms pa ga grung yin/ /drung du mjal ba ma mjal la/ /bu lon 'jal 'a 'jal yin/ /'bru yi gro ni ga gro la/ /me dang nyi ma da dro yin/ /shing gi 'khan pa 'a 'khan la/ /mkhan po mkhas pa'i dbang po dang*/ /mkhar gyang la sogs ma yis 'phul/ /dus las 'da' ba 'a 'da' la/ /lung pa'i mda' dang 'phen pa'i mda'/ /ma mda' yin pas shes par bya/ /gnam gyi zla ba grogs kyi zla/ /zlog pa zlum po zlo ba dang*/ /zlos gar la sogs za la 'dogs/ /gang gā'i klung dang chu klung sogs/ /ka klung yin pas shes par bya/ /sa bdag klu ni ka klu la/ /len pa'i glu ni ga sdum glu/ /blon po dag ni ba blon la/ /ngan pas slu ba sa slu yin/ /'byung ba'i rlung ni ra rlung la/ /yi ge klog pa ka klog yin | | gon pa'i slog pa sa slog la/ /blo gros blo ldan ba blo yin/ /lus kyi glo ba leb mor gleb/ /glegs bam glegs shing glegs thag dang*/ / gling bu glen pa glog dmar dang*/ /gla ba glang ma gling bzhi sogs/ /ga la la 'dogs shes par bya/ /yid dga' ba ni da dga' la/ /dud 'gro'i sga ni sa sga yin/ /rgod ma rgan po ra rgan la/ /dgon pa dag ni da dgon yin | | chu la rgal ba ra rgal la/ /lus kyi sgal ba sa sgal yin/

/mang du bsnan pa sa bsnan la/ /blug pa'i snod dang snod bcud rnams/ /sa snod yin pas shes par bya/ /nam mkha'i gza' ni ga gza' la/ kha ru bza' ba ba bza' yin/ /gong mas gnang ba ga gnang la/ /mngon sum snang ba sa snang yin/ /sa bdag gnyan ni ga gnyan la/ /sgra snyan skad snyan snyan zhu dang | | snyan ngag la sogs sa snyan yin/ /gdong gi gnyer ma ga gnyer la | | bzhin ras snyer ba sa snyer yin/ /'ding ba'i stan ni sa stan la/ / gtan 'dun gtan tshigs ga gtan yin/ /mig gis lta ba la lta la/ / zhon pa'i rta ni ra rta yin/ /bla ma bsten pa sa bsten la/ /gzhan la brten pa ra brten yin/ /lcags rigs zha nye zha rkyang la/ /'phur ba'i bya ni ba bya yin || 'thung ba'i ja ni ja rkyang la/ /ljon shing ljang gu la ljang yin/ /gyen la 'dren pa da 'dren la/ /dngos rdzas 'grem pa ga 'grem yin/ /rnam pa mang po ra rnam la/ /sna tshogs dag ni sa sna yin/ /dus kyi dbyar ni da dbyar la/ /g.yar dam g.yo ba ga g.yor yin/ khog pa'i snying ni sa snying la || gsar rnying rnying ni ra rnying yin/ /gcod pa'i gri ni ga gri la/ /mnam pa'i dri ni da dri yin/ /gzhan la ster ba sa ster la/ /mdzod kyi gter ni ga gter yin/ /dngos po 'dzad pa 'a 'dzad la/ /bya ba mdzad dang khang pa'i mdzod/ /mdzes ma la sogs ma yis 'phul/ /sems kyi rtog pa ra rtog la/ khungs su gtogs pa ga gtogs yin/ /bor ba'i stor ba sa stor la/ /gtor ma gtor ba ga gtor yin/ /sde pa dag ni sa sde la/ /sku khams bde ba ba bde yin/ /dbang du sdud pa sa sdud la/ /bar chad bdud ni ba bdud yin/ /nang du gshegs pa ga gshegs la/ /sdig pa bshags pa ba bshags yin/ /mtho ba'i sgang ni sa sgang la/ /sgye snod dgang ba da dgang yin/ /gnas nas spags pa sa spags yin/ /dpag tu med pa da dpag yin/ /pags pa 'bri tshe pags rkyang la/ /stag lpags sogs la la lpags 'bri/ /dpal 'byor dpe cha la sogs pa/ /da yis 'phul bas shes par bya/

/ljon shing stag pa dud 'gro'i stag /sa stag yin pas shes par bya/ /dmigs yul dmigs bsal da dmigs la/ / dud 'gro'i rmig pa ra rmig yin/ /'tsho byed sman pa sa sman la/ /spus ka dman pa da dman yin/ khang ba'i sgo ni sa sgo la/ /skal du bgo ba ba bgo yin | | mgyogs par 'gro ba ma mgyogs la/ /yar la 'gyogs pa 'a 'gyogs yin/ /phyag tu bzhes pa ba bzhes la/ /dus kyi gzhes pa ga gzhes yin/ /na tshod gzhon pa ga gzhon la/ /bzhon rta bzhon ma ba bzhon yin/ /shing gi smyugs ma sa smyugs la/ /gnyug mar gnas pa ga gnyug yin//nye ba'i gnyen dang bshes gnyen dang*/ /gnyen po la sogs ga gnyen la/ /tshur la bsnyen pa sa bsnyen yin/ /rlig pa rlon pa rlangs pa che || ra la la 'dogs shes par bya/ /g.yang sa g.yang nor ga g.yang la// dbyangs len pa ni da dbyangs yin/ /mig 'phrul sgyu ma sa sgyu la/ /lus kyi rgyu ma ra rgyu yin/ /rin chen mtshal ni ma mtshal la/ /zhe sa'i 'tshal ni 'a 'tshal yin/ /rgya mtsho dag ni ma mtsho la/ /phyugs zog 'tsho ba 'a 'tsho yin || rta sogs 'tsher ba 'a 'tsher la/ /'brog gi mtsher sa ma mtsher yin || rin chen gser ni ga gser la/ /bser bu ldang ba ba bser yin// 'dzin byed rnyi dang so yi rnyil/ /thob pa'i rnyed sogs ra mgo yin/ /snyan pa'i sgra ni sa sgra la/ /sdang ba'i dgra ni da dgra yin/ /gong ma'i gsung ni ga gsung la/ /dri bsung dag ni ba bsung yin/ /bya ba bshol ba ba bshol la/ /zhing rmo gshol ni ga gshol yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa sa bstan la/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ra brtan yin/ /rin chen gzi ni ga gzi la | | chang gis bzi ba ba bzi yin/ kha la mngar ba ma mngar la/ /tshar du dngar ba da dngar yin/ /'byung ba'i rdo ni ra rdo la/ /dar ba'i bdo ni ba bdo yin/ /'dzeg pa'i skas ni sa skas la/ /chu yi rka ni ra rka yin/ / sdug bsngal ba ni sa bsngal la/ /mngal nas skyes pa ma mngal yin/ / lus kyi rma ni ra rma la/

kha spu sma ra sa sma yin/ /mi gsod dme bo da dme la | | lus kyi sme ba sa sme yin/ /lcang ma lcug ma gzhu byed lcag /lceb dang lcags dang lce la sogs/ /la mgo can gyi lca yin no/ /gcong nad srog gcod gcong rong dang*/ /gcer bu gces phrug ga yis 'phul/ /'dogs pa'i rtod ni ra rtod la/ /lus kyi stod ni sa stod yin/ /rgod po bya rgod ra rgod la/ /gad mo dgod pa da dgod yin/ /yod de med de de rkyang la/ / lus dang sa yi lte ba dang*/ /rang thag lte ba la lte yin/ /grangs kyi stong phrag sa stong la/ /bzung ba gtong ba ga gtong yin/ /mdun du bshams pa ba bshams la/ /gos kyi gsham dang gshar sbyang sogs/ /ga yis 'phul bas shes par bya/ /mchog dkar gzhu ni ga gzhu la/ /gleng mo byed pa ga gleng yin/ /zas slong ba ni sa slong la/ /grod pa ltogs pa la ltogs yin | | rtse mo'i tog ni ta sgur tog /chung ba'i dog ni da rkyang yin/ /byad kyi sna ni sa sna la/ /nyan byed rna ba ra rna yin/ /dag 'byin mna' ni ma mna' la/ /na tshod na zug na rkyang yin/ /dpang po byed pa da dpang la/ / pang du sdod pa pa rkyang yin/ /rke yi lba ba la lba dang*/ / nang du sba ba sa sba la | | chu yi rba ni ra rba yin/ /sbal pa dag ni sa sbal la/ /gral la sdod pa ga gral yin/ /sog les dras pa da dras la/ /sta re dag ni sa sta yin// lha bsang byed pa ba bsang la/ /gsang gtam byed pa ga gsang yin/ / mtshon cha gdeng dang gdeng thob dang*/ kha gdang sogs la ga yis 'phul// nyes pa snyon pa sa snyon la/ /shes pa smyo ba sa smyo yin/ /gnyid log pa de ga gnyid la/ /tshad pas rnyid pa ra rnyid yin/ /gdams ngag zhu ba ga gdams la/ /thag pas bsdams pa sa bsdams yin/ /rtsed mo rtse ba ra rtse la/ /gnod pa'i gtse ba ga gtse yin/ /grangs brtsi brtse sems brtson 'grus dag /ra mgo bas 'phul can yin no/ /sems tsam pa ni tsam rkyang la/ kha zas rtsam pa ra rtsam yin/ /dbus gtsang gtsang ma ga gtsang la

| | lus kyi rtsa ni ra rtsa yin/ /ri khrod dben dang dben bcug byed/ / da yis 'phul bas shes par bya/ /'bigs pa'i gsor ni ga gsor la/ / bsod nams bsod snyoms ba bsod yin/ /'ching byed zhags pa zha zhags la/ /phyags ma dag ni pha phyags yin/ /pags pa mnyen pa ma mnyen la/ /gnod 'tshe'i nyen kha 'phul med nyen/ /yul ljongs ljan ljin lce yi ljags/ /la mgo can gyi ja yin no/ /rnam 'gyur rnam g.yeng ra rnam la | | snam bu snam sbyar sa snam yin/ /snag tsha dag ni sa snag la/ /rnag khrag rnag ni ra rnag yin/ /sgo nga dag kyang sa sgo la/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa da dgongs yin/ /grangs kyi bzhi ni ba bzhi la/ /sa gzhi dag ni ga gzhi yin/ /skal ldan dag ni sa skal la/ /dus kyi bskal ba bas 'phul bskal | | dud 'gro g.yi dang rin chen g.yu/ /g.yul kha la sogs ga yis 'phul//rtsig pa'i rmang ni ra rmang la/ /'bras bu smin pa sa smin yin// mnga' thang mnga' ni ma mnga' la/ /nga tsho nga rgyal nga rkyang yin/ /mtshon chas gsod pa ga gsod la/ /dus kyi srod ni ra btags srod/ /sdeb kha sdeb sbyor sa sdeb la/

/smon lam 'debs pa 'a 'debs yin/ / dag par byed pa'-i sdeb sbyor rin chen rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// // chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab kha skong pod dang po/ mel po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 286PAGE 287
